`patches/gs_gpu_accelerator.h`:

```h
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>

// Everything the GPU needs to draw one sprite exactly like the CPU fast path. Filled
// by GSCpuBackend::PrepareGpuSprite, which owns the geometry and UV arithmetic.
struct GSGpuSpriteJob
{
    int x0 = 0, y0 = 0, x1 = 0, y1 = 0; // scissored, inclusive
    uint32_t fbBlock = 0, fbWidth = 1;
    uint32_t source = 0;                 // RGBA of v1
    uint32_t alphaMode = 0, alphaFix = 0;
    uint32_t flags = 0;                  // 1 ABE, 2 TME, 4 TCC, 8 texture from snapshot
    uint32_t texBlock = 0, texWidth = 0;
    std::vector<int32_t> columnU;        // texel U for x0..x1
    std::vector<int32_t> rowV;           // texel V for y0..y1
    std::vector<uint32_t> snapshotPages; // 8 KB pages copied before the draw (feedback sprites)
};

// One triangle or general sprite for the tile rasterizer (gs_tiles.comp). The 64-word
// layout is shared with the shader; GSCpuBackend::PrepareGpuPrimitive fills it.
struct GSGpuPrimitive
{
    uint32_t words[64] = {};
    std::vector<uint32_t> columns, rows; // sprites: texel U/S per column and V/T per row
};

// Memory one primitive writes or reads, in 64-word blocks, so a batch can be split when
// a later primitive reads what an earlier one wrote.
struct GSGpuAccess
{
    uint32_t frameStart = 0, frameEnd = 0, frameWidth = 0, framePsm = 0;
    uint32_t depthStart = 0, depthEnd = 0, depthPsm = 0; // depthEnd == depthStart: no depth write
    uint32_t depthReadStart = 0, depthReadEnd = 0;       // Z read by the depth test with ZMSK set
    uint32_t textureStart = 0, textureEnd = 0;           // textureEnd == textureStart: untextured
};

// A run of host-to-local transfer pixels for the upload pipeline. The caller keeps the
// transfer state; destStart/destEnd bound the blocks it writes.
struct GSGpuUpload
{
    uint32_t block = 0, width = 1, psm = 0, x = 0, y = 0, rowWidth = 1, firstPixel = 0, count = 0;
    uint32_t destStart = 0, destEnd = 0;
};

// A local-to-local transfer for the copy pipeline: destination as in GSGpuUpload
// (firstPixel unused, count = rrw * rrh), plus the source. Source and destination
// must not overlap.
struct GSGpuCopy
{
    GSGpuUpload dest;
    uint32_t block = 0, width = 1, psm = 0, x = 0, y = 0, dir = 0;
    uint32_t sourceStart = 0, sourceEnd = 0;
};

// A CLUT load that reads local memory still written by queued GPU work: the GPU runs it in
// queue order (GSCpuBackend::LoadClutUnlocked's decoded arguments), so the CPU need not wait.
// sourceStart/sourceEnd bound the blocks it reads.
struct GSGpuClutLoad
{
    uint32_t cbp = 0, cpsm = 0, csm = 0, sourceWidth = 1, cou = 0, cov = 0;
    uint32_t firstEntry = 0, entryCount = 0, destinationBase = 0;
    bool csm1Suffix = false;
    uint32_t sourceStart = 0, sourceEnd = 0;
};

// Runs GS work on the GPU through Vulkan compute (PS2X_GS_GPU=1). The GS local memory
// lives in a host-visible buffer, so the CPU backend keeps drawing whatever the GPU
// does not handle yet straight into the same memory. Draws queued here are recorded
// into a command buffer, sent by Submit() and finished by Flush(); the caller flushes
// before any CPU access that Touches reports.
class GSGpuAccelerator
{
public:
    // Null when PS2X_GS_GPU is unset or Vulkan cannot start (the CPU path is used then).
    static std::unique_ptr<GSGpuAccelerator> CreateFromEnvironment(uint32_t vramSize);
    ~GSGpuAccelerator();

    uint8_t *vram() const;
    void QueueSprite(const GSGpuSpriteJob &job);
    void QueuePrimitive(const GSGpuPrimitive &primitive, const GSGpuAccess &access);
    // False when the bytes don't fit the ring: the caller uploads on the CPU then.
    // mirrored: the caller also wrote these pixels to host memory, so the blocks need no
    // copy back and do not count as pending writes for host reads (CLUT loads).
    bool QueueUpload(const GSGpuUpload &upload, const uint8_t *data, uint32_t sizeBytes, bool mirrored = false);
    void QueueLocalCopy(const GSGpuCopy &copy);
    // The CLUT for primitives queued from now on (earlier ones keep theirs).
    // unknown: 512-bit mask of entries only the GPU knows (loaded by QueueClutLoad and not
    // rewritten since); they keep their GPU value. Null: all entries are known.
    void SetClut(const uint16_t *entries512, const uint64_t *unknown = nullptr);
    // A CLUT load on the GPU (cpsm CT32, CT16 or CT16S); unknown is the mask after it.
    void QueueClutLoad(const GSGpuClutLoad &load, const uint64_t *unknown);
    // The current CLUT as the GPU holds it; the caller ran Flush first.
    void ReadClut(uint16_t *entries512);
    // The CPU wrote local memory blocks [start, end) of vram(): the GPU copy needs them.
    void HostWrote(uint32_t start, uint32_t end);
    // True when queued GPU work reads or writes local memory blocks [start, end): CPU
    // writes there (uploads) or reads (CLUT loads, readback) must Flush() first.
    // Reads only clash with pending writes; writes clash with both.
    bool Touches(uint32_t start, uint32_t end, bool forWrite) const;
    // Sends queued work without waiting; Touches still sees it until it finishes.
    void Submit();
    // Sends queued work and waits for everything: local memory is then current on the host.
    void Flush();
    // Queues a GPU copy of all local memory as it stands after the work queued so far and
    // submits it without waiting; TakeCapture hands it over once the GPU finished.
    void QueueCapture();
    // Copies the newest finished capture (vram size) to dst; false when none is ready.
    bool TakeCapture(uint8_t *dst);
    bool HasPendingWork() const;

private:
    GSGpuAccelerator();
    bool Initialize(uint32_t vramSize);

    struct Impl;
    std::unique_ptr<Impl> m_impl;
};

```

`patches/gs_raster.vert`:

```vert
#version 450
// Rasterizer path: three vertices per GS record, read from the record itself. Triangles use
// (words 60,61), (62,63), (30,31) (offset-adjusted, pixel units). A general sprite is one
// triangle twice its scissored rectangle (words 1-4), cut back by the fragment's box test:
// two triangles would both cover the diagonal under conservative rasterization.
layout(std430, binding = 4) restrict readonly buffer Records { uint rec[]; };
layout(push_constant) uniform Batch
{
    uint tileBase, recordBase;
    uint upBlock, upWidth, upPsm, upX, upY, upRowWidth, upFirstPixel, upCount, upData;
    uint srcBlock, srcWidth, srcPsm, srcX, srcY;
} pc;
layout(location = 0) flat out uint vRecord;

void main()
{
    const uint record = pc.recordBase + uint(gl_VertexIndex) / 3u;
    const uint corner = uint(gl_VertexIndex) % 3u;
    const uint base = record * 64u;
    vec2 p;
    if (rec[base] == 0u)
    {
        // Normal rasterization of a dilated triangle. The fragment's edge test accepts
        // barycentrics >= -1e-4: that region is the triangle scaled by 1 + 3e-4 about its
        // center (2.5e-4 used here for float slack); each edge then moves out by kMargin
        // pixels for the rasterizer's subpixel snapping, the corner miter capped at 4 px.
        const vec2 v[3] = vec2[3](vec2(uintBitsToFloat(rec[base + 60u]), uintBitsToFloat(rec[base + 61u])),
                                  vec2(uintBitsToFloat(rec[base + 62u]), uintBitsToFloat(rec[base + 63u])),
                                  vec2(uintBitsToFloat(rec[base + 30u]), uintBitsToFloat(rec[base + 31u])));
        const vec2 center = (v[0] + v[1] + v[2]) / 3.0;
        const vec2 self = v[corner], next = v[(corner + 1u) % 3u], prev = v[(corner + 2u) % 3u];
        const float kMargin = 1.0 / 32.0;
        const float orientation = sign((next.x - self.x) * (prev.y - self.y) - (next.y - self.y) * (prev.x - self.x));
        // Outward unit normals of the two edges meeting here.
        const vec2 a = normalize(next - self), b = normalize(self - prev);
        const vec2 na = -orientation * vec2(-a.y, a.x), nb = -orientation * vec2(-b.y, b.x);
        vec2 miter = kMargin * (na + nb) / max(1.0 + dot(na, nb), 1e-6);
        if (length(miter) > 4.0)
            miter = normalize(miter) * 4.0;
        p = self + 7.5e-4 * (self - center) + miter;
    }
    else
    {
        const float x0 = float(int(rec[base + 1u])), x1 = float(int(rec[base + 2u]) + 1);
        const float y0 = float(int(rec[base + 3u])), y1 = float(int(rec[base + 4u]) + 1);
        p = corner == 0u ? vec2(x0, y0) : corner == 1u ? vec2(2.0 * x1 - x0, y0) : vec2(x0, 2.0 * y1 - y0);
    }
    gl_Position = vec4(p / 1024.0 - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    vRecord = record;
}

```

```cpp
#include "runtime/gs/gs_recording_backend.h"
#include "runtime/gs/gs_cpu_backend.h"

#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <iostream>
#include <type_traits>

namespace
{
    constexpr char kMagic[8] = {'P', 'S', '2', 'X', 'G', 'S', 'R', '1'};

    enum RecordKind : uint8_t
    {
        kEnd = 0,
        kDraw,
        kLoadClut,
        kBeginTransfer,
        kUploadImage,
        kFrameEnd,
        kWriteVram,
        kClearFramebuffer,
        kTextureFlush,
        kConsumeLocalToHost,
        kReset,
    };

    struct LayoutHeader
    {
        uint32_t batch = sizeof(GSPrimitiveBatch);
        uint32_t tex0 = sizeof(GSTex0Reg);
        uint32_t texclut = sizeof(GSTexClutReg);
        uint32_t transfer = sizeof(GSTransferCommand);
        uint32_t context = sizeof(GSContext);
    };

    struct LoadClutRecord
    {
        GSTex0Reg tex0;
        GSTexClutReg texclut;
    };

    struct WriteVramRecord
    {
        uint32_t psm, base, bw, x, y, value;
    };

    struct ClearRecord
    {
        GSContext context;
        uint32_t rgba;
    };

    static_assert(std::is_trivially_copyable_v<GSPrimitiveBatch> && std::is_trivially_copyable_v<GSTransferCommand> &&
                      std::is_trivially_copyable_v<GSContext>,
                  "GS recordings store these structs raw");

    void writeBlob(std::FILE *file, const std::vector<uint8_t> &blob)
    {
        const uint32_t size = static_cast<uint32_t>(blob.size());
        std::fwrite(&size, sizeof(size), 1, file);
        if (size)
            std::fwrite(blob.data(), 1, size, file);
    }
}

GSRecordingBackend::GSRecordingBackend(std::unique_ptr<GSRasterBackend> inner, std::string path, double startSeconds, uint32_t frameCount)
    : m_inner(std::move(inner)), m_path(std::move(path)), m_created(std::chrono::steady_clock::now()),
      m_startSeconds(startSeconds), m_framesLeft(std::max<uint32_t>(frameCount, 1u))
{
}

GSRecordingBackend::~GSRecordingBackend()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(m_mutex);
    if (m_file)
    {
        const uint8_t end = kEnd;
        std::fwrite(&end, 1, 1, m_file);
        std::fclose(m_file);
    }
}

std::unique_ptr<GSRasterBackend> GSRecordingBackend::WrapFromEnvironment(std::unique_ptr<GSRasterBackend> inner)
{
    const char *path = std::getenv("PS2X_GS_RECORD");
    if (!path || !*path)
        return inner;
    const char *at = std::getenv("PS2X_GS_RECORD_AT");
    const char *frames = std::getenv("PS2X_GS_RECORD_FRAMES");
    const double startSeconds = at ? std::atof(at) : 0.0;
    const uint32_t frameCount = frames ? static_cast<uint32_t>(std::atoi(frames)) : 30u;
    std::cerr << "[gs:record] " << path << " from " << startSeconds << " s, " << frameCount << " frames" << std::endl;
    return std::make_unique<GSRecordingBackend>(std::move(inner), path, startSeconds, frameCount);
}

void GSRecordingBackend::startRecording()
{
    std::vector<uint8_t> vram, state;
    m_inner->SnapshotVram(vram);
    if (auto *cpu = dynamic_cast<GSCpuBackend *>(m_inner.get()))
        cpu->SaveState(state);

    m_file = std::fopen(m_path.c_str(), "wb");
    if (!m_file)
    {
        std::cerr << "[gs:record] cannot open " << m_path << std::endl;
        m_done = true;
        return;
    }
    const LayoutHeader layout{};
    std::fwrite(kMagic, sizeof(kMagic), 1, m_file);
    std::fwrite(&layout, sizeof(layout), 1, m_file);
    writeBlob(m_file, vram);
    writeBlob(m_file, state);
    std::cerr << "[gs:record] started" << std::endl;
}

void GSRecordingBackend::writeRecord(uint8_t kind, const void *data, size_t size)
{
    if (!m_file)
        return;
    std::fwrite(&kind, 1, 1, m_file);
    if (size)
        std::fwrite(data, 1, size, m_file);
}

void GSRecordingBackend::Submit(const GSPrimitiveBatch &batch)
{
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(m_mutex);
        // MKSM double-buffers in frame pages 0x00 and 0x46: switching between them
        // starts a game frame (the bloom and depth copies in between are part of it).
        const uint32_t fbp = batch.state.context.frame.fbp;
        const bool mainTarget = fbp == 0x00u || fbp == 0x46u;
        const bool frameEnd = mainTarget && m_lastMainFbp != ~0u && fbp != m_lastMainFbp;
        if (mainTarget)
            m_lastMainFbp = fbp;
        if (frameEnd && !m_done)
        {
            if (m_file)
            {
                writeRecord(kFrameEnd, nullptr, 0u);
                if (--m_framesLeft == 0u)
                {
                    const uint8_t end = kEnd;
                    std::fwrite(&end, 1, 1, m_file);
                    std::fclose(m_file);
                    m_file = nullptr;
                    m_done = true;
                    std::cerr << "[gs:record] finished " << m_path << std::endl;
                }
            }
            else if (std::chrono::duration<double>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - m_created).count() >= m_startSeconds)
            {
                startRecording();
            }
        }
        writeRecord(kDraw, &batch, sizeof(batch));
    }
    m_inner->Submit(batch);
}

void GSRecordingBackend::LoadClut(const GSTex0Reg &tex0, const GSTexClutReg &texclut)
{
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(m_mutex);
        const LoadClutRecord record{tex0, texclut};
        writeRecord(kLoadClut, &record, sizeof(record));
    }
    m_inner->LoadClut(tex0, texclut);
}

void GSRecordingBackend::BeginTransfer(const GSTransferCommand &command)
{
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(m_mutex);
        writeRecord(kBeginTransfer, &command, sizeof(command));
    }
    m_inner->BeginTransfer(command);
}

void GSRecordingBackend::UploadImage(const uint8_t *data, uint32_t sizeBytes)
{
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(m_mutex);
        if (m_file && data && sizeBytes)
        {
            writeRecord(kUploadImage, &sizeBytes, sizeof(sizeBytes));
            std::fwrite(data, 1, sizeBytes, m_file);
        }
    }
    m_inner->UploadImage(data, sizeBytes);
}

void GSRecordingBackend::TextureFlush()
{
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(m_mutex);
        writeRecord(kTextureFlush, nullptr, 0u);
    }
    m_inner->TextureFlush();
}

        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(m_mutex);

bool GSRecording::Load(const std::string &path, std::string &error)
{
    std::FILE *file = std::fopen(path.c_str(), "rb");
    if (!file)
    {
        error = "cannot open " + path;
        return false;
    }
    std::vector<uint8_t> bytes;
    uint8_t buffer[1 << 16];
    size_t got;
    while ((got = std::fread(buffer, 1, sizeof(buffer), file)) > 0)
        bytes.insert(bytes.end(), buffer, buffer + got);
    std::fclose(file);

    size_t pos = 0u;
    auto take = [&](void *out, size_t size)
    {
        if (pos + size > bytes.size())
            return false;
        std::memcpy(out, bytes.data() + pos, size);
        pos += size;
        return true;
    };
    auto takeBlob = [&](std::vector<uint8_t> &out)
    {
        uint32_t size = 0u;
        if (!take(&size, sizeof(size)) || pos + size > bytes.size())
            return false;
        out.assign(bytes.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(pos), bytes.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(pos + size));
        pos += size;
        return true;
    };

    char magic[8];
    LayoutHeader layout{}, expected{};
    if (!take(magic, sizeof(magic)) || std::memcmp(magic, kMagic, sizeof(magic)) != 0)
    {
        error = "not a GS recording";
        return false;
    }
    if (!take(&layout, sizeof(layout)) || std::memcmp(&layout, &expected, sizeof(layout)) != 0)
    {
        error = "recorded with a different struct layout; record it again with this build";
        return false;
    }
    if (!takeBlob(m_vram) || !takeBlob(m_state))
    {
        error = "truncated header";
        return false;
    }
    m_records.assign(bytes.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(pos), bytes.end());

    // Validate the stream once and count frames, so Replay can trust it.
    m_frames = 0u;
    size_t at = 0u;
    while (at < m_records.size())
    {
        const uint8_t kind = m_records[at++];
        size_t size = 0u;
        switch (kind)
        {
        case kEnd: at = m_records.size(); continue;
        case kDraw: size = sizeof(GSPrimitiveBatch); break;
        case kLoadClut: size = sizeof(LoadClutRecord); break;
        case kBeginTransfer: size = sizeof(GSTransferCommand); break;
        case kUploadImage:
        {
            uint32_t n = 0u;
            if (at + sizeof(n) > m_records.size())
                break;
            std::memcpy(&n, m_records.data() + at, sizeof(n));
            size = sizeof(n) + n;
            break;
        }
        case kFrameEnd: ++m_frames; break;
        case kWriteVram: size = sizeof(WriteVramRecord); break;
        case kClearFramebuffer: size = sizeof(ClearRecord); break;
        case kTextureFlush: case kReset: break;
        case kConsumeLocalToHost: size = sizeof(uint32_t); break;
        default:
            error = "unknown record kind " + std::to_string(kind);
            return false;
        }
        if (at + size > m_records.size())
        {
            error = "truncated record";
            return false;
        }
        at += size;
    }
    return true;
}

void GSRecording::RestoreStart(GSRasterBackend &backend) const
{
    GSRasterBackend *target = &backend;
    if (auto *recorder = dynamic_cast<GSRecordingBackend *>(target))
        target = &recorder->inner();
    if (auto *cpu = dynamic_cast<GSCpuBackend *>(target))
        cpu->LoadState(m_vram, m_state);
}

void GSRecording::Replay(GSRasterBackend &backend, const std::function<void(uint32_t)> &onFrameEnd) const
{
    uint32_t frame = 0u;
    std::vector<uint8_t> scratch;
    size_t at = 0u;
    auto read = [&](void *out, size_t size)
    {
        std::memcpy(out, m_records.data() + at, size);
        at += size;
    };
    while (at < m_records.size())
    {
        const uint8_t kind = m_records[at++];
        switch (kind)
        {
        case kEnd:
            return;
        case kDraw:
        {
            GSPrimitiveBatch batch;
            read(&batch, sizeof(batch));
            backend.Submit(batch);
            break;
        }
        case kLoadClut:
        {
            LoadClutRecord record;
            read(&record, sizeof(record));
            backend.LoadClut(record.tex0, record.texclut);
            break;
        }
        case kBeginTransfer:
        {
            GSTransferCommand command;
            read(&command, sizeof(command));
            backend.BeginTransfer(command);
            break;
        }
        case kUploadImage:
        {
            uint32_t size = 0u;
            read(&size, sizeof(size));
            backend.UploadImage(m_records.data() + at, size);
            at += size;
            break;
        }
        case kFrameEnd:
            if (onFrameEnd)
                onFrameEnd(frame);
            ++frame;
            break;
        case kWriteVram:
        {
            WriteVramRecord record;
            read(&record, sizeof(record));
            backend.WriteVram(record.psm, record.base, record.bw, record.x, record.y, record.value);
            break;
        }
        case kClearFramebuffer:
        {
            ClearRecord record;
            read(&record, sizeof(record));
            backend.ClearFramebuffer(record.context, record.rgba);
            break;
        }
        case kTextureFlush:
            backend.TextureFlush();
            break;
        case kConsumeLocalToHost:
        {
            uint32_t maxBytes = 0u;
            read(&maxBytes, sizeof(maxBytes));
            scratch.resize(maxBytes);
            backend.ConsumeLocalToHostBytes(scratch.data(), maxBytes);
            break;
        }
        case kReset:
            backend.Reset();
            break;
        default:
            return; // Load already rejected unknown kinds.
        }
    }
}
```

`patches/gs_recording_backend.h`:

```h
#pragma once

#include "runtime/gs/gs_backend.h"

#include <chrono>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

// Records every command a GS backend receives, so a few frames of the real game can
// be replayed later without booting it (ps2x_gs_replay). The file holds the backend
// state at the first recorded frame, then the commands in order. Raw structs: a file
// is only valid for the build layout that wrote it (the header checks the sizes).
class GSRecordingBackend final : public GSRasterBackend
{
public:
    // Starts at the first frame end after startSeconds and stops after frameCount frames.
    GSRecordingBackend(std::unique_ptr<GSRasterBackend> inner, std::string path, double startSeconds, uint32_t frameCount);
    ~GSRecordingBackend() override;

    // PS2X_GS_RECORD=<file> [PS2X_GS_RECORD_AT=<s>] [PS2X_GS_RECORD_FRAMES=<n>] wraps the backend.
    static std::unique_ptr<GSRasterBackend> WrapFromEnvironment(std::unique_ptr<GSRasterBackend> inner);

    void Initialize(uint8_t *vram, uint32_t vramSize) override;
    void Reset() override;
    void Submit(const GSPrimitiveBatch &batch) override;
    void LoadClut(const GSTex0Reg &tex0, const GSTexClutReg &texclut) override;
    void BeginTransfer(const GSTransferCommand &command) override;
    void UploadImage(const uint8_t *data, uint32_t sizeBytes) override;
    void Flush() override;
    void TextureFlush() override;
    void Sync(GSSyncReason reason) override;
    PresentationFrame Present(const GSPresentationRequest &request) override;
    bool ClearFramebuffer(const GSContext &context, uint32_t rgba) override;
    uint32_t ConsumeLocalToHostBytes(uint8_t *dst, uint32_t maxBytes) override;
    uint32_t ReadVram(uint32_t psm, uint32_t base, uint32_t bw, uint32_t x, uint32_t y) const override;
    void WriteVram(uint32_t psm, uint32_t base, uint32_t bw, uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t value) override;
    void SnapshotVram(std::vector<uint8_t> &out) const override;
    GSTransferSnapshot GetTransferSnapshot() const override;

    GSRasterBackend &inner() { return *m_inner; }

private:
    void startRecording();
    void writeRecord(uint8_t kind, const void *data, size_t size);

    std::unique_ptr<GSRasterBackend> m_inner;
    std::string m_path;
    std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point m_created;
    double m_startSeconds;
    uint32_t m_framesLeft;
    uint32_t m_lastMainFbp = ~0u;
    std::FILE *m_file = nullptr;
    bool m_done = false;
    std::mutex m_mutex;
};

// A recording loaded in memory, replayable into any backend.
class GSRecording
{
public:
    bool Load(const std::string &path, std::string &error);

    // Puts the recorded starting VRAM and backend state into backend, which must
    // already be initialized over a VRAM of the recorded size.
    void RestoreStart(GSRasterBackend &backend) const;

    // Sends every command to backend; onFrameEnd(index) runs at each recorded frame end.
    void Replay(GSRasterBackend &backend, const std::function<void(uint32_t)> &onFrameEnd) const;

    const std::vector<uint8_t> &startVram() const { return m_vram; }
    uint32_t frameCount() const { return m_frames; }

private:
    std::vector<uint8_t> m_vram;
    std::vector<uint8_t> m_state;
    std::vector<uint8_t> m_records;
    uint32_t m_frames = 0u;
};
```

`patches/gs_replay.cpp`:

```cpp
// ps2x_gs_replay: draws a GS recording (PS2X_GS_RECORD) without the game.
//   ps2x_gs_replay file.gsr [--repeat N] [--dump-vram out.bin] [--compare ref.bin] [--ppm prefix]
// Prints the time per frame and a hash of the final VRAM, so a renderer change can be
// timed and checked against the CPU backend in seconds.
#include "runtime/gs/gs_cpu_backend.h"
#include "runtime/gs/gs_recording_backend.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <map>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace
{
    uint64_t fnv1a(const std::vector<uint8_t> &bytes)
    {
        uint64_t hash = 1469598103934665603ull;
        for (const uint8_t byte : bytes)
            hash = (hash ^ byte) * 1099511628211ull;
        return hash;
    }

    bool readFile(const std::string &path, std::vector<uint8_t> &out)
    {
        std::FILE *file = std::fopen(path.c_str(), "rb");
        if (!file)
            return false;
        std::fseek(file, 0, SEEK_END);
        out.resize(static_cast<size_t>(std::ftell(file)));
        std::fseek(file, 0, SEEK_SET);
        const bool ok = std::fread(out.data(), 1, out.size(), file) == out.size();
        std::fclose(file);
        return ok;
    }

    bool writeFile(const std::string &path, const void *data, size_t size)
    {
        std::FILE *file = std::fopen(path.c_str(), "wb");
        if (!file)
            return false;
        const bool ok = std::fwrite(data, 1, size, file) == size;
        std::fclose(file);
        return ok;
    }

    // MKSM draws 640x224 fields into frame pages 0x00 and 0x46 (CT32, width 640).
    void writeFramePpm(GSCpuBackend &backend, uint32_t page, const std::string &path)
    {
        constexpr uint32_t kWidth = 640u, kHeight = 224u;
        std::vector<uint8_t> rgb;
        rgb.reserve(kWidth * kHeight * 3u);
        for (uint32_t y = 0u; y < kHeight; ++y)
            for (uint32_t x = 0u; x < kWidth; ++x)
            {
                const uint32_t pixel = backend.ReadVram(GS_PSM_CT32, page * 32u, kWidth / 64u, x, y);
                rgb.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(pixel));
                rgb.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(pixel >> 8));
                rgb.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(pixel >> 16));
            }
        const std::string header = "P6\n" + std::to_string(kWidth) + " " + std::to_string(kHeight) + "\n255\n";
        std::vector<uint8_t> out(header.begin(), header.end());
        out.insert(out.end(), rgb.begin(), rgb.end());
        writeFile(path, out.data(), out.size());
    }
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    if (argc < 2)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "usage: %s file.gsr [--repeat N] [--dump-vram out] [--compare ref] [--ppm prefix] [--sync 0|1]\n", argv[0]);
        return 2;
    }
    const std::string path = argv[1];
    int repeat = 1;
    bool syncEachFrame = true; // 0: no wait per field, so the GPU overlaps the next one as in the game
    std::string dumpPath, comparePath, ppmPrefix;
    for (int i = 2; i + 1 < argc; i += 2)
    {
        const std::string option = argv[i];
        if (option == "--repeat")
            repeat = std::max(1, std::atoi(argv[i + 1]));
        else if (option == "--dump-vram")
            dumpPath = argv[i + 1];
        else if (option == "--compare")
            comparePath = argv[i + 1];
        else if (option == "--sync")
            syncEachFrame = std::atoi(argv[i + 1]) != 0;
        else if (option == "--ppm")
            ppmPrefix = argv[i + 1];
        else
        {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "unknown option %s\n", option.c_str());
            return 2;
        }
    }

    GSRecording recording;
    std::string error;
    if (!recording.Load(path, error))
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "%s: %s\n", path.c_str(), error.c_str());
        return 1;
    }

    std::vector<uint8_t> vram(recording.startVram().size());
    GSCpuBackend backend;
    backend.Initialize(vram.data(), static_cast<uint32_t>(vram.size()));

    std::vector<double> frameMs;
    double totalMs = 0.0;
    for (int pass = 0; pass < repeat; ++pass)
    {
        recording.RestoreStart(backend);
        auto frameStart = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        const auto start = frameStart;
        recording.Replay(backend, [&](uint32_t)
                         {
            if (syncEachFrame)
                backend.Sync(GSSyncReason::DebugReadback);
            const auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
            frameMs.push_back(std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(now - frameStart).count());
            frameStart = now; });
        backend.Sync(GSSyncReason::DebugReadback);
        totalMs += std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count();
    }

    std::vector<uint8_t> finalVram;
    backend.SnapshotVram(finalVram);
    std::sort(frameMs.begin(), frameMs.end());
    const double median = frameMs.empty() ? 0.0 : frameMs[frameMs.size() / 2];
    std::printf("%s: %u frames x %d, %.1f ms total, frame median %.2f ms (%.1f fps), worst %.2f ms\n",
                path.c_str(), recording.frameCount(), repeat, totalMs, median, median > 0.0 ? 1000.0 / median : 0.0,
                frameMs.empty() ? 0.0 : frameMs.back());
    std::printf("vram hash %016llx\n", static_cast<unsigned long long>(fnv1a(finalVram)));

    if (!dumpPath.empty() && !writeFile(dumpPath, finalVram.data(), finalVram.size()))
        std::fprintf(stderr, "cannot write %s\n", dumpPath.c_str());
    if (!ppmPrefix.empty())
    {
        writeFramePpm(backend, 0x00u, ppmPrefix + "_fb00.ppm");
        writeFramePpm(backend, 0x46u, ppmPrefix + "_fb46.ppm");
    }

    int status = 0;
    if (!comparePath.empty())
    {
        std::vector<uint8_t> reference;
        if (!readFile(comparePath, reference) || reference.size() != finalVram.size())
        {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "cannot read %s or size differs\n", comparePath.c_str());
            return 1;
        }
        std::map<size_t, size_t> pages; // 8 KB page -> differing bytes
        size_t differing = 0u;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < reference.size(); ++i)
            if (reference[i] != finalVram[i])
            {
                ++differing;
                ++pages[i / 8192u];
            }
        std::printf("compare %s: %zu bytes differ in %zu pages\n", comparePath.c_str(), differing, pages.size());
        size_t shown = 0u;
        for (const auto &[page, count] : pages)
        {
            if (shown++ == 16u)
                break;
            std::printf("  page 0x%zx: %zu bytes\n", page, count);
        }
        status = differing ? 3 : 0;
    }
    return status;
}

```

`patches/gs_sprite.comp`:

```comp
#version 450
// GS sprites of the CPU fast path (GSCpuBackend::DrawSprite, simplePixels &&
// simpleTexture): CT32 frame, no Z, alpha test, mask, fog or filtering; optional CT32
// DECAL texture. Same integer arithmetic as the CPU so the VRAM comes out identical.
// Texel coordinates come per column/row from the CPU (uvTable), which keeps the float
// division of the CPU path exact.

layout(local_size_x = 8, local_size_y = 8) in;

layout(std430, binding = 0) buffer Vram { uint vram[]; };              // 4 MB of GS local memory
layout(std430, binding = 1) readonly buffer Snapshot { uint snapshot[]; }; // pages copied before a feedback sprite
layout(std430, binding = 2) readonly buffer Swizzle { uint swizzleCT32[]; }; // [y % 32][x % 64] -> BlockId * 64 + ColumnId
layout(std430, binding = 3) readonly buffer UvTable { int uvTable[]; };

// A batch of sprites, one per workgroup layer (gl_WorkGroupID.z). The CPU only batches
// sprites that neither overlap each other's writes nor read what another one writes
// (feedback sprites read the snapshot, copied before the batch), so the layers are
// independent and the result matches drawing them one by one.
layout(push_constant) uniform Batch
{
    uint descBase;   // uvTable index of the first 16-word descriptor
    uint count;
} pc;

// Descriptor words: x0, y0, x1, y1 (inclusive, scissored), fbBlock, fbWidth, source (RGBA
// of v1), alphaMode (ALPHA bits 0..7), alphaFix, flags (1 ABE, 2 TME, 4 TCC, 8 texture
// from snapshot), texBlock, texWidth (TBW as given), uvOffsetU (uvTable index of column
// x0), uvOffsetV (of row y0).
const uint kMemoryWords = 4u * 1024u * 1024u / 4u;

uint addressCT32(uint block, uint width, uint x, uint y)
{
    const uint page = block / 32u + (y / 32u) * ((width * 64u) / 64u) + x / 64u;
    const uint word = page * 2048u + (block % 32u) * 64u + swizzleCT32[(y % 32u) * 64u + (x % 64u)];
    return word & (kMemoryWords - 1u);
}

int pick(uint sel, int cs, int cd)
{
    return sel == 0u ? cs : sel == 1u ? cd : 0;
}

void main()
{
    const uint d = pc.descBase + gl_WorkGroupID.z * 16u;
    const ivec4 drawRect = ivec4(uvTable[d], uvTable[d + 1u], uvTable[d + 2u], uvTable[d + 3u]);
    const uint fbBlock = uint(uvTable[d + 4u]), fbWidth = uint(uvTable[d + 5u]), source = uint(uvTable[d + 6u]);
    const uint alphaMode = uint(uvTable[d + 7u]), alphaFix = uint(uvTable[d + 8u]), flags = uint(uvTable[d + 9u]);
    const uint texBlock = uint(uvTable[d + 10u]), texWidth = uint(uvTable[d + 11u]);
    const uint uvOffsetU = uint(uvTable[d + 12u]), uvOffsetV = uint(uvTable[d + 13u]);

    const int x = drawRect.x + int(gl_GlobalInvocationID.x);
    const int y = drawRect.y + int(gl_GlobalInvocationID.y);
    if (x > drawRect.z || y > drawRect.w)
        return;

    uint src = source;
    if ((flags & 2u) != 0u)
    {
        const uint u = uint(uvTable[uvOffsetU + uint(x - drawRect.x)]);
        const uint v = uint(uvTable[uvOffsetV + uint(y - drawRect.y)]);
        const uint at = addressCT32(texBlock, texWidth, u, v);
        const uint texel = (flags & 8u) != 0u ? snapshot[at] : vram[at];
        src = (flags & 4u) != 0u ? texel : ((texel & 0x00FFFFFFu) | (source & 0xFF000000u));
    }

    const uint at = addressCT32(fbBlock, fbWidth, uint(x), uint(y));
    uint result = src;
    if ((flags & 1u) != 0u)
    {
        const uint dest = vram[at];
        const uint asel = alphaMode & 3u, bsel = (alphaMode >> 2) & 3u;
        const uint csel = (alphaMode >> 4) & 3u, dsel = (alphaMode >> 6) & 3u;
        const int cAlpha = csel == 0u ? int(src >> 24) : csel == 1u ? int(dest >> 24) : int(alphaFix);
        result = src & 0xFF000000u;
        for (uint shift = 0u; shift < 24u; shift += 8u)
        {
            const int cs = int((src >> shift) & 0xFFu), cd = int((dest >> shift) & 0xFFu);
            const int value = (((pick(asel, cs, cd) - pick(bsel, cs, cd)) * cAlpha) >> 7) + pick(dsel, cs, cd);
            result |= uint(clamp(value, 0, 255)) << shift;
        }
    }
    vram[at] = result;
}
```
