`patches/gs_tiles.comp`:

```comp
#version 450
#extension GL_ARB_gpu_shader_fp64 : require
#ifdef GS_RASTER
#extension GL_ARB_fragment_shader_interlock : require
#endif
// GS triangles and general sprites, one 8x8 screen tile per workgroup. Each
// invocation owns one pixel and walks the primitives of its tile in GS order, so
// blending and depth see exactly the order the CPU backend uses. Every step mirrors
// GSCpuBackend (DrawTriangle, DrawSprite general path, SampleTexture, LookupCLUT,
// combineTexture, WritePixel); float math is `precise` and the CPU side is built
// with -ffp-contract=off, so both run the same IEEE operations.

// 8x8 tiles: MKSM's scenes are many small triangles, and every invocation of a tile walks
// every primitive in it; 16x16 tiles spent most of that walk rejecting by bounding box.
const uint kTileSize = 8u, kGroupSize = kTileSize * kTileSize; // must match gs_gpu_accelerator.cpp
#ifndef GS_RASTER
layout(local_size_x = 8, local_size_y = 8) in;
#endif

#ifdef GS_RASTER
// Interlocked fragments of one pixel may run on different SMs: writes must skip their L1.
layout(std430, binding = 0) coherent buffer Vram { uint vram[]; };
#else
layout(std430, binding = 0) buffer Vram { uint vram[]; };
#endif
layout(std430, binding = 2) restrict readonly buffer Tables { uint tables[]; };     // page tables, see layoutInfo
layout(std430, binding = 3) restrict readonly buffer UvTable { uint uvTable[]; };   // sprite columns/rows
layout(std430, binding = 4) restrict readonly buffer Records { uint rec[]; };       // 64 uints per primitive
layout(std430, binding = 5) restrict readonly buffer Tiles { uint tiles[]; };       // per active tile: x, y, first, count, then indices
layout(std430, binding = 6) restrict buffer Clut { uint clut[]; };                  // versions of 512 x 16-bit CLUT entries
layout(std430, binding = 7) buffer TexCache { uint texCache[]; };                     // decoded textures, tw*th texels each

// 1 builds the host-to-local upload pipeline from this same shader (uploadMain), 2 the
// local-to-local copy pipeline (copyMain), 3 the texture decode pipeline (decodeMain).
layout(constant_id = 0) const uint kMode = 0u;

layout(push_constant) uniform Batch
{
    uint tileBase;   // tiles[] offset of this dispatch's tile headers
    uint recordBase; // rec[] offset (in records) of this dispatch
    // Upload: destination buffer and the transfer pixels this dispatch writes, whose
    // bytes start at uvTable[upData].
    uint upBlock, upWidth, upPsm, upX, upY, upRowWidth, upFirstPixel, upCount, upData;
    // Copy: source buffer and origin; upData holds TRXPOS.DIR.
    uint srcBlock, srcWidth, srcPsm, srcX, srcY;
} pc;

const uint kRecordWords = 64u;
const uint kMemoryBytes = 4u * 1024u * 1024u;
const float kEdgeEpsilon = 1.0e-4;

// ---- GS local memory layouts (same tables as GSMem::PixelAddress) -------------------
// layout: 0 C32, 1 Z32, 2 C16, 3 C16S, 4 Z16, 5 Z16S, 6 P8, 7 P4
const uint kPageW[8] = uint[8](64u, 64u, 64u, 64u, 64u, 64u, 128u, 128u);
const uint kPageH[8] = uint[8](32u, 32u, 64u, 64u, 64u, 64u, 64u, 128u);
const uint kPerBlock[8] = uint[8](64u, 64u, 128u, 128u, 128u, 128u, 256u, 512u);
const uint kTableOffset[8] = uint[8](0u, 2048u, 4096u, 8192u, 12288u, 16384u, 20480u, 28672u);

void formatInfo(uint psm, out uint layoutIndex, out uint unpackedBits, out uint bitOffset, out uint packedBytes)
{
    layoutIndex = 0u; unpackedBits = 32u; bitOffset = 0u; packedBytes = 4u;
    switch (psm)
    {
    case 0x00u: case 0x01u: break;                                        // CT32, CT24
    case 0x1Bu: bitOffset = 24u; packedBytes = 1u; break;                // T8H
    case 0x24u: bitOffset = 24u; packedBytes = 1u; break;                // T4HL
    case 0x2Cu: bitOffset = 28u; packedBytes = 1u; break;                // T4HH
    case 0x30u: case 0x31u: layoutIndex = 1u; break;                     // Z32, Z24
    case 0x02u: layoutIndex = 2u; unpackedBits = 16u; packedBytes = 2u; break;
    case 0x0Au: layoutIndex = 3u; unpackedBits = 16u; packedBytes = 2u; break;
    case 0x32u: layoutIndex = 4u; unpackedBits = 16u; packedBytes = 2u; break;
    case 0x3Au: layoutIndex = 5u; unpackedBits = 16u; packedBytes = 2u; break;
    case 0x13u: layoutIndex = 6u; unpackedBits = 8u; packedBytes = 1u; break;
    case 0x14u: layoutIndex = 7u; unpackedBits = 4u; packedBytes = 1u; break;
    default: break;
    }
}

// Page sizes and pixels per block are powers of two: shifts instead of integer divisions,
// which cost a lot per pixel on the GPU. Same results as the divisions.
const uint kPageWShift[8] = uint[8](6u, 6u, 6u, 6u, 6u, 6u, 7u, 7u);
const uint kPageHShift[8] = uint[8](5u, 5u, 6u, 6u, 6u, 6u, 6u, 7u);
const uint kPerBlockShift[8] = uint[8](6u, 6u, 7u, 7u, 7u, 7u, 8u, 9u);

uint pixelAddress(uint layoutIndex, uint block, uint bw, uint x, uint y)
{
    const uint wShift = kPageWShift[layoutIndex], hShift = kPageHShift[layoutIndex], bShift = kPerBlockShift[layoutIndex];
    const uint page = (block >> 5) + (y >> hShift) * ((bw << 6) >> wShift) + (x >> wShift);
    const uint inPage = ((y & ((1u << hShift) - 1u)) << wShift) + (x & ((1u << wShift) - 1u));
    return (page << (5u + bShift)) + ((block & 31u) << bShift) + tables[kTableOffset[layoutIndex] + inPage];
}

uint readVram(uint psm, uint block, uint bw, uint x, uint y)
{
    uint layoutIndex, unpackedBits, bitOffset, packedBytes;
    formatInfo(psm, layoutIndex, unpackedBits, bitOffset, packedBytes);
    const uint bits = pixelAddress(layoutIndex, block, bw, x, y) * unpackedBits + bitOffset;
    const uint byteAddr = (bits / 8u) & (kMemoryBytes - packedBytes);
    const uint shift = bits % 8u;
    const uint word = vram[byteAddr >> 2];
    const uint sub = (byteAddr & 3u) * 8u;
    uint v = packedBytes == 4u ? word : packedBytes == 2u ? (word >> sub) & 0xFFFFu : (word >> sub) & 0xFFu;
    if (psm == 0x01u || psm == 0x31u)
        return v & 0x00FFFFFFu;
    if (psm == 0x14u || psm == 0x24u || psm == 0x2Cu)
        return (v >> shift) & 0x0Fu;
    return v;
}

// Pixels of 8/16-bit formats share 32-bit words with pixels other invocations own:
// change only this pixel's bits, atomically.
void writeVram(uint psm, uint block, uint bw, uint x, uint y, uint value)
{
    uint layoutIndex, unpackedBits, bitOffset, packedBytes;
    formatInfo(psm, layoutIndex, unpackedBits, bitOffset, packedBytes);
    const uint bits = pixelAddress(layoutIndex, block, bw, x, y) * unpackedBits + bitOffset;
    const uint byteAddr = (bits / 8u) & (kMemoryBytes - packedBytes);
    const uint shift = bits % 8u;
    const uint index = byteAddr >> 2;
    const uint sub = (byteAddr & 3u) * 8u;
    if (psm == 0x01u || psm == 0x31u) // C24/Z24 keep the top byte
    {
        vram[index] = (vram[index] & 0xFF000000u) | (value & 0x00FFFFFFu);
        return;
    }
    if (packedBytes == 4u)
    {
        vram[index] = value;
        return;
    }
    uint mask, bitsValue;
    if (psm == 0x14u || psm == 0x24u || psm == 0x2Cu)
    {
        mask = 0x0Fu << (sub + shift);
        bitsValue = (value & 0x0Fu) << (sub + shift);
    }
    else
    {
        const uint width = packedBytes == 2u ? 0xFFFFu : 0xFFu;
        mask = width << sub;
        bitsValue = (value & width) << sub;
    }
    atomicAnd(vram[index], ~mask);
    atomicOr(vram[index], bitsValue);
}

// ---- texture -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// A CLUT word with bit 31 set is an entry only the GPU knows: bits 0-30 give the word
// offset of the version that holds its value (written by a kMode 4 pass).
uint clutEntry(uint index)
{
    const uint value = clut[index];
    return (value & 0x80000000u) != 0u ? clut[(value & 0x7FFFFFFFu) + index % 512u] : value;
}

uint applyTexa(uint texa, uint psm, uint texel)
{
    if (psm == 0x00u)
        return texel;
    const bool rgbZero = (texel & 0x00FFFFFFu) == 0u;
    uint a = texel >> 24;
    const uint ta0 = texa & 0xFFu, ta1 = (texa >> 16) & 0xFFu;
    const bool aem = ((texa >> 8) & 1u) != 0u;
    if (psm == 0x01u)
        a = (aem && rgbZero) ? 0u : ta0;
    else if (psm == 0x02u || psm == 0x0Au)
        a = (a & 0x80u) != 0u ? ta1 : ((aem && rgbZero) ? 0u : ta0);
    return (texel & 0x00FFFFFFu) | (a << 24);
}

uint rgba5551To8888(uint c)
{
    return (((c >> 0) & 0x1Fu) << 3) | ((((c >> 5) & 0x1Fu) << 3) << 8) | ((((c >> 10) & 0x1Fu) << 3) << 16) |
           ((((c >> 15) & 0x01u) << 7) << 24);
}

uint rgba8888To5551(uint c)
{
    return (((c >> 0) & 0xFFu) >> 3) | ((((c >> 8) & 0xFFu) >> 3) << 5) | ((((c >> 16) & 0xFFu) >> 3) << 10) |
           ((((c >> 24) & 0xFFu) >> 7) << 15);
}

bool isFourBit(uint psm) { return psm == 0x14u || psm == 0x24u || psm == 0x2Cu; }
bool isEightBit(uint psm) { return psm == 0x13u || psm == 0x1Bu; }

uint lookupClut(uint base, uint index, uint sourcePsm)
{
    const uint cpsm = rec[base + 20u], csm = rec[base + 21u], csa = rec[base + 22u], texa = rec[base + 28u];
    const bool sixteenBit = cpsm == 0x02u || cpsm == 0x0Au;
    const uint csaMask = sixteenBit ? 0x1Fu : 0x0Fu;
    const uint clutBase = (csa & csaMask) << 4u;
    const uint sourceIndex = isFourBit(sourcePsm) ? (index & 0x0Fu) : index;
    uint clutIndex = (clutBase + sourceIndex) & (sixteenBit ? 0x1FFu : 0x0FFu);
    if (!sixteenBit && csm == 0u && isEightBit(sourcePsm))
    {
        const uint blockIndex = min((sourceIndex & 0xF0u) + clutBase, 240u);
        clutIndex = blockIndex + (sourceIndex & 0x0Fu);
    }
    clutIndex += rec[base + 58u] * 512u; // CLUT version this primitive was queued with
    if (cpsm == 0x00u)
        return applyTexa(texa, cpsm, clutEntry(clutIndex) | (clutEntry(clutIndex + 256u) << 16));
    if (cpsm == 0x01u)
        return applyTexa(texa, cpsm, (clutEntry(clutIndex) | (clutEntry(clutIndex + 256u) << 16)) & 0x00FFFFFFu);
    if (sixteenBit)
        return applyTexa(texa, cpsm, rgba5551To8888(clutEntry(clutIndex)));
    return 0xFFFF00FFu;
}

uint fetchTexel(uint base, int u, int v)
{
    const uint psm = rec[base + 17u];
    const uint out_ = readVram(psm, rec[base + 15u], rec[base + 16u], uint(u), uint(v));
    switch (psm)
    {
    case 0x00u: case 0x30u: case 0x01u: case 0x31u: return applyTexa(rec[base + 28u], psm, out_);
    case 0x02u: case 0x0Au: case 0x32u: case 0x3Au: return applyTexa(rec[base + 28u], psm, rgba5551To8888(out_));
    case 0x13u: case 0x1Bu: case 0x14u: case 0x24u: case 0x2Cu: return lookupClut(base, out_ & 0xFFu, psm);
    default: return 0xFFFF00FFu;
    }
}

int wrapCoordinate(int coordinate, int size, uint mode, uint regionMin, uint regionMax)
{
    switch (mode & 3u)
    {
    case 0u: return int(uint(coordinate) & uint(size - 1));
    case 1u: return clamp(coordinate, 0, size - 1);
    case 2u: return min(max(coordinate, int(regionMin)), int(regionMax));
    default: return int((uint(coordinate) & regionMin) | regionMax);
    }
}

uint samplePoint(uint base, int u, int v)
{
    const int texW = int(rec[base + 23u]), texH = int(rec[base + 24u]);
    const uint wrap = rec[base + 25u], regionU = rec[base + 26u], regionV = rec[base + 27u];
    u = wrapCoordinate(u, texW, wrap & 3u, regionU & 0x3FFu, regionU >> 16);
    v = wrapCoordinate(v, texH, (wrap >> 2) & 3u, regionV & 0x3FFu, regionV >> 16);
    // Decoded by decodeMain from this same record (REGION_CLAMP may reach past tw/th).
    const uint cached = rec[base + 59u];
    if (cached != 0u && uint(u) < uint(texW) && uint(v) < uint(texH))
        return texCache[cached - 1u + uint(v) * uint(texW) + uint(u)];
    return fetchTexel(base, u, v);
}

uint lerpRgba(uint a, uint b, uint t)
{
    const uint inverse = 256u - t;
    const uint redBlue = (((a & 0x00FF00FFu) * inverse + (b & 0x00FF00FFu) * t) >> 8) & 0x00FF00FFu;
    const uint greenAlpha = (((a >> 8) & 0x00FF00FFu) * inverse + ((b >> 8) & 0x00FF00FFu) * t) & 0xFF00FF00u;
    return redBlue | greenAlpha;
}

// GSCpuBackend::SampleTexture; the reciprocal is refined to the correctly rounded
// value the CPU's 1.0f / q gives (GPU division may be off by an ulp).
uint sampleTexture(uint base, float s, float t, float q, uint u, uint v)
{
    const uint flags = rec[base + 5u];
    const float texW = float(rec[base + 23u]), texH = float(rec[base + 24u]);
    precise float texUf, texVf;
    if ((flags & 4u) != 0u)
    {
        texUf = float(u) * 0.0625;
        texVf = float(v) * 0.0625;
    }
    else
    {
        const float fq = abs(q) > 1.0e-8 ? q : 1.0;
        precise float invQ = 1.0 / fq;
        const precise float error = fma(-fq, invQ, 1.0);
        invQ = fma(invQ, error, invQ);
        texUf = s * invQ * texW;
        texVf = t * invQ * texH;
    }
    if ((flags & 64u) == 0u)
        return samplePoint(base, int(texUf), int(texVf));

    const precise float scaledU = (texUf - 0.5) * 256.0, scaledV = (texVf - 0.5) * 256.0;
    const int fixedU = int(floor(scaledU)), fixedV = int(floor(scaledV));
    const int u0 = fixedU >> 8, v0 = fixedV >> 8;
    const uint fx = uint(fixedU) & 0xFFu, fy = uint(fixedV) & 0xFFu;
    if (fx == 0u && fy == 0u)
        return samplePoint(base, u0, v0);
    const uint top = lerpRgba(samplePoint(base, u0, v0), samplePoint(base, u0 + 1, v0), fx);
    const uint bottom = lerpRgba(samplePoint(base, u0, v0 + 1), samplePoint(base, u0 + 1, v0 + 1), fx);
    return lerpRgba(top, bottom, fy);
}

uint clampU8(int v) { return uint(clamp(v, 0, 255)); }

uvec4 combineTexture(uint base, uvec4 shade, uint texel)
{
    const uint tcc = rec[base + 18u], tfx = rec[base + 19u];
    const int tr = int(texel & 0xFFu), tg = int((texel >> 8) & 0xFFu), tb = int((texel >> 16) & 0xFFu), ta = int(texel >> 24);
    const int vr = int(shade.r), vg = int(shade.g), vb = int(shade.b), va = int(shade.a);
    const bool hasAlpha = tcc != 0u;
    if (tfx == 0u)
        return uvec4(clampU8((tr * vr) >> 7), clampU8((tg * vg) >> 7), clampU8((tb * vb) >> 7),
                     hasAlpha ? clampU8((ta * va) >> 7) : uint(va));
    if (tfx == 2u)
        return uvec4(clampU8(((tr * vr) >> 7) + va), clampU8(((tg * vg) >> 7) + va), clampU8(((tb * vb) >> 7) + va),
                     hasAlpha ? clampU8(ta + va) : uint(va));
    if (tfx == 3u)
        return uvec4(clampU8(((tr * vr) >> 7) + va), clampU8(((tg * vg) >> 7) + va), clampU8(((tb * vb) >> 7) + va),
                     hasAlpha ? uint(ta) : uint(va));
    return uvec4(uint(tr), uint(tg), uint(tb), hasAlpha ? uint(ta) : uint(va));
}

// ---- pixel pipeline (GSCpuBackend::WritePixel) ---------------------------------------
bool passesAlphaTest(uint test, uint alpha)
{
    if ((test & 1u) == 0u)
        return true;
    const uint atst = (test >> 1) & 7u, aref = (test >> 4) & 0xFFu;
    switch (atst)
    {
    case 0u: return false;
    case 1u: return true;
    case 2u: return alpha < aref;
    case 3u: return alpha <= aref;
    case 4u: return alpha == aref;
    case 5u: return alpha >= aref;
    case 6u: return alpha > aref;
    default: return alpha != aref;
    }
}

int pickColor(uint sel, int cs, int cd) { return sel == 0u ? cs : sel == 1u ? cd : 0; }

void writePixel(uint base, int x, int y, uint z, uint r, uint g, uint b, uint a, uint fog)
{
    const uint flags = rec[base + 5u];
    if ((flags & 8u) != 0u) // fog
    {
        const uint fogColor = rec[base + 29u];
        const uint inverseFog = 255u - fog;
        r = ((fog * r) >> 8) + ((inverseFog * (fogColor & 0xFFu)) >> 8);
        g = ((fog * g) >> 8) + ((inverseFog * ((fogColor >> 8) & 0xFFu)) >> 8);
        b = ((fog * b) >> 8) + ((inverseFog * ((fogColor >> 16) & 0xFFu)) >> 8);
        r &= 0xFFu; g &= 0xFFu; b &= 0xFFu;
    }

    const uint fbBlock = rec[base + 6u], fbw = rec[base + 7u], fpsm = rec[base + 8u], fbmsk = rec[base + 9u];
    const uint zBlock = rec[base + 10u], zpsm = rec[base + 11u], test = rec[base + 12u];

    bool writeRgb = true, writeAlpha = true, writeDepth = true;
    if (!passesAlphaTest(test, a))
    {
        switch ((test >> 12) & 3u)
        {
        case 1u: writeDepth = false; break;
        case 2u: writeRgb = false; writeAlpha = false; break;
        case 3u: writeDepth = false; writeAlpha = fpsm != 0x00u; break;
        default: writeRgb = false; writeAlpha = false; writeDepth = false; break;
        }
    }
    if (!writeRgb && !writeAlpha && !writeDepth)
        return;

    const bool writesFramebuffer = writeRgb || writeAlpha;
    const bool abe = (flags & 16u) != 0u;
    const bool preserveDestinationAlpha = writeRgb && !writeAlpha && fpsm == 0x00u;
    const bool date = ((test >> 14) & 1u) != 0u;
    const bool dateNeedsRead = date && (fpsm == 0x00u || fpsm == 0x02u || fpsm == 0x0Au);
    const bool frmw = dateNeedsRead || (writesFramebuffer && (fbmsk != 0u || abe || preserveDestinationAlpha));

    uint rawFramebuffer = 0u, fbrgba = 0u;
    if (frmw)
    {
        rawFramebuffer = readVram(fpsm, fbBlock, fbw, uint(x), uint(y));
        fbrgba = rawFramebuffer;
        if (fpsm == 0x02u || fpsm == 0x0Au || fpsm == 0x32u || fpsm == 0x3Au)
            fbrgba = rgba5551To8888(fbrgba);
        else if (fpsm == 0x01u)
            fbrgba |= 0x80000000u;
    }
    if (date)
    {
        const bool datm = ((test >> 15) & 1u) != 0u;
        if (fpsm == 0x00u && (((rawFramebuffer >> 31) & 1u) != 0u) != datm)
            return;
        if ((fpsm == 0x02u || fpsm == 0x0Au) && (((rawFramebuffer >> 15) & 1u) != 0u) != datm)
            return;
    }

    const uint ztest = (test >> 17) & 3u;
    if (ztest == 0u)
        return;
    if (ztest >= 2u)
    {
        const uint storedZ = readVram(zpsm, zBlock, fbw, uint(x), uint(y));
        if (ztest == 2u ? z < storedZ : z <= storedZ)
            return;
    }

    if (writesFramebuffer)
    {
        if (abe)
        {
            const bool pabe = (flags & 32u) != 0u;
            if (!(pabe && (a & 0x80u) == 0u))
            {
                const uint mode = rec[base + 13u];
                const uint asel = mode & 3u, bsel = (mode >> 2) & 3u, csel = (mode >> 4) & 3u, dsel = (mode >> 6) & 3u;
                const int dr = int(fbrgba & 0xFFu), dg = int((fbrgba >> 8) & 0xFFu), db = int((fbrgba >> 16) & 0xFFu);
                const int da = int(fbrgba >> 24);
                const int cAlpha = csel == 0u ? int(a) : csel == 1u ? da : int(rec[base + 14u]);
                const int sr = int(r), sg = int(g), sb = int(b);
                r = clampU8((((pickColor(asel, sr, dr) - pickColor(bsel, sr, dr)) * cAlpha) >> 7) + pickColor(dsel, sr, dr));
                g = clampU8((((pickColor(asel, sg, dg) - pickColor(bsel, sg, dg)) * cAlpha) >> 7) + pickColor(dsel, sg, dg));
                b = clampU8((((pickColor(asel, sb, db) - pickColor(bsel, sb, db)) * cAlpha) >> 7) + pickColor(dsel, sb, db));
            }
        }
        if (writeAlpha && (flags & 256u) != 0u && fpsm != 0x01u) // FBA
            a |= 0x80u;
        uint pixel = r | (g << 8) | (b << 16) | ((a & 0xFFu) << 24);
        if (fbmsk != 0u)
            pixel = (pixel & ~fbmsk) | (fbrgba & fbmsk);
        if (preserveDestinationAlpha)
            pixel = (pixel & 0x00FFFFFFu) | (fbrgba & 0xFF000000u);
        if (fpsm == 0x02u || fpsm == 0x0Au || fpsm == 0x32u || fpsm == 0x3Au)
            pixel = rgba8888To5551(pixel);
        writeVram(fpsm, fbBlock, fbw, uint(x), uint(y), pixel);
    }

    if (writeDepth && (flags & 128u) == 0u)
        writeVram(zpsm, zBlock, fbw, uint(x), uint(y), z);
}

// ---- primitives ----------------------------------------------------------------------
float recFloat(uint base, uint i) { return uintBitsToFloat(rec[base + i]); }
double recDouble(uint base, uint i) { return packDouble2x32(uvec2(rec[base + i], rec[base + i + 1u])); }

// The coverage half of drawTrianglePixel (same operations): the rasterizer path tests it
// before the interlock, so fragments outside the triangle never wait for their pixel.
bool triangleCovers(uint base, int x, int y)
{
    const int minX = int(rec[base + 1u]), maxX = int(rec[base + 2u]);
    const float fx2 = recFloat(base, 30u), fy2 = recFloat(base, 31u);
    const float w0StepX = recFloat(base, 32u), w0StepY = recFloat(base, 33u);
    const float w1StepX = recFloat(base, 34u), w1StepY = recFloat(base, 35u);

    const precise float rowDy = float(y) + 0.5 - fy2;
    const precise float rowDx = float(minX) + 0.5 - fx2;
    const precise float w0Row = w0StepX * rowDx + w0StepY * rowDy;
    const precise float w1Row = w1StepX * rowDx + w1StepY * rowDy;

    // Same span window as the CPU (two columns of slack; the edge test below decides).
    precise float firstColumn = 0.0, lastColumn = float(maxX - minX);
    const precise float w2Row = 1.0 - w0Row - w1Row;
    const precise float w2Step = -w0StepX - w1StepX;
    const float edgeRow[3] = float[3](w0Row, w1Row, w2Row);
    const float edgeStep[3] = float[3](w0StepX, w1StepX, w2Step);
    for (int edge = 0; edge < 3; ++edge)
    {
        if (abs(edgeStep[edge]) < 1.0e-3)
            continue;
        const precise float crossing = (-kEdgeEpsilon - edgeRow[edge]) / edgeStep[edge];
        if (edgeStep[edge] > 0.0)
            firstColumn = max(firstColumn, crossing - 2.0);
        else
            lastColumn = min(lastColumn, crossing + 2.0);
    }
    if (firstColumn > lastColumn)
        return false;
    if (x < minX + int(firstColumn) || x > minX + int(lastColumn))
        return false;

    const precise float column = float(x - minX);
    const precise float w0 = w0Row + w0StepX * column;
    const precise float w1 = w1Row + w1StepX * column;
    const precise float w2 = 1.0 - w0 - w1;
    if (w0 < -kEdgeEpsilon || w1 < -kEdgeEpsilon || w2 < -kEdgeEpsilon)
        return false;
    return true;
}

void drawTrianglePixel(uint base, int x, int y)
{
    const int minX = int(rec[base + 1u]), maxX = int(rec[base + 2u]);
    const float fx2 = recFloat(base, 30u), fy2 = recFloat(base, 31u);
    const float w0StepX = recFloat(base, 32u), w0StepY = recFloat(base, 33u);
    const float w1StepX = recFloat(base, 34u), w1StepY = recFloat(base, 35u);

    const precise float rowDy = float(y) + 0.5 - fy2;
    const precise float rowDx = float(minX) + 0.5 - fx2;
    const precise float w0Row = w0StepX * rowDx + w0StepY * rowDy;
    const precise float w1Row = w1StepX * rowDx + w1StepY * rowDy;

    // Same span window as the CPU (two columns of slack; the edge test below decides).
    precise float firstColumn = 0.0, lastColumn = float(maxX - minX);
    const precise float w2Row = 1.0 - w0Row - w1Row;
    const precise float w2Step = -w0StepX - w1StepX;
    const float edgeRow[3] = float[3](w0Row, w1Row, w2Row);
    const float edgeStep[3] = float[3](w0StepX, w1StepX, w2Step);
    for (int edge = 0; edge < 3; ++edge)
    {
        if (abs(edgeStep[edge]) < 1.0e-3)
            continue;
        const precise float crossing = (-kEdgeEpsilon - edgeRow[edge]) / edgeStep[edge];
        if (edgeStep[edge] > 0.0)
            firstColumn = max(firstColumn, crossing - 2.0);
        else
            lastColumn = min(lastColumn, crossing + 2.0);
    }
    if (firstColumn > lastColumn)
        return;
    if (x < minX + int(firstColumn) || x > minX + int(lastColumn))
        return;

    const precise float column = float(x - minX);
    const precise float w0 = w0Row + w0StepX * column;
    const precise float w1 = w1Row + w1StepX * column;
    const precise float w2 = 1.0 - w0 - w1;
    if (w0 < -kEdgeEpsilon || w1 < -kEdgeEpsilon || w2 < -kEdgeEpsilon)
        return;

    const precise double z = recDouble(base, 52u) * double(w0) + recDouble(base, 54u) * double(w1) + recDouble(base, 56u) * double(w2);

    const uint flags = rec[base + 5u];
    const uint c0 = rec[base + 36u], c1 = rec[base + 37u], c2 = rec[base + 38u];
    uvec4 color;
    if ((flags & 1u) != 0u)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
        {
            const uint s = uint(i) * 8u;
            const precise float value = float((c0 >> s) & 0xFFu) * w0 + float((c1 >> s) & 0xFFu) * w1 + float((c2 >> s) & 0xFFu) * w2;
            color[i] = clampU8(int(value + 0.5)); // rounded: 0x80 at every vertex must stay 0x80 (alpha test GEQUAL 0x80)
        }
    }
    else
    {
        color = uvec4(c2 & 0xFFu, (c2 >> 8) & 0xFFu, (c2 >> 16) & 0xFFu, c2 >> 24);
    }

    if ((flags & 2u) != 0u)
    {
        uint texel;
        if ((flags & 4u) != 0u)
        {
            const uint uv0 = rec[base + 39u], uv1 = rec[base + 40u], uv2 = rec[base + 41u];
            const precise float fu = float(uv0 & 0xFFFFu) * w0 + float(uv1 & 0xFFFFu) * w1 + float(uv2 & 0xFFFFu) * w2;
            const precise float fv = float(uv0 >> 16) * w0 + float(uv1 >> 16) * w1 + float(uv2 >> 16) * w2;
            texel = sampleTexture(base, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, uint(int(fu)) & 0xFFFFu, uint(int(fv)) & 0xFFFFu);
        }
        else
        {
            const precise float s = recFloat(base, 42u) * w0 + recFloat(base, 45u) * w1 + recFloat(base, 48u) * w2;
            const precise float t = recFloat(base, 43u) * w0 + recFloat(base, 46u) * w1 + recFloat(base, 49u) * w2;
            const precise float q = recFloat(base, 44u) * w0 + recFloat(base, 47u) * w1 + recFloat(base, 50u) * w2;
            texel = sampleTexture(base, s, t, q, 0u, 0u);
        }
        color = combineTexture(base, color, texel);
    }

    uint fog = 0u;
    if ((flags & 8u) != 0u)
    {
        const uint f = rec[base + 51u];
        const precise float value = float(f & 0xFFu) * w0 + float((f >> 8) & 0xFFu) * w1 + float((f >> 16) & 0xFFu) * w2;
        fog = clampU8(int(value));
    }
    writePixel(base, x, y, uint(z + 0.5lf), color.r, color.g, color.b, color.a, fog);
}

void drawSpritePixel(uint base, int x, int y)
{
    const uint flags = rec[base + 5u];
    const uint c = rec[base + 30u];
    uvec4 color = uvec4(c & 0xFFu, (c >> 8) & 0xFFu, (c >> 16) & 0xFFu, c >> 24);
    if ((flags & 2u) != 0u)
    {
        const uint column = rec[base + 35u] + uint(x - int(rec[base + 1u]));
        const uint row = rec[base + 36u] + uint(y - int(rec[base + 3u]));
        uint texel;
        if ((flags & 4u) != 0u)
            texel = sampleTexture(base, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, uvTable[column], uvTable[row]);
        else
            texel = sampleTexture(base, uintBitsToFloat(uvTable[column]), uintBitsToFloat(uvTable[row]), 1.0, 0u, 0u);
        color = combineTexture(base, color, texel);
    }
    writePixel(base, x, y, rec[base + 31u], color.r, color.g, color.b, color.a, rec[base + 32u]);
}

#ifndef GS_RASTER
// One pixel of a host-to-local transfer per invocation, laid out like
// GSCpuBackend::UploadImageLocked (4-bit formats: low nibble first).
// CLUT version in queue order (kMode 4, one group): version srcBlock (word offset) is
// copied, resolved, into version srcWidth. Then, when srcPsm (entry count) is set,
// entries srcX.. load from local memory as
// GSCpuBackend::LoadClutUnlocked does (srcY: destination base, bit 16 = CSM1 32-bit
// suffix load; source upBlock/upWidth/upPsm, upX = CSM, upY = COU, upRowWidth = COV).
void clutMain()
{
    const uint lane = gl_LocalInvocationIndex;
    for (uint i = lane; i < 512u; i += kGroupSize)
        clut[pc.srcWidth + i] = clutEntry(pc.srcBlock + i);
    if (pc.srcPsm == 0u)
        return;
    memoryBarrierBuffer();
    barrier();
    const bool sixteenBit = pc.upPsm == 0x02u || pc.upPsm == 0x0Au;
    const bool suffix = (pc.srcY >> 16) != 0u;
    const uint destinationBase = pc.srcY & 0xFFFFu;
    for (uint entry = pc.srcX + lane; entry < pc.srcPsm; entry += kGroupSize)
    {
        uint sourceX, sourceY;
        if (pc.upX == 0u)
        {
            const uint sourceIndex = (entry & ~0x18u) | ((entry & 0x08u) << 1) | ((entry & 0x10u) >> 1);
            sourceX = sourceIndex & 0x0Fu;
            sourceY = sourceIndex >> 4;
        }
        else
        {
            sourceX = (pc.upY << 4) + entry;
            sourceY = pc.upRowWidth;
        }
        const uint raw = readVram(pc.upPsm, pc.upBlock, pc.upWidth, sourceX, sourceY);
        const uint destination = (suffix ? entry : destinationBase + entry) & (sixteenBit ? 0x1FFu : 0x0FFu);
        clut[pc.srcWidth + destination] = raw & 0xFFFFu;
        if (!sixteenBit)
            clut[pc.srcWidth + destination + 256u] = raw >> 16;
    }
}

void uploadMain()
{
    const uint i = gl_WorkGroupID.x * kGroupSize + gl_LocalInvocationIndex;
    if (i >= pc.upCount)
        return;
    const uint psm = pc.upPsm;
    const uint pixel = pc.upFirstPixel + i;
    const uint x = pc.upX + pixel % pc.upRowWidth, y = pc.upY + pixel / pc.upRowWidth;
    const uint bytesPerPixel = (psm == 0x00u || psm == 0x30u) ? 4u : (psm == 0x01u || psm == 0x31u) ? 3u
                             : (psm == 0x13u || psm == 0x1Bu) ? 1u : (psm == 0x14u || psm == 0x24u || psm == 0x2Cu) ? 0u : 2u;
    const uint base = pc.upData * 4u;
    uint value = 0u;
    if (bytesPerPixel == 0u)
    {
        const uint byteAt = base + i / 2u;
        value = ((uvTable[byteAt >> 2] >> ((byteAt & 3u) * 8u)) >> ((i & 1u) * 4u)) & 0x0Fu;
    }
    else
    {
        for (uint b = 0u; b < bytesPerPixel; ++b)
        {
            const uint byteAt = base + i * bytesPerPixel + b;
            value |= ((uvTable[byteAt >> 2] >> ((byteAt & 3u) * 8u)) & 0xFFu) << (b * 8u);
        }
    }
    writeVram(psm, pc.upBlock, pc.upWidth, x, y, value);
}

// One pixel of a local-to-local transfer per invocation, like
// GSCpuBackend::PerformLocalToLocalTransfer. Only used when source and destination
// don't overlap, so the order between pixels doesn't matter.
void copyMain()
{
    const uint i = gl_WorkGroupID.x * kGroupSize + gl_LocalInvocationIndex;
    if (i >= pc.upCount)
        return;
    const uint rows = pc.upCount / pc.upRowWidth;
    uint x = i % pc.upRowWidth, y = i / pc.upRowWidth;
    if ((pc.upData & 2u) != 0u)
        x = pc.upRowWidth - x - 1u;
    if ((pc.upData & 1u) != 0u)
        y = rows - y - 1u;
    const uint value = readVram(pc.srcPsm, pc.srcBlock, pc.srcWidth, pc.srcX + x, pc.srcY + y);
    writeVram(pc.upPsm, pc.upBlock, pc.upWidth, pc.upX + x, pc.upY + y, value);
}

// One texel of the primitive at pc.recordBase per invocation: what fetchTexel returns,
// stored row by row at texCache[pc.upFirstPixel].
void decodeMain()
{
    const uint i = gl_WorkGroupID.x * kGroupSize + gl_LocalInvocationIndex;
    if (i >= pc.upCount)
        return;
    const uint base = pc.recordBase * kRecordWords, texW = rec[base + 23u];
    texCache[pc.upFirstPixel + i] = fetchTexel(base, int(i % texW), int(i / texW));
}


shared uint sBase[kGroupSize];
shared ivec4 sBox[kGroupSize];

void main()
{
    if (kMode == 4u)
    {
        clutMain();
        return;
    }
    if (kMode == 3u)
    {
        decodeMain();
        return;
    }
    if (kMode == 1u)
    {
        uploadMain();
        return;
    }
    if (kMode == 2u)
    {
        copyMain();
        return;
    }
    const uint header = pc.tileBase + gl_WorkGroupID.x * 4u;
    const int x = int(tiles[header] * kTileSize + gl_LocalInvocationID.x);
    const int y = int(tiles[header + 1u] * kTileSize + gl_LocalInvocationID.y);
    const uint first = tiles[header + 2u], count = tiles[header + 3u];
    // Each invocation fetches one list entry's bounds into shared memory: the serial
    // index -> record loads per entry were latency-bound (few warps fit this shader).
    const uint lane = gl_LocalInvocationIndex;
    for (uint chunk = 0u; chunk < count; chunk += kGroupSize)
    {
        if (chunk + lane < count)
        {
            const uint base = (pc.recordBase + tiles[first + chunk + lane]) * kRecordWords;
            sBase[lane] = base | (rec[base] != 0u ? 1u : 0u); // records are 64-word aligned
            sBox[lane] = ivec4(rec[base + 1u], rec[base + 2u], rec[base + 3u], rec[base + 4u]);
        }
        barrier();
        const uint n = min(kGroupSize, count - chunk);
        for (uint i = 0u; i < n; ++i)
        {
            const ivec4 box = sBox[i];
            if (x < box.x || x > box.y || y < box.z || y > box.w)
                continue;
            const uint base = sBase[i] & ~1u;
            if ((sBase[i] & 1u) == 0u)
                drawTrianglePixel(base, x, y);
            else
                drawSpritePixel(base, x, y);
        }
        barrier();
    }
}
#else
// Rasterizer path (PS2X_GS_RASTER): gs_raster.vert draws each record's triangle (or the
// sprite rectangle) with conservative rasterization; every fragment runs the same pixel
// code as a tile invocation, and the ordered pixel interlock keeps GS primitive order per
// pixel. Coverage stays the edge test in drawTrianglePixel.
layout(pixel_interlock_ordered) in;
layout(location = 0) flat in uint vRecord;

void main()
{
    const int x = int(gl_FragCoord.x), y = int(gl_FragCoord.y);
    const uint base = vRecord * kRecordWords;
    const bool inBox = x >= int(rec[base + 1u]) && x <= int(rec[base + 2u]) && y >= int(rec[base + 3u]) && y <= int(rec[base + 4u]);
    const bool triangle = rec[base] == 0u;
    if (!inBox || (triangle && !triangleCovers(base, x, y)))
        discard;
    beginInvocationInterlockARB();
    if (triangle)
        drawTrianglePixel(base, x, y);
    else
        drawSpritePixel(base, x, y);
    endInvocationInterlockARB();
}
#endif

```

`patches/iop_jit.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "iop_jit.h"

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>

#if defined(__x86_64__) && !defined(_WIN32)
#include <sys/mman.h>
#define PS2X_IOP_JIT_SUPPORTED 1
#else
#define PS2X_IOP_JIT_SUPPORTED 0
#endif

namespace ps2x::iop::detail
{
    namespace
    {
        constexpr size_t kArenaSize = 8u * 1024u * 1024u;
        constexpr uint32_t kMaxBlockInstructions = 64u;
        constexpr uint32_t kRamSize = IopMemory::RamSize;

        uint32_t gprOffset(uint32_t reg) { return static_cast<uint32_t>(offsetof(IopCpuState, gpr) + reg * 4u); }
        const uint32_t kHi = offsetof(IopCpuState, hi);
        const uint32_t kLo = offsetof(IopCpuState, lo);
        const uint32_t kPc = offsetof(IopCpuState, pc);
        const uint32_t kPendingReg = offsetof(IopCpuState, pendingLoadReg);
        const uint32_t kPendingValue = offsetof(IopCpuState, pendingLoadValue);
        const uint32_t kPendingLoad = offsetof(IopCpuState, pendingLoad);
        const uint32_t kBranchPending = offsetof(IopCpuState, branchPending);
        const uint32_t kBranchTarget = offsetof(IopCpuState, branchTarget);

        // Registers: rdi = IopCpuState*, rsi = RAM, rdx = written-byte map; eax, ecx, r8d, r9d scratch.
        struct Assembler
        {
            std::vector<uint8_t> b;
            void u8(uint8_t v) { b.push_back(v); }
            void u32(uint32_t v)
            {
                for (int s = 0; s < 32; s += 8)
                    u8(static_cast<uint8_t>(v >> s));
            }
            void bytes(std::initializer_list<uint8_t> list) { b.insert(b.end(), list); }
            // mov reg32, [rdi + off] / mov [rdi + off], reg32 (reg 0..15)
            void load(uint8_t reg, uint32_t off)
            {
                if (reg >= 8u)
                    u8(0x44);
                u8(0x8B);
                u8(static_cast<uint8_t>(0x80u | ((reg & 7u) << 3) | 7u));
                u32(off);
            }
            void store(uint32_t off, uint8_t reg)
            {
                if (reg >= 8u)
                    u8(0x44);
                u8(0x89);
                u8(static_cast<uint8_t>(0x80u | ((reg & 7u) << 3) | 7u));
                u32(off);
            }
            void storeImm(uint32_t off, uint32_t imm) { bytes({0xC7, 0x87}); u32(off); u32(imm); }
            void storeImm8(uint32_t off, uint8_t imm) { bytes({0xC6, 0x87}); u32(off); u8(imm); }
            void addMemImm(uint32_t off, uint32_t imm) { bytes({0x81, 0x87}); u32(off); u32(imm); }
            void movEaxImm(uint32_t imm) { u8(0xB8); u32(imm); }
            // Jcc rel32; returns the offset of the displacement to patch.
            size_t jcc(uint8_t cc)
            {
                bytes({0x0F, cc});
                const size_t at = b.size();
                u32(0);
                return at;
            }
            void patch(size_t at, size_t target)
            {
                const int32_t rel = static_cast<int32_t>(target - (at + 4u));
                std::memcpy(b.data() + at, &rel, 4);
            }
        };

        enum class Kind
        {
            None,
            Alu,
            Load,
            Store,
            Branch
        };

        Kind classify(uint32_t w)
        {
            const uint32_t op = w >> 26u, funct = w & 63u;
            if (op == 0x00)
            {
                switch (funct)
                {
                case 0x00: case 0x02: case 0x03: case 0x04: case 0x06: case 0x07:
                case 0x10: case 0x12: case 0x21: case 0x23: case 0x24: case 0x25:
                case 0x26: case 0x27: case 0x2A: case 0x2B:
                    return Kind::Alu;
                case 0x08: case 0x09:
                    return Kind::Branch;
                default:
                    return Kind::None;
                }
            }
            if (op == 0x01)
            {
                const uint32_t rt = (w >> 16u) & 31u;
                return rt == 0x00 || rt == 0x01 || rt == 0x10 || rt == 0x11 ? Kind::Branch : Kind::None;
            }
            switch (op)
            {
            case 0x02: case 0x03: case 0x04: case 0x05: case 0x06: case 0x07:
                return Kind::Branch;
            case 0x09: case 0x0A: case 0x0B: case 0x0C: case 0x0D: case 0x0E: case 0x0F:
                return Kind::Alu;
            case 0x20: case 0x21: case 0x23: case 0x24: case 0x25:
                return Kind::Load;
            case 0x28: case 0x29: case 0x2B:
                return Kind::Store;
            default:
                return Kind::None;
            }
        }
    }

    IopJit::IopJit(IopMemory &memory) : m_memory(memory)
    {
#if PS2X_IOP_JIT_SUPPORTED
        const char *setting = std::getenv("PS2X_IOP_JIT");
        if (setting != nullptr && setting[0] == '0')
            return;
        void *arena = mmap(nullptr, kArenaSize, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE | PROT_EXEC, MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0);
        if (arena == MAP_FAILED)
            return;
        m_arena = static_cast<uint8_t *>(arena);
        m_enabled = true;
#endif
    }

    IopJit::~IopJit()
    {
#if PS2X_IOP_JIT_SUPPORTED
        if (m_arena != nullptr)
            munmap(m_arena, kArenaSize);
#endif
    }

    void IopJit::clear()
    {
        m_blocks.clear();
        m_arenaUsed = 0;
    }

    IopJit::Block IopJit::compile(uint32_t phys)
    {
        Block block;
        const uint8_t *ram = m_memory.ramData();
        uint32_t count = 0;
        bool endsInBranch = false;
        while (count < kMaxBlockInstructions && phys + (count + 1u) * 4u <= kRamSize)
        {
            uint32_t w;
            std::memcpy(&w, ram + phys + count * 4u, 4);
            const Kind kind = classify(w);
            if (kind == Kind::None)
                break;
            if (kind == Kind::Branch)
            {
                // The branch and its delay slot end the block. An import stub (jr ra with
                // addiu zero in the slot) belongs to the interpreter's import dispatch.
                uint32_t slot = 0;
                if (count + 1u >= kMaxBlockInstructions || phys + (count + 2u) * 4u > kRamSize)
                    break;
                std::memcpy(&slot, ram + phys + (count + 1u) * 4u, 4);
                const Kind slotKind = classify(slot);
                if (slotKind == Kind::None || slotKind == Kind::Branch ||
                    (w == 0x03E00008u && (slot & 0xFFFF0000u) == 0x24000000u))
                    break;
                block.words.push_back(w);
                block.words.push_back(slot);
                count += 2u;
                endsInBranch = true;
                break;
            }
            block.words.push_back(w);
            ++count;
        }
        if (count < 2u) // one instruction: the interpreter is as fast. Keep the two words the
        {               // decision rests on, so reloaded code there gets looked at again.
            block.words.resize(2);
            std::memcpy(block.words.data(), ram + phys, 8);
            block.length = count;
            return block;
        }

        Assembler a;
        std::vector<uint32_t> pendingAtStart(count); // load still in its delay slot when instruction i starts
        std::vector<std::pair<size_t, uint32_t>> bails;   // jcc to patch, instruction index
        uint32_t pending = 0;
        auto commitPending = [&](uint32_t writtenReg)
        {
            if (pending != 0u && pending != writtenReg)
            {
                a.load(9, kPendingValue);
                a.store(gprOffset(pending), 9);
            }
        };
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
        {
            pendingAtStart[i] = pending;
            const uint32_t w = block.words[i];
            const uint32_t op = w >> 26u, rs = (w >> 21u) & 31u, rt = (w >> 16u) & 31u, rd = (w >> 11u) & 31u;
            const uint32_t sa = (w >> 6u) & 31u, funct = w & 63u, imm = w & 0xFFFFu;
            const uint32_t simm = static_cast<uint32_t>(static_cast<int32_t>(static_cast<int16_t>(imm)));
            const Kind kind = classify(w);
            if (kind == Kind::Branch)
            {
                // Link first: the interpreter writes ra (or rd) before it reads the condition
                // or the jump register. pc in memory is still the block's entry pc here.
                uint32_t link = 0;
                if (op == 0x03 || (op == 0x01 && (rt == 0x10 || rt == 0x11)))
                    link = 31u;
                else if (op == 0x00 && funct == 0x09)
                    link = rd != 0u ? rd : 31u;
                if (link != 0u)
                {
                    a.load(0, kPc);
                    a.u8(0x05);
                    a.u32(i * 4u + 8u);
                    a.store(gprOffset(link), 0);
                }
                if (op == 0x00) // jr / jalr: always taken, target from rs
                {
                    a.load(0, gprOffset(rs));
                    a.storeImm8(kBranchPending, 1u);
                    a.store(kBranchTarget, 0);
                }
                else if (op == 0x02 || op == 0x03) // j / jal
                {
                    a.load(0, kPc);
                    a.u8(0x05);
                    a.u32((i + 1u) * 4u);
                    a.u8(0x25);
                    a.u32(0xF0000000u);
                    a.u8(0x0D);
                    a.u32((w & 0x03FFFFFFu) << 2u);
                    a.storeImm8(kBranchPending, 1u);
                    a.store(kBranchTarget, 0);
                }
                else // conditional: branchPending = taken, branchTarget = taken ? target : 0
                {
                    a.load(0, kPc);
                    a.u8(0x05);
                    a.u32((i + 1u) * 4u + (simm << 2u));
                    a.load(8, gprOffset(rs));
                    uint8_t setcc;
                    if (op == 0x04 || op == 0x05)
                    {
                        a.load(9, gprOffset(rt));
                        a.bytes({0x45, 0x39, 0xC8}); // cmp r8d, r9d
                        setcc = op == 0x04 ? 0x94 : 0x95; // sete / setne
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        a.bytes({0x41, 0x83, 0xF8, 0x00}); // cmp r8d, 0
                        if (op == 0x06)
                            setcc = 0x9E; // setle
                        else if (op == 0x07)
                            setcc = 0x9F; // setg
                        else
                            setcc = (rt & 1u) == 0u ? 0x9C : 0x9D; // bltz(al): setl, bgez(al): setge
                    }
                    a.bytes({0x0F, setcc, 0xC1, 0x0F, 0xB6, 0xC9}); // setcc cl; movzx ecx, cl
                    a.bytes({0x88, 0x8F});
                    a.u32(kBranchPending); // mov [rdi+branchPending], cl
                    a.bytes({0xF7, 0xD9, 0x21, 0xC8}); // neg ecx; and eax, ecx
                    a.store(kBranchTarget, 0);
                }
                commitPending(link);
                pending = 0;
                continue;
            }
            if (kind == Kind::Alu)
            {
                uint32_t dest = op == 0x00 ? rd : rt;
                if (op == 0x00)
                {
                    switch (funct)
                    {
                    case 0x00: a.load(0, gprOffset(rt)); a.bytes({0xC1, 0xE0, static_cast<uint8_t>(sa)}); break; // shl
                    case 0x02: a.load(0, gprOffset(rt)); a.bytes({0xC1, 0xE8, static_cast<uint8_t>(sa)}); break; // shr
                    case 0x03: a.load(0, gprOffset(rt)); a.bytes({0xC1, 0xF8, static_cast<uint8_t>(sa)}); break; // sar
                    case 0x04: a.load(0, gprOffset(rt)); a.load(1, gprOffset(rs)); a.bytes({0xD3, 0xE0}); break; // shl eax, cl
                    case 0x06: a.load(0, gprOffset(rt)); a.load(1, gprOffset(rs)); a.bytes({0xD3, 0xE8}); break;
                    case 0x07: a.load(0, gprOffset(rt)); a.load(1, gprOffset(rs)); a.bytes({0xD3, 0xF8}); break;
                    case 0x10: a.load(0, kHi); break;
                    case 0x12: a.load(0, kLo); break;
                    case 0x21: a.load(0, gprOffset(rs)); a.load(1, gprOffset(rt)); a.bytes({0x01, 0xC8}); break; // add
                    case 0x23: a.load(0, gprOffset(rs)); a.load(1, gprOffset(rt)); a.bytes({0x29, 0xC8}); break; // sub
                    case 0x24: a.load(0, gprOffset(rs)); a.load(1, gprOffset(rt)); a.bytes({0x21, 0xC8}); break; // and
                    case 0x25: a.load(0, gprOffset(rs)); a.load(1, gprOffset(rt)); a.bytes({0x09, 0xC8}); break; // or
                    case 0x26: a.load(0, gprOffset(rs)); a.load(1, gprOffset(rt)); a.bytes({0x31, 0xC8}); break; // xor
                    case 0x27: a.load(0, gprOffset(rs)); a.load(1, gprOffset(rt)); a.bytes({0x09, 0xC8, 0xF7, 0xD0}); break; // or; not
                    case 0x2A: a.load(0, gprOffset(rs)); a.load(1, gprOffset(rt)); a.bytes({0x39, 0xC8, 0x0F, 0x9C, 0xC0, 0x0F, 0xB6, 0xC0}); break; // setl
                    case 0x2B: a.load(0, gprOffset(rs)); a.load(1, gprOffset(rt)); a.bytes({0x39, 0xC8, 0x0F, 0x92, 0xC0, 0x0F, 0xB6, 0xC0}); break; // setb
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    switch (op)
                    {
                    case 0x09: a.load(0, gprOffset(rs)); a.u8(0x05); a.u32(simm); break; // addiu
                    case 0x0A: a.load(0, gprOffset(rs)); a.u8(0x3D); a.u32(simm); a.bytes({0x0F, 0x9C, 0xC0, 0x0F, 0xB6, 0xC0}); break; // slti
                    case 0x0B: a.load(0, gprOffset(rs)); a.u8(0x3D); a.u32(simm); a.bytes({0x0F, 0x92, 0xC0, 0x0F, 0xB6, 0xC0}); break; // sltiu
                    case 0x0C: a.load(0, gprOffset(rs)); a.u8(0x25); a.u32(imm); break;
                    case 0x0D: a.load(0, gprOffset(rs)); a.u8(0x0D); a.u32(imm); break;
                    case 0x0E: a.load(0, gprOffset(rs)); a.u8(0x35); a.u32(imm); break;
                    case 0x0F: a.movEaxImm(imm << 16u); break;
                    }
                }
                if (dest != 0u)
                    a.store(gprOffset(dest), 0);
                commitPending(dest);
                pending = 0;
                continue;
            }

            // Loads and stores: address, alignment and RAM checks first; failing one leaves the
            // block before this instruction (the interpreter raises the exception or goes to
            // hardware).
            const uint32_t size = (op == 0x20 || op == 0x24 || op == 0x28) ? 1u : (op == 0x21 || op == 0x25 || op == 0x29) ? 2u : 4u;
            a.load(0, gprOffset(rs));
            a.u8(0x05);
            a.u32(simm); // add eax, simm
            if (size > 1u)
            {
                a.bytes({0xA8, static_cast<uint8_t>(size - 1u)}); // test al, size-1
                bails.emplace_back(a.jcc(0x85), i);                // jnz
            }
            a.u8(0x25);
            a.u32(0x1FFFFFFFu); // and eax, physical mask
            a.u8(0x3D);
            a.u32(kRamSize - size); // cmp eax, last valid address
            bails.emplace_back(a.jcc(0x87), i); // ja
            if (kind == Kind::Load)
            {
                switch (op)
                {
                case 0x20: a.bytes({0x44, 0x0F, 0xBE, 0x04, 0x06}); break; // movsx r8d, byte [rsi+rax]
                case 0x24: a.bytes({0x44, 0x0F, 0xB6, 0x04, 0x06}); break; // movzx r8d, byte
                case 0x21: a.bytes({0x44, 0x0F, 0xBF, 0x04, 0x06}); break; // movsx r8d, word
                case 0x25: a.bytes({0x44, 0x0F, 0xB7, 0x04, 0x06}); break; // movzx r8d, word
                case 0x23: a.bytes({0x44, 0x8B, 0x04, 0x06}); break;       // mov r8d, dword
                }
                commitPending(0u); // a load writes no register now
                if (rt != 0u)
                    a.store(kPendingValue, 8);
                pending = rt;
                continue;
            }
            a.load(1, gprOffset(rt));
            switch (size)
            {
            case 1: a.bytes({0x88, 0x0C, 0x06, 0xC6, 0x04, 0x02, 0x01}); break;                         // mov [rsi+rax], cl; mov byte [rdx+rax], 1
            case 2: a.bytes({0x66, 0x89, 0x0C, 0x06, 0x66, 0xC7, 0x04, 0x02, 0x01, 0x01}); break;       // word
            default: a.bytes({0x89, 0x0C, 0x06, 0xC7, 0x04, 0x02, 0x01, 0x01, 0x01, 0x01}); break;     // dword
            }
            commitPending(0u);
            pending = 0;
        }
        auto leave = [&](uint32_t executed, uint32_t loadInDelaySlot)
        {
            a.addMemImm(kPc, executed * 4u);
            if (loadInDelaySlot != 0u)
            {
                a.storeImm(kPendingReg, loadInDelaySlot);
                a.storeImm8(kPendingLoad, 1u);
            }
            a.movEaxImm(executed);
            a.u8(0xC3);
        };
        if (endsInBranch)
        {
            // After the delay slot: pc = taken ? branchTarget : next; the branch is resolved.
            a.load(0, kPc);
            a.u8(0x05);
            a.u32(count * 4u);
            a.load(1, kBranchTarget);
            a.bytes({0x80, 0xBF});
            a.u32(kBranchPending);
            a.u8(0x00);                      // cmp byte [rdi+branchPending], 0
            a.bytes({0x0F, 0x45, 0xC1});     // cmovne eax, ecx
            a.store(kPc, 0);
            a.storeImm8(kBranchPending, 0u);
            if (pending != 0u)
            {
                a.storeImm(kPendingReg, pending);
                a.storeImm8(kPendingLoad, 1u);
            }
            a.movEaxImm(count);
            a.u8(0xC3);
        }
        else
            leave(count, pending);
        for (const auto &[at, index] : bails)
        {
            a.patch(at, a.b.size());
            leave(index, pendingAtStart[index]);
        }

        if (m_arenaUsed + a.b.size() > kArenaSize)
            clear();
        std::memcpy(m_arena + m_arenaUsed, a.b.data(), a.b.size());
        block.fn = reinterpret_cast<BlockFn>(m_arena + m_arenaUsed);
        m_arenaUsed += (a.b.size() + 15u) & ~size_t{15};
        block.length = count;
        return block;
    }

    uint32_t IopJit::run(IopCpuState &cpu, uint32_t maxInstructions)
    {
        if (!m_enabled || (cpu.pc & 3u) != 0u)
            return 0;
        const uint32_t phys = cpu.pc & 0x1FFFFFFFu;
        if (phys + 8u > kRamSize)
            return 0;
        uint8_t *ram = m_memory.ramData();
        auto found = m_blocks.find(phys);
        // Code can be reloaded (modules): a block runs only on the words it was built from.
        if (found == m_blocks.end() || std::memcmp(found->second.words.data(), ram + phys, found->second.words.size() * 4u) != 0)
        {
            const size_t arenaBefore = m_arenaUsed;
            Block block = compile(phys);
            if (m_arenaUsed < arenaBefore) // the arena was cleared: every older block is gone
                m_blocks.clear();
            found = m_blocks.insert_or_assign(phys, std::move(block)).first;
        }
        const Block &block = found->second;
        if (block.fn == nullptr || block.length > maxInstructions)
            return 0;
        return block.fn(&cpu, ram, m_memory.ownedData());
    }
}
```

`patches/iop_jit.h`:

```h
#pragma once

#include "iop_cpu.h"
#include "iop_memory.h"

#include <cstdint>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

namespace ps2x::iop::detail
{
    // x86-64 recompiler for straight runs of simple R3000 instructions (ALU, HI/LO reads,
    // loads and stores that hit RAM). Branches, jumps, COP0, MULT/DIV, overflow traps,
    // LWL/LWR/SWL/SWR and anything that touches hardware stay in the interpreter: a block
    // stops before them, and a load or store outside RAM or misaligned leaves the block
    // at that instruction with the state the interpreter would have there. The R3000 load
    // delay is resolved at compile time with the interpreter's own rule.
    //
    // The caller enters only where nothing can interrupt mid-block: no pending load, no
    // branch delay slot, no deliverable interrupt, no due DMA or guest callback. Then the
    // only things an instruction here changes are RAM and registers.
    //
    // PS2X_IOP_JIT=0 disables it.
    class IopJit
    {
    public:
        explicit IopJit(IopMemory &memory);
        ~IopJit();
        IopJit(const IopJit &) = delete;
        IopJit &operator=(const IopJit &) = delete;

        [[nodiscard]] bool enabled() const noexcept { return m_enabled; }
        // Runs one block at cpu.pc of at most maxInstructions; returns how many ran (0: none).
        uint32_t run(IopCpuState &cpu, uint32_t maxInstructions);

    private:
        using BlockFn = uint32_t (*)(IopCpuState *cpu, uint8_t *ram, uint8_t *owned);
        struct Block
        {
            BlockFn fn = nullptr; // null: no block starts here
            uint32_t length = 0;
            std::vector<uint32_t> words; // the code it was compiled from
        };

        Block compile(uint32_t phys);
        void clear();

        IopMemory &m_memory;
        bool m_enabled = false;
        uint8_t *m_arena = nullptr;
        size_t m_arenaUsed = 0;
        std::unordered_map<uint32_t, Block> m_blocks;
    };
}
```

`patches/ps2_log_stream_override.cpp`:

```cpp
// Replaces the weak ps2_log::log_stream() emitted by every generated function.
//
// The function tracker writes and flushes on each guest call, which dominates
// run time. Rebuilding 13,651 files to compile it out takes hours, so this
// strong definition sends it to a null stream unless PS2X_TRACE=1 is set.
// It must not include ps2_log.h, which defines the same function inline.
#include <cstdlib>
#include <fstream>
#include <ostream>

namespace ps2_log
{
    std::ostream &log_stream()
    {
        static std::ostream nullStream(nullptr);
        static std::ofstream traceFile;
        static const bool traceEnabled = []
        {
            const char *trace = std::getenv("PS2X_TRACE");
            if (trace == nullptr || trace[0] != '1')
            {
                return false;
            }
            traceFile.open("ps2_log.txt", std::ios::out);
            return traceFile.is_open();
        }();
        return traceEnabled ? static_cast<std::ostream &>(traceFile) : nullStream;
    }
}
```

`patches/ps2_perf.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "runtime/ps2_perf.h"

#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <fstream>
#include <set>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>
#if defined(__linux__)
#include <pthread.h>
#include <sched.h>
#endif

namespace ps2_perf
{
    Counters &counters()
    {
        static Counters instance;
        return instance;
    }

    bool enabled()
    {
        static const bool on = std::getenv("PS2X_PERF") != nullptr;
        return on;
    }

    uint64_t nowNs()
    {
        return static_cast<uint64_t>(std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(
                                         std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch())
                                         .count());
    }

    void startReporter()
    {
        static bool started = false;
        if (!enabled() || started)
            return;
        started = true;
        std::thread([]
                    {
            Counters &c = counters();
            uint64_t last = nowNs();
            for (;;)
            {
                std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::seconds(2));
                const uint64_t now = nowNs();
                const double seconds = static_cast<double>(now - last) / 1e9;
                last = now;
                std::fprintf(stderr,
                             "[perf] janela %.1f fps (imagens novas %.1f/s) | jogo %.1f quadros/s | vsync %.1f/s | GS ocupado %.0f%% | jogo esperando o GS %.0f%%\n",
                             c.windowFrames.exchange(0) / seconds, c.newImages.exchange(0) / seconds, c.gameFrames.exchange(0) / seconds,
                             c.vsyncs.exchange(0) / seconds, c.gsBusyNs.exchange(0) / (seconds * 1e7),
                             c.eeWaitingGsNs.exchange(0) / (seconds * 1e7));
            } })
            .detach();
    }

    void pinHeavyThread(HeavyThread role)
    {
#if defined(__linux__)
        static const std::vector<int> cores = []
        {
            std::vector<int> firstCpus; // first logical CPU of each physical core, in order
            const char *setting = std::getenv("PS2X_PIN");
            if (setting && setting[0] == '0')
                return firstCpus;
            std::set<std::string> seen;
            cpu_set_t allowed;
            if (sched_getaffinity(0, sizeof(allowed), &allowed) != 0)
                return firstCpus;
            for (int cpu = 0; cpu < CPU_SETSIZE; ++cpu)
            {
                if (!CPU_ISSET(cpu, &allowed))
                    continue;
                std::ifstream file("/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu" + std::to_string(cpu) + "/topology/thread_siblings_list");
                std::string siblings;
                if (!(file >> siblings))
                    return std::vector<int>{};
                if (seen.insert(siblings).second)
                    firstCpus.push_back(cpu);
            }
            if (firstCpus.size() < 4u)
                firstCpus.clear();
            return firstCpus;
        }();
        if (cores.empty())
            return;
        cpu_set_t set;
        CPU_ZERO(&set);
        CPU_SET(cores[static_cast<unsigned>(role) % cores.size()], &set);
        pthread_setaffinity_np(pthread_self(), sizeof(set), &set);
#else
        (void)role;
#endif
    }
}
```

`patches/ps2_perf.h`:

```h
#pragma once

#include <atomic>
#include <cstdint>

// PS2X_PERF=1 prints, every 2 s, how fast each part runs: window frames, game frames,
// vsyncs, how busy the GS was and how long the game waited for it. Counters are
// cheap atomics; the timed ones are only measured when the meter is on.
namespace ps2_perf
{
    struct Counters
    {
        std::atomic<uint64_t> windowFrames{0};
        std::atomic<uint64_t> newImages{0}; // window frames that show a newly completed game frame
        std::atomic<uint64_t> gameFrames{0};
        std::atomic<uint64_t> vsyncs{0};
        std::atomic<uint64_t> gsBusyNs{0};
        std::atomic<uint64_t> eeWaitingGsNs{0};
    };

    Counters &counters();
    bool enabled();
    uint64_t nowNs();
    // Starts the reporter thread once, if PS2X_PERF is set.
    void startReporter();

    // The four busy threads (game, VU1, GS frontend, GS worker) each on their own physical
    // core: two of them sharing a core's hyperthreads run ~40% slower (i7-7700HQ: 54 -> 59.5
    // frames/s in gameplay). No-op with fewer than 4 cores or PS2X_PIN=0.
    enum class HeavyThread : unsigned { Game = 0, Vu1 = 1, GsWorker = 2, GsFrontend = 3 };
    void pinHeavyThread(HeavyThread role);
}
```

`patches/ps2_sampling_profiler.cpp`:

```cpp
// Self-time sampling profiler for hosts without perf. PS2X_PROFILE=<seconds>
// waits that long, samples every 1 ms of CPU time for 20 s and writes the raw
// instruction pointers to ps2_profile.txt (resolved with nm by a script).
// PS2X_PROFILE_THREAD=<name> keeps only the samples of that thread (e.g. GameThread).
// Each sample line is "<rip> <[rsp]> <up to 4 stack words that point into the executable>":
// [rsp] is the caller when rip is in a leaf; the scan finds who called into libc (no unwinder needed).
#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <csignal>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <dirent.h>
#include <string>
#include <sys/syscall.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <thread>
#include <ucontext.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <vector>

extern "C" char __executable_start, etext;

namespace
{
    constexpr size_t kMaxSamples = 200000u;
    uintptr_t g_samples[kMaxSamples];
    uintptr_t g_stackTop[kMaxSamples]; // [rsp]: the caller of a leaf like memcpy
    constexpr size_t kScan = 4u;
    uintptr_t g_stackScan[kMaxSamples][kScan];
    std::atomic<size_t> g_count{0u};
    long g_onlyTid = 0;

    long findThread(const char *name)
    {
        DIR *tasks = opendir("/proc/self/task");
        long found = 0;
        unsigned long long bestCpu = 0;
        while (dirent *entry = tasks != nullptr ? readdir(tasks) : nullptr)
        {
            std::FILE *comm = std::fopen((std::string("/proc/self/task/") + entry->d_name + "/comm").c_str(), "r");
            if (comm == nullptr)
                continue;
            char line[64]{};
            if (std::fgets(line, sizeof(line), comm) != nullptr && std::string(line) == std::string(name) + "\n")
            {
                // Several threads can share a name (the presentation backend has its own idle
                // GSWorker): keep the busiest, by utime + stime from /proc/self/task/<tid>/stat.
                unsigned long long cpu = 0;
                if (std::FILE *stat = std::fopen((std::string("/proc/self/task/") + entry->d_name + "/stat").c_str(), "r"))
                {
                    char buffer[1024]{};
                    if (std::fgets(buffer, sizeof(buffer), stat) != nullptr)
                        if (const char *close = std::strrchr(buffer, ')'))
                        {
                            unsigned long long utime = 0, stime = 0;
                            if (std::sscanf(close + 2, "%*c %*d %*d %*d %*d %*d %*u %*u %*u %*u %*u %llu %llu", &utime, &stime) == 2)
                                cpu = utime + stime;
                        }
                    std::fclose(stat);
                }
                if (found == 0 || cpu > bestCpu)
                    found = std::atol(entry->d_name), bestCpu = cpu;
            }
            std::fclose(comm);
        }
        if (tasks != nullptr)
            closedir(tasks);
        return found;
    }

    void onProfileSignal(int, siginfo_t *, void *context)
    {
        if (g_onlyTid != 0 && syscall(SYS_gettid) != g_onlyTid)
            return;
        const size_t index = g_count.fetch_add(1u, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        if (index < kMaxSamples)
        {
            const auto &regs = static_cast<ucontext_t *>(context)->uc_mcontext.gregs;
            g_samples[index] = static_cast<uintptr_t>(regs[REG_RIP]);
            const auto *stack = reinterpret_cast<const uintptr_t *>(regs[REG_RSP]);
            g_stackTop[index] = stack[0];
            const auto low = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&__executable_start), high = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&etext);
            // shortcut: 64 words is always inside the mapped stack of our threads; stale words can show up as callers.
            for (size_t word = 0u, found = 0u; word < 64u && found < kScan; ++word)
                if (stack[word] >= low && stack[word] < high)
                    g_stackScan[index][found++] = stack[word];
        }
    }

    struct ProfilerStarter
    {
        ProfilerStarter()
        {
            const char *delay = std::getenv("PS2X_PROFILE");
            if (delay == nullptr)
            {
                return;
            }
            const int seconds = std::atoi(delay);
            std::thread([seconds]
                        {
                std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::seconds(seconds));
                if (const char *only = std::getenv("PS2X_PROFILE_THREAD"))
                    g_onlyTid = findThread(only);
                struct sigaction action{};
                action.sa_sigaction = onProfileSignal;
                action.sa_flags = SA_SIGINFO | SA_RESTART;
                sigaction(SIGPROF, &action, nullptr);
                // One thread: a timer on that thread's own CPU clock, signalling that thread.
                // ITIMER_PROF counts the whole process and lands on any thread, so with many
                // busy threads the chosen one almost never got a sample.
                timer_t threadTimer{};
                bool perThread = false;
                if (g_onlyTid != 0)
                {
                    const clockid_t clock = static_cast<clockid_t>((~static_cast<unsigned long>(g_onlyTid) << 3) | 6u); // CPUCLOCK_SCHED of a tid
                    sigevent event{};
                    event.sigev_notify = SIGEV_THREAD_ID;
                    event.sigev_signo = SIGPROF;
                    event._sigev_un._tid = static_cast<pid_t>(g_onlyTid);
                    perThread = timer_create(clock, &event, &threadTimer) == 0;
                    if (perThread)
                    {
                        itimerspec every{{0, 1000000}, {0, 1000000}};
                        timer_settime(threadTimer, 0, &every, nullptr);
                    }
                }
                if (!perThread)
                {
                    itimerval timer{{0, 1000}, {0, 1000}};
                    setitimer(ITIMER_PROF, &timer, nullptr);
                }
                std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::seconds(20));
                if (perThread)
                    timer_delete(threadTimer);
                itimerval stop{};
                setitimer(ITIMER_PROF, &stop, nullptr);
                std::FILE *out = std::fopen("ps2_profile.txt", "w");
                if (out == nullptr)
                {
                    return;
                }
                std::FILE *maps = std::fopen("/proc/self/maps", "r");
                char line[512];
                while (maps != nullptr && std::fgets(line, sizeof(line), maps) != nullptr)
                {
                    std::fprintf(out, "base %s", line);

                }
                const size_t total = std::min(g_count.load(), kMaxSamples);
                for (size_t i = 0u; i < total; ++i)
                {
                    std::fprintf(out, "%zx %zx %zx %zx %zx %zx\n", g_samples[i], g_stackTop[i], g_stackScan[i][0],
                                 g_stackScan[i][1], g_stackScan[i][2], g_stackScan[i][3]);
                }
                std::fclose(out); })
                .detach();
        }
    } g_profilerStarter;
}
```

`patches/ps2_spu2_stream.cpp`:

```cpp
// Plays what the IOP sends to the SPU2 by AutoDMA (CRI ADX music and voices) on the host,
// mixed with the SPU2 voices (sound effects, ps2xIOP spu2_voices.cpp). See notas/audio.md.
// PS2X_AUDIO=0 turns it off; PS2X_SPU2_DUMP=<file> also writes the mixed stream as raw
// 16-bit stereo 48 kHz PCM.
#include "ps2x/iop/spu2_stream.h"
#include "raylib.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <mutex>
#include <vector>

namespace
{
    constexpr uint32_t kRingFrames = 96000u;  // 2 s per core
    constexpr uint32_t kTargetFrames = 19200u; // 400 ms queued: absorbs the emulator's stalls
    // Time stretch (WSOLA): grains of kGrain frames, 50% overlap, each placed within
    // +-kSearch of its nominal position where it best continues the previous grain.
    constexpr uint32_t kGrain = 1024u, kHop = kGrain / 2u, kSearch = 128u;

    struct Ring
    {
        std::array<int16_t, kRingFrames * 2u> samples{};
        uint64_t start = 0u; // absolute index of the oldest frame kept
        uint64_t size = 0u;
        double nominal = kSearch; // absolute input position of the next grain
        uint64_t natural = 0u;    // where the previous grain would continue; 0 = none
        double tempo = 1.0;       // input frames per output frame
        double rate = 1.0;        // frames arriving per output frame, averaged over ~1 s
        uint64_t arrived = 0u;
        bool primed = false;      // false until refilled after running dry
        std::array<float, kHop * 2u> hop{}, tail{};
        uint32_t hopLeft = 0u;

        int16_t at(uint64_t frame, int channel) const { return samples[(frame % kRingFrames) * 2u + channel]; }
    };

    std::mutex g_mutex;
    Ring g_rings[2];
    AudioStream g_stream{};
    std::FILE *g_dump = nullptr;
    std::vector<int32_t> g_mix; // audio thread only
    std::array<float, kGrain> g_window = []
    {
        std::array<float, kGrain> w{};
        for (uint32_t i = 0u; i < kGrain; ++i) // periodic Hann: overlapping halves sum to 1
            w[i] = 0.5f - 0.5f * std::cos(6.283185307f * static_cast<float>(i) / kGrain);
        return w;
    }();

    void onAutoDmaBlock(int core, const uint8_t *block, size_t size)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_mutex);
        Ring &ring = g_rings[core & 1];
        // Each KB holds 256 left samples, then 256 right.
        for (size_t kb = 0u; kb + 1024u <= size; kb += 1024u)
        {
            for (uint32_t i = 0u; i < 256u; ++i)
            {
                if (ring.size == kRingFrames) // the host fell behind: drop the oldest frame
                {
                    ++ring.start;
                    --ring.size;
                }
                const uint64_t write = (ring.start + ring.size) % kRingFrames;
                std::memcpy(&ring.samples[write * 2u], block + kb + i * 2u, 2u);
                std::memcpy(&ring.samples[write * 2u + 1u], block + kb + 512u + i * 2u, 2u);
                ++ring.size;
                ++ring.arrived;
            }
        }
    }

    // Fills ring.hop with the next kHop output frames.
    void nextHop(Ring &ring)
    {
        ring.hopLeft = kHop;
        const uint64_t end = ring.start + ring.size;
        if (ring.nominal < ring.start + kSearch)
            ring.nominal = static_cast<double>(ring.start + kSearch);
        const uint64_t nominal = static_cast<uint64_t>(ring.nominal);
        if (!ring.primed && ring.size >= kTargetFrames / 2u)
            ring.primed = true;
        if (!ring.primed || nominal + kSearch + kGrain > end)
        {
            // Ran dry: fade out what was playing and wait for a refill.
            ring.primed = false;
            ring.hop = ring.tail;
            ring.tail.fill(0.0f);
            ring.natural = 0u;
            return;
        }

        uint64_t pos = nominal;
        if (ring.tempo == 1.0 && ring.natural != 0u && ring.natural >= ring.start && ring.natural + kHop + kGrain <= end)
            pos = ring.natural; // real-time speed: plain copy, no seam search (no warble)
        else if (ring.natural != 0u && ring.natural >= ring.start)
        {
            float best = -1e30f;
            for (uint64_t c = nominal - kSearch; c <= nominal + kSearch; c += 4u)
            {
                float dot = 0.0f, energy = 1.0f;
                for (uint32_t k = 0u; k < kHop; k += 2u)
                {
                    const float a = static_cast<float>(ring.at(ring.natural + k, 0) + ring.at(ring.natural + k, 1));
                    const float b = static_cast<float>(ring.at(c + k, 0) + ring.at(c + k, 1));
                    dot += a * b;
                    energy += b * b;
                }
                const float score = dot / std::sqrt(energy);
                if (score > best)
                {
                    best = score;
                    pos = c;
                }
            }
        }
        for (uint32_t k = 0u; k < kHop; ++k)
            for (int ch = 0; ch < 2; ++ch)
            {
                ring.hop[k * 2u + ch] = ring.tail[k * 2u + ch] + ring.at(pos + k, ch) * g_window[k];
                ring.tail[k * 2u + ch] = ring.at(pos + kHop + k, ch) * g_window[kHop + k];
            }
        ring.natural = pos + kHop;
        ring.nominal += kHop * ring.tempo;
        const uint64_t keep = std::min<uint64_t>(ring.natural, static_cast<uint64_t>(ring.nominal) - kSearch);
        if (keep > ring.start)
        {
            ring.size -= keep - ring.start;
            ring.start = keep;
        }
    }

    // Audio thread: mixes both cores. Below 60 fields/s the guest makes sound slower than
    // real time, and it stalls for a few hundred ms at a time. The queue absorbs the stalls;
    // a longer slowdown plays the music at a slower tempo (same pitch) instead of gaps, and
    // a backlog plays slightly faster.
    void fillStream(void *buffer, unsigned int frames)
    {
        auto *out = static_cast<int16_t *>(buffer);
        g_mix.assign(frames * 2u, 0);
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_mutex);
        for (Ring &ring : g_rings)
        {
            const double fill = static_cast<double>(ring.size) / kTargetFrames;
            ring.rate += (std::min(static_cast<double>(ring.arrived) / frames, 4.0) - ring.rate) * 0.01;
            ring.arrived = 0u;
            // With the queue in a comfortable band play at exactly real-time speed: at a steady
            // 60 fields/s the guest keeps up, and constant small tempo changes were audible as a
            // warble in gameplay. Outside the band follow the arrival rate and steer the queue
            // back toward the target, as before.
            if (ring.tempo == 1.0 && fill > 0.5 && fill < 2.0)
            {
            }
            else
            {
                const double wanted = (fill > 0.8 && fill < 1.25) ? 1.0 : std::clamp(ring.rate * (0.5 + 0.5 * std::min(fill, 3.0)), 0.3, 1.25);
                ring.tempo += (wanted - ring.tempo) * 0.05;
                if (wanted == 1.0 && std::abs(ring.tempo - 1.0) < 0.01)
                    ring.tempo = 1.0;
            }
            for (unsigned int frame = 0u; frame < frames; ++frame)
            {
                if (ring.hopLeft == 0u)
                    nextHop(ring);
                const uint32_t k = kHop - ring.hopLeft--;
                g_mix[frame * 2u] += static_cast<int32_t>(ring.hop[k * 2u]);
                g_mix[frame * 2u + 1u] += static_cast<int32_t>(ring.hop[k * 2u + 1u]);
            }
        }
        ps2x::iop::renderSpu2Voices(g_mix.data(), frames);
        for (unsigned i = 0u; i < frames * 2u; ++i)
            out[i] = static_cast<int16_t>(std::clamp(g_mix[i], -32768, 32767));
        if (g_dump != nullptr)
            std::fwrite(out, 4u, frames, g_dump);
    }
}

void startSpu2Stream()
{
    const char *setting = std::getenv("PS2X_AUDIO");
    if ((setting != nullptr && setting[0] == '0') || !IsAudioDeviceReady())
        return;
    if (const char *dump = std::getenv("PS2X_SPU2_DUMP"))
        g_dump = std::fopen(dump, "wb");
    g_stream = LoadAudioStream(48000u, 16u, 2u);
    SetAudioStreamCallback(g_stream, fillStream);
    PlayAudioStream(g_stream);
    ps2x::iop::setSpu2StreamSink(onAutoDmaBlock);
}

```

`patches/ps2_vu1_jit.cpp`:

```cpp
// x86-64 SSE recompiler for VU1 microcode.
//
// Runs of simple instruction pairs become native blocks working on the same
// VU1State as the interpreter, so run() can alternate between the two on every
// pair. Everything with timing that a program can observe (branches, CLIP, Q and
// P producers, XGKICK, flag operations) stays in the interpreter.
//
// A block's cycle count comes from the interpreter's own interlock rules, applied
// at compile time. Values read from outside the block are checked at entry.
//
// PS2X_VU_JIT=0 disables it. PS2X_VU_JIT_CHECK=N also runs one block in N through the
// interpreter and reports any difference in registers, memory or cycles.
#include "runtime/ps2_vu1.h"
#include "ps2_runtime.h"
#include "ps2_vu1_detail.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <memory>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

#if defined(__x86_64__) && !defined(_WIN32)
#include <sys/mman.h>
#define PS2_VU_JIT_SUPPORTED 1
#else
#define PS2_VU_JIT_SUPPORTED 0
#endif

namespace
{
    constexpr uint32_t kCodeArenaSize = 16u * 1024u * 1024u;
    constexpr uint32_t kMinBlockPairs = 2u;
    constexpr uint32_t kMaxBlockPairs = 256u;
    // shortcut: MAC/STATUS are only produced by interpreted pairs, and pairs this close
    // before a flag read stay interpreted. A reader reached by a branch from further
    // away would see stale flags; MKSM's programs read them right after computing.
    constexpr uint32_t kFlagReaderWindow = 16u;

    class Assembler
    {
    public:
        std::vector<uint8_t> bytes;

        void u8(uint8_t value) { bytes.push_back(value); }
        void u32(uint32_t value)
        {
            for (int shift = 0; shift < 32; shift += 8)
                u8(static_cast<uint8_t>(value >> shift));
        }
        void modrmDisp(uint8_t reg, uint32_t disp)
        {
            u8(static_cast<uint8_t>(0x80u | (reg << 3) | 7u)); // [rdi+disp32]
            u32(disp);
        }
        void op0F(uint8_t opcode, uint8_t dst, uint8_t src)
        {
            u8(0x0F);
            u8(opcode);
            u8(static_cast<uint8_t>(0xC0u | (dst << 3) | src));
        }

        void loadState(uint8_t xmm, uint32_t disp) { u8(0x0F); u8(0x10); modrmDisp(xmm, disp); }
        void storeState(uint32_t disp, uint8_t xmm) { u8(0x0F); u8(0x11); modrmDisp(xmm, disp); }
        void loadScalarState(uint8_t xmm, uint32_t disp)
        {
            u8(0xF3); u8(0x0F); u8(0x10); modrmDisp(xmm, disp);
            shufps(xmm, xmm, 0x00);
        }
        void loadConstant(uint8_t xmm, const void *address)
        {
            u8(0x48); u8(0xB8); // mov rax, imm64
            const uint64_t value = reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(address);
            for (int shift = 0; shift < 64; shift += 8)
                u8(static_cast<uint8_t>(value >> shift));
            u8(0x0F); u8(0x10); u8(static_cast<uint8_t>((xmm << 3) | 0u)); // movups xmm, [rax]
        }
        void movaps(uint8_t dst, uint8_t src) { op0F(0x28, dst, src); }
        void addps(uint8_t dst, uint8_t src) { op0F(0x58, dst, src); }
        void mulps(uint8_t dst, uint8_t src) { op0F(0x59, dst, src); }
        void subps(uint8_t dst, uint8_t src) { op0F(0x5C, dst, src); }
        void minps(uint8_t dst, uint8_t src) { op0F(0x5D, dst, src); }
        void maxps(uint8_t dst, uint8_t src) { op0F(0x5F, dst, src); }
        void andps(uint8_t dst, uint8_t src) { op0F(0x54, dst, src); }
        void xorps(uint8_t dst, uint8_t src) { op0F(0x57, dst, src); }
        void cvtdq2ps(uint8_t dst, uint8_t src) { op0F(0x5B, dst, src); }
        void cvttps2dq(uint8_t dst, uint8_t src) { u8(0xF3); op0F(0x5B, dst, src); }
        void shufps(uint8_t dst, uint8_t src, uint8_t imm) { op0F(0xC6, dst, src); u8(imm); }
        void cmpnltps(uint8_t dst, uint8_t src) { op0F(0xC2, dst, src); u8(5); }
        void andnps(uint8_t dst, uint8_t src) { op0F(0x55, dst, src); }
        void orps(uint8_t dst, uint8_t src) { op0F(0x56, dst, src); }
        void pcmpeqd(uint8_t dst, uint8_t src) { u8(0x66); op0F(0x76, dst, src); }
        void movmskpsEax(uint8_t src) { op0F(0x50, 0, src); }
        void testEaxEax() { u8(0x85); u8(0xC0); }
        void jz(uint8_t displacement) { u8(0x74); u8(displacement); }
        void pcmpgtd(uint8_t dst, uint8_t src) { u8(0x66); op0F(0x66, dst, src); }
```
