```cpp
        void pxor(uint8_t dst, uint8_t src) { u8(0x66); op0F(0xEF, dst, src); }
        void psrad(uint8_t xmm, uint8_t shift) { u8(0x66); u8(0x0F); u8(0x72); u8(static_cast<uint8_t>(0xE0u | xmm)); u8(shift); }
        // xmm0 = MAX (or MINI) of xmm0 and xmm1 in the VU's sign-magnitude order (+0 > -0,
        // denormals by their bits): keys k = x ^ ((x >> 31) & 0x7FFFFFFF) compare as int32.
        // Uses xmm2, xmm3 and xmm7; expects kVecExponent and kVecSign in xmm5 and xmm6.
        void vuMinMax(bool max)
        {
            for (uint8_t x = 0u; x < 2u; ++x) // denormals become signed zero, as normalizeOperand does
            {
                movaps(2, x); andps(2, 5); pxor(3, 3); pcmpeqd(2, 3);
                movaps(3, 6); andnps(3, 2); andnps(3, x); movaps(x, 3);
            }
            movaps(2, 0); psrad(2, 31); movaps(3, 6); andnps(3, 2); xorps(3, 0); // key of xmm0
            movaps(2, 1); psrad(2, 31); movaps(7, 6); andnps(7, 2); xorps(7, 1); // key of xmm1
            if (max)
                pcmpgtd(3, 7); // xmm0 wins
            else
            {
                pcmpgtd(7, 3);
                movaps(3, 7);
            }
            andps(0, 3);
            andnps(3, 1);
            orps(0, 3);
        }
        size_t jzFar()
        {
            u8(0x0F); u8(0x84); u32(0u);
            return bytes.size();
        }
        size_t jnzFar()
        {
            u8(0x0F); u8(0x85); u32(0u);
            return bytes.size();
        }
        void patchJump(size_t afterJump)
        {
            const uint32_t distance = static_cast<uint32_t>(bytes.size() - afterJump);
            std::memcpy(bytes.data() + afterJump - 4u, &distance, 4u);
        }
        void callAbsolute(const void *function)
        {
            u8(0x48); u8(0xB8);
            const uint64_t value = reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(function);
            for (int shift = 0; shift < 64; shift += 8)
                u8(static_cast<uint8_t>(value >> shift));
            u8(0xFF); u8(0xD0); // call rax
        }

        // Inf and NaN operands become signed MAX, like normalizeOperand. Denormals are
        // handled by DAZ. Expects kVecMax, kVecExponent and kVecSign in xmm4 to xmm6.
        void clampOperand(uint8_t xmm)
        {
            movaps(3, xmm);
            andps(3, 5);
            pcmpeqd(3, 5);
            movmskpsEax(3);
            testEaxEax();
            constexpr uint8_t kCorrectionBytes = 7u * 3u;
            jz(kCorrectionBytes);
            movaps(7, xmm);
            andps(7, 6);
            orps(7, 4);
            andps(7, 3);
            andnps(3, xmm);
            orps(3, 7);
            movaps(xmm, 3);
        }
        void blendps(uint8_t dst, uint8_t src, uint8_t imm)
        {
            u8(0x66); u8(0x0F); u8(0x3A); u8(0x0C);
            u8(static_cast<uint8_t>(0xC0u | (dst << 3) | src));
            u8(imm);
        }

        void loadViEax(uint32_t disp) { u8(0x8B); modrmDisp(0, disp); }
        void loadViEcx(uint32_t disp) { u8(0x8B); modrmDisp(1, disp); }
        void storeViEax(uint32_t disp) { u8(0x89); modrmDisp(0, disp); }
        void storeImm32(uint32_t disp, uint32_t value)
        {
            u8(0xC7); modrmDisp(0, disp); u32(value);
        }
        void addEaxImm(uint32_t value) { u8(0x05); u32(value); }
        void andEaxImm(uint32_t value) { u8(0x25); u32(value); }
        void addEaxEcx() { u8(0x01); u8(0xC8); }
        void subEaxEcx() { u8(0x29); u8(0xC8); }
        void andEaxEcx() { u8(0x21); u8(0xC8); }
        void orEaxEcx() { u8(0x09); u8(0xC8); }
        void shlEax4() { u8(0xC1); u8(0xE0); u8(0x04); }
        void movsxEaxAx() { u8(0x0F); u8(0xBF); u8(0xC0); }
        void movzxEaxAx() { u8(0x0F); u8(0xB7); u8(0xC0); }
        void movdXmmEax(uint8_t xmm) { u8(0x66); u8(0x0F); u8(0x6E); u8(static_cast<uint8_t>(0xC0u | (xmm << 3))); }
        void loadData(uint8_t xmm) { u8(0x0F); u8(0x10); u8(static_cast<uint8_t>((xmm << 3) | 4u)); u8(0x06); }  // [rsi+rax]
        void storeData(uint8_t xmm) { u8(0x0F); u8(0x11); u8(static_cast<uint8_t>((xmm << 3) | 4u)); u8(0x06); } // [rsi+rax]
        // Interpreter members, at [rdx+disp32].
        void loadSelfEax(uint32_t disp) { u8(0x8B); u8(0x82); u32(disp); }
        void loadSelfEcx(uint32_t disp) { u8(0x8B); u8(0x8A); u32(disp); }
        void storeSelfEax(uint32_t disp) { u8(0x89); u8(0x82); u32(disp); }
        void storeSelfImm8(uint32_t disp, uint8_t value) { u8(0xC6); u8(0x82); u32(disp); u8(value); }
        void storeImm8(uint32_t disp, uint8_t value) { u8(0xC6); modrmDisp(0, disp); u8(value); }
        void cmpAxCx() { u8(0x66); u8(0x39); u8(0xC8); }
        void loadDataEax(uint8_t disp) { u8(0x8B); u8(0x44); u8(0x06); u8(disp); }  // mov eax, [rsi+rax+disp8]
        void storeDataEcx(uint8_t disp) { u8(0x89); u8(0x4C); u8(0x06); u8(disp); } // mov [rsi+rax+disp8], ecx
        void movzxEcxCx() { u8(0x0F); u8(0xB7); u8(0xC9); }
        void ret() { u8(0xC3); }
    };

    struct alignas(16) Vec4
    {
        float value[4];
    };
    struct alignas(16) Vec4i
    {
        uint32_t value[4];
    };

    const Vec4 kItofScale[4] = {{{1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f}},
                                {{1.0f / 16.0f, 1.0f / 16.0f, 1.0f / 16.0f, 1.0f / 16.0f}},
                                {{1.0f / 4096.0f, 1.0f / 4096.0f, 1.0f / 4096.0f, 1.0f / 4096.0f}},
                                {{1.0f / 32768.0f, 1.0f / 32768.0f, 1.0f / 32768.0f, 1.0f / 32768.0f}}};
    const Vec4 kFtoiScale[4] = {{{1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f}},
                                {{16.0f, 16.0f, 16.0f, 16.0f}},
                                {{4096.0f, 4096.0f, 4096.0f, 4096.0f}},
                                {{32768.0f, 32768.0f, 32768.0f, 32768.0f}}};
    const Vec4 kInt32Limit = {{2147483648.0f, 2147483648.0f, 2147483648.0f, 2147483648.0f}};
    const Vec4i kAbsMask = {{0x7FFFFFFFu, 0x7FFFFFFFu, 0x7FFFFFFFu, 0x7FFFFFFFu}};
    const Vec4i kVecMax = {{0x7F7FFFFFu, 0x7F7FFFFFu, 0x7F7FFFFFu, 0x7F7FFFFFu}};
    const Vec4i kVecExponent = {{0x7F800000u, 0x7F800000u, 0x7F800000u, 0x7F800000u}};
    const Vec4i kVecSign = {{0x80000000u, 0x80000000u, 0x80000000u, 0x80000000u}};
    const Vec4i kExponentBelowFe = {{0x7EFFFFFFu, 0x7EFFFFFFu, 0x7EFFFFFFu, 0x7EFFFFFFu}};

    uint8_t laneForComponent(uint32_t component) { return static_cast<uint8_t>(8u >> component); }

    uint8_t blendMask(uint8_t dest)
    {
        return static_cast<uint8_t>(((dest >> 3) & 1u) | (((dest >> 2) & 1u) << 1) |
                                    (((dest >> 1) & 1u) << 2) | ((dest & 1u) << 3));
    }

    uint32_t vfOffset(uint32_t reg) { return static_cast<uint32_t>(offsetof(VU1State, vf)) + reg * 16u; }
    uint32_t viOffset(uint32_t reg) { return static_cast<uint32_t>(offsetof(VU1State, vi)) + reg * 4u; }
    uint32_t accOffset() { return static_cast<uint32_t>(offsetof(VU1State, acc)); }
    uint32_t qOffset() { return static_cast<uint32_t>(offsetof(VU1State, q)); }
    uint32_t iOffset() { return static_cast<uint32_t>(offsetof(VU1State, i)); }

    enum class UpperKind : uint8_t
    {
        Unsupported,
        Nop,
        Add,
        Sub,
        Mul,
        Madd,
        Msub,
        Max,
        Min,
        Itof,
        Ftoi,
        Abs
    };
    enum class UpperSource : uint8_t
    {
        Broadcast,
        Q,
        I,
        Vector
    };

    struct UpperOp
    {
        UpperKind kind = UpperKind::Unsupported;
        UpperSource source = UpperSource::Vector;
        uint8_t broadcast = 0;
        uint8_t scale = 0;
        bool toAcc = false;
    };

    UpperOp decodeUpper(uint32_t instr)
    {
        UpperOp op;
        const uint8_t code = instr & 0x3Fu;
        const auto set = [&op](UpperKind kind, UpperSource source, uint8_t broadcast = 0u, bool toAcc = false)
        {
            op.kind = kind;
            op.source = source;
            op.broadcast = broadcast;
            op.toAcc = toAcc;
        };
        if (code < 0x3Cu)
        {
            const uint8_t bc = code & 3u;
            if (code <= 0x03u) set(UpperKind::Add, UpperSource::Broadcast, bc);
            else if (code <= 0x07u) set(UpperKind::Sub, UpperSource::Broadcast, bc);
            else if (code <= 0x0Bu) set(UpperKind::Madd, UpperSource::Broadcast, bc);
            else if (code <= 0x0Fu) set(UpperKind::Msub, UpperSource::Broadcast, bc);
            else if (code <= 0x13u) set(UpperKind::Max, UpperSource::Broadcast, bc);
            else if (code <= 0x17u) set(UpperKind::Min, UpperSource::Broadcast, bc);
            else if (code <= 0x1Bu) set(UpperKind::Mul, UpperSource::Broadcast, bc);
            else switch (code)
            {
            case 0x1C: set(UpperKind::Mul, UpperSource::Q); break;
            case 0x1D: set(UpperKind::Max, UpperSource::I); break;
            case 0x1E: set(UpperKind::Mul, UpperSource::I); break;
            case 0x1F: set(UpperKind::Min, UpperSource::I); break;
            case 0x20: set(UpperKind::Add, UpperSource::Q); break;
            case 0x21: set(UpperKind::Madd, UpperSource::Q); break;
            case 0x22: set(UpperKind::Add, UpperSource::I); break;
            case 0x23: set(UpperKind::Madd, UpperSource::I); break;
            case 0x24: set(UpperKind::Sub, UpperSource::Q); break;
            case 0x25: set(UpperKind::Msub, UpperSource::Q); break;
            case 0x26: set(UpperKind::Sub, UpperSource::I); break;
            case 0x27: set(UpperKind::Msub, UpperSource::I); break;
            case 0x28: set(UpperKind::Add, UpperSource::Vector); break;
            case 0x29: set(UpperKind::Madd, UpperSource::Vector); break;
            case 0x2A: set(UpperKind::Mul, UpperSource::Vector); break;
            case 0x2B: set(UpperKind::Max, UpperSource::Vector); break;
            case 0x2C: set(UpperKind::Sub, UpperSource::Vector); break;
            case 0x2D: set(UpperKind::Msub, UpperSource::Vector); break;
            case 0x2F: set(UpperKind::Min, UpperSource::Vector); break;
            default: break;
            }
            return op;
        }

        const uint8_t special = static_cast<uint8_t>((instr & 3u) | ((instr >> 4) & 0x7Cu));
        const uint8_t bc = special & 3u;
        if (special <= 0x03u) set(UpperKind::Add, UpperSource::Broadcast, bc, true);
        else if (special <= 0x07u) set(UpperKind::Sub, UpperSource::Broadcast, bc, true);
        else if (special <= 0x0Bu) set(UpperKind::Madd, UpperSource::Broadcast, bc, true);
        else if (special <= 0x0Fu) set(UpperKind::Msub, UpperSource::Broadcast, bc, true);
        else if (special <= 0x13u) { op.kind = UpperKind::Itof; op.scale = special & 3u; }
        else if (special <= 0x17u) { op.kind = UpperKind::Ftoi; op.scale = special & 3u; }
        else if (special <= 0x1Bu) set(UpperKind::Mul, UpperSource::Broadcast, bc, true);
        else switch (special)
        {
        case 0x1C: set(UpperKind::Mul, UpperSource::Q, 0u, true); break;
        case 0x1D: op.kind = UpperKind::Abs; break;
        case 0x1E: set(UpperKind::Mul, UpperSource::I, 0u, true); break;
        case 0x20: set(UpperKind::Add, UpperSource::Q, 0u, true); break;
        case 0x21: set(UpperKind::Madd, UpperSource::Q, 0u, true); break;
        case 0x22: set(UpperKind::Add, UpperSource::I, 0u, true); break;
        case 0x23: set(UpperKind::Madd, UpperSource::I, 0u, true); break;
        case 0x24: set(UpperKind::Sub, UpperSource::Q, 0u, true); break;
        case 0x25: set(UpperKind::Msub, UpperSource::Q, 0u, true); break;
        case 0x26: set(UpperKind::Sub, UpperSource::I, 0u, true); break;
        case 0x27: set(UpperKind::Msub, UpperSource::I, 0u, true); break;
        case 0x28: set(UpperKind::Add, UpperSource::Vector, 0u, true); break;
        case 0x29: set(UpperKind::Madd, UpperSource::Vector, 0u, true); break;
        case 0x2A: set(UpperKind::Mul, UpperSource::Vector, 0u, true); break;
        case 0x2C: set(UpperKind::Sub, UpperSource::Vector, 0u, true); break;
        case 0x2D: set(UpperKind::Msub, UpperSource::Vector, 0u, true); break;
        case 0x2F: op.kind = UpperKind::Nop; break;
        default: break;
        }
        return op;
    }

    bool lowerIsSupported(uint32_t instr)
    {
        if (instr == 0u || instr == 0x8000033Cu)
            return true;
        const uint8_t opHi = (instr >> 25) & 0x7Fu;
        switch (opHi)
        {
        case 0x00: case 0x01: case 0x04: case 0x05: case 0x08: case 0x09:
            return true;
        case 0x40:
            break;
        default:
            return false;
        }
        const uint8_t funct = instr & 0x3Fu;
        if (funct == 0x30u || funct == 0x31u || funct == 0x32u || funct == 0x34u || funct == 0x35u)
            return true;
        if (funct < 0x3Cu)
            return false;
        const uint8_t special = static_cast<uint8_t>((instr & 3u) | ((instr >> 4) & 0x7Cu));
        return special == 0x30u || special == 0x31u || (special >= 0x34u && special <= 0x37u) ||
               special == 0x3Cu || special == 0x3Du;
    }

    // Lower instructions a block runs through the interpreter's own code at their cycle
    // (emitCallout): FDIV/EFU/clip-flag pipelines and register-addressed integer memory ops.
    void loadJitConstants(Assembler &a);

    bool lowerIsCallout(uint32_t instr)
    {
        switch ((instr >> 25) & 0x7Fu)
        {
        case 0x10: case 0x11: case 0x12: case 0x13: case 0x1C: // FCEQ, FCSET, FCAND, FCOR, FCGET
            return true;
        case 0x40:
            break;
        default:
            return false;
        }
        if ((instr & 0x3Fu) < 0x3Cu)
            return false;
        const uint8_t special = static_cast<uint8_t>((instr & 3u) | ((instr >> 4) & 0x7Cu));
        return (special >= 0x38u && special <= 0x3Au) ||          // DIV, SQRT, RSQRT
               special == 0x3Eu || special == 0x3Fu ||            // ILWR, ISWR
               special == 0x64u ||                                // MFP
               special == 0x68u || special == 0x69u ||            // XTOP, XITOP
               (special >= 0x70u && special <= 0x7Fu && special != 0x7Bu); // EFU ops but WAITP
    }

    // B, IBEQ and IBNE are emitted inline; the other branches stay callouts.
    bool branchIsNative(uint32_t instr)
    {
        const uint8_t opHi = (instr >> 25) & 0x7Fu;
        return opHi == 0x20u || opHi == 0x28u || opHi == 0x29u;
    }

    bool lowerIsXgkick(uint32_t instr)
    {
        return ((instr >> 25) & 0x7Fu) == 0x40u && (instr & 0x3Fu) >= 0x3Cu &&
               ((instr & 3u) | ((instr >> 4) & 0x7Cu)) == 0x6Cu;
    }

    bool upperIsClip(uint32_t instr)
    {
        return (instr & 0x3Cu) == 0x3Cu && (((instr >> 4) & 0x7Cu) | (instr & 3u)) == 0x1Fu;
    }

    // Calls function(interpreter, instr, cycle offset in the block), keeping xmm0: the
    // pair's upper result is still unstored there.
    void emitCallout(Assembler &a, const void *function, uint32_t instr, uint32_t offset)
    {
        a.u8(0x57); a.u8(0x56); a.u8(0x52);             // push rdi, rsi, rdx
        a.u8(0x48); a.u8(0x83); a.u8(0xEC); a.u8(0x10); // sub rsp, 16
        a.u8(0x0F); a.u8(0x11); a.u8(0x04); a.u8(0x24); // movups [rsp], xmm0
        a.u8(0x48); a.u8(0x89); a.u8(0xD7);             // mov rdi, rdx (interpreter)
        a.u8(0xBE); a.u32(instr);                       // mov esi, instr
        a.u8(0xBA); a.u32(offset);                      // mov edx, offset
        a.callAbsolute(function);
        a.u8(0x0F); a.u8(0x10); a.u8(0x04); a.u8(0x24); // movups xmm0, [rsp]
        a.u8(0x48); a.u8(0x83); a.u8(0xC4); a.u8(0x10); // add rsp, 16
        a.u8(0x5A); a.u8(0x5E); a.u8(0x5F);             // pop rdx, rsi, rdi
        loadJitConstants(a);
    }

    bool upperReadsQ(const UpperOp &op) { return op.kind != UpperKind::Unsupported && op.kind != UpperKind::Nop &&
                                                 op.kind != UpperKind::Itof && op.kind != UpperKind::Ftoi &&
                                                 op.kind != UpperKind::Abs && op.source == UpperSource::Q; }

    void loadJitConstants(Assembler &a)
    {
        a.loadConstant(4, &kVecMax);
        a.loadConstant(5, &kVecExponent);
        a.loadConstant(6, &kVecSign);
    }

    // Lanes where truncated single precision and the interpreter's exact form part ways:
    // a result or product at exponent 0xFE/0xFF and, for MADD/MSUB, a zero or subnormal
    // sum whose exact sign can differ. They are rare: hand them to the interpreter's own
    // code while the VF and ACC still hold the pre-pair values it reads.
    // A zero sum is exact when the product is: one of its operands is zero (most of them;
    // expects the product's second operand still in xmm2 and FS unstored).
    void emitExactFmacFixup(Assembler &a, uint32_t instr, bool checksProduct, const void *fixup)
    {
        if (checksProduct)
        {
            a.movaps(7, 2);
            a.andps(7, 5);
            a.loadState(3, vfOffset(FS(instr)));
            a.andps(3, 5);
            a.pxor(2, 2);
            a.pcmpeqd(7, 2);
            a.pcmpeqd(3, 2);
            a.orps(7, 3); // lanes with a zero operand
        }
        a.movaps(3, 0);
        a.andps(3, 5);
        if (checksProduct)
        {
            a.pcmpeqd(2, 3); // zero result (xmm2 was zero)
            a.andnps(7, 2);
            a.movaps(2, 7);
        }
        a.loadConstant(7, &kExponentBelowFe);
        a.pcmpgtd(3, 7);
        if (checksProduct)
        {
            a.orps(3, 2);
            a.movaps(2, 1);
            a.andps(2, 5);
            a.loadConstant(7, &kExponentBelowFe);
            a.pcmpgtd(2, 7);
            a.orps(3, 2);
        }
        a.movmskpsEax(3);
        a.andEaxImm(blendMask(DEST(instr)));
        const size_t skip = a.jzFar();
        a.u8(0x57); a.u8(0x56); a.u8(0x52);             // push rdi, rsi, rdx
        a.u8(0x48); a.u8(0x83); a.u8(0xEC); a.u8(0x10); // sub rsp, 16
        a.u8(0x0F); a.u8(0x11); a.u8(0x04); a.u8(0x24); // movups [rsp], xmm0
        a.u8(0x48); a.u8(0x89); a.u8(0xD7);             // mov rdi, rdx (interpreter)
        a.u8(0xBE); a.u32(instr);                       // mov esi, instr
        a.u8(0x48); a.u8(0x89); a.u8(0xE2);             // mov rdx, rsp
        a.callAbsolute(fixup);
        a.u8(0x0F); a.u8(0x10); a.u8(0x04); a.u8(0x24); // movups xmm0, [rsp]
        a.u8(0x48); a.u8(0x83); a.u8(0xC4); a.u8(0x10); // add rsp, 16
        a.u8(0x5A); a.u8(0x5E); a.u8(0x5F);             // pop rdx, rsi, rdi
        loadJitConstants(a);
        a.patchJump(skip);
    }

    // Leaves the masked result in xmm0, unstored: the lower instruction of the pair must
    // still see the old register value.
    // finiteVf: registers this block produced through exact FMAC/ITOF/ABS results, never Inf/NaN,
    // so their loads need no clampOperand.
    void emitUpper(Assembler &a, uint32_t instr, const UpperOp &op, const void *fixup, const bool *finiteVf)
    {
        const uint8_t fs = FS(instr), ft = FT(instr);
        const auto loadSource = [&](uint8_t xmm)
        {
            switch (op.source)
            {
            case UpperSource::Broadcast:
                a.loadState(xmm, vfOffset(ft));
                a.shufps(xmm, xmm, static_cast<uint8_t>(op.broadcast * 0x55u));
                break;
            case UpperSource::Q: a.loadScalarState(xmm, qOffset()); break;
            case UpperSource::I: a.loadScalarState(xmm, iOffset()); break;
            case UpperSource::Vector: a.loadState(xmm, vfOffset(ft)); break;
            }
            if (op.source == UpperSource::Q || op.source == UpperSource::I || !finiteVf[ft])
                a.clampOperand(xmm);
        };
        const auto loadFs = [&](uint8_t xmm)
        {
            a.loadState(xmm, vfOffset(fs));
            if (!finiteVf[fs])
                a.clampOperand(xmm);
        };

        switch (op.kind)
        {
        case UpperKind::Add:
            loadFs(0); loadSource(1); a.addps(0, 1);
            emitExactFmacFixup(a, instr, false, fixup);
            break;
        case UpperKind::Sub:
            loadFs(0); loadSource(1); a.subps(0, 1);
            emitExactFmacFixup(a, instr, false, fixup);
            break;
        case UpperKind::Mul:
            loadFs(0); loadSource(1); a.mulps(0, 1);
            emitExactFmacFixup(a, instr, false, fixup);
            break;
        case UpperKind::Max:
            loadFs(0); loadSource(1); a.vuMinMax(true);
            break;
        case UpperKind::Min:
            loadFs(0); loadSource(1); a.vuMinMax(false);
            break;
        case UpperKind::Madd:
            loadFs(1); loadSource(2); a.mulps(1, 2);
            a.loadState(0, accOffset()); a.addps(0, 1);
            emitExactFmacFixup(a, instr, true, fixup);
            break;
        case UpperKind::Msub:
            loadFs(1); loadSource(2); a.mulps(1, 2);
            a.loadState(0, accOffset()); a.subps(0, 1);
            emitExactFmacFixup(a, instr, true, fixup);
            break;
        case UpperKind::Itof:
            a.loadState(0, vfOffset(fs));
            a.cvtdq2ps(0, 0);
            if (op.scale != 0u)
            {
                a.loadConstant(1, &kItofScale[op.scale]);
                a.mulps(0, 1);
            }
            break;
        case UpperKind::Ftoi:
            loadFs(1);
            if (op.scale != 0u)
            {
                a.loadConstant(2, &kFtoiScale[op.scale]);
                a.mulps(1, 2);
            }
            a.cvttps2dq(0, 1);
            // cvttps2dq returns INT_MIN on overflow; positive overflow must saturate high.
            a.loadConstant(2, &kInt32Limit);
            a.cmpnltps(1, 2);
            a.xorps(0, 1);
            break;
        case UpperKind::Abs:
            loadFs(0);
            a.loadConstant(1, &kAbsMask);
            a.andps(0, 1);
            break;
        default:
            break;
        }
    }

    void emitStoreVf(Assembler &a, uint32_t reg, uint8_t dest, uint8_t xmm)
    {
        if (reg == 0u || dest == 0u)
            return;
        if (dest == 0xFu)
        {
            a.storeState(vfOffset(reg), xmm);
            return;
        }
        a.loadState(7, vfOffset(reg));
        a.blendps(7, xmm, blendMask(dest));
        a.storeState(vfOffset(reg), 7);
    }

    void emitStoreAcc(Assembler &a, uint8_t dest, uint8_t xmm)
    {
        if (dest == 0u)
            return;
        a.loadState(7, accOffset());
        a.blendps(7, xmm, blendMask(dest));
        a.storeState(accOffset(), 7);
    }

    void emitPostIncrement(Assembler &a, uint32_t reg, int32_t delta)
    {
        if (reg == 0u)
            return;
        a.loadViEax(viOffset(reg));
        a.addEaxImm(static_cast<uint32_t>(delta));
        a.movsxEaxAx();
        a.storeViEax(viOffset(reg));
    }

    void emitAddressFromVi(Assembler &a, uint32_t reg, uint32_t dataMask)
    {
        a.loadViEax(viOffset(reg));
        a.movzxEaxAx();
        a.shlEax4();
        a.andEaxImm(dataMask);
    }

    void emitLoadVf(Assembler &a, uint32_t reg, uint8_t dest, uint8_t suppressedReg)
    {
        if (reg == 0u || reg == suppressedReg)
            return;
        a.loadData(1);
        emitStoreVf(a, reg, dest, 1);
    }

    void emitStoreData(Assembler &a, uint32_t reg, uint8_t dest)
    {
        if (dest == 0u)
            return;
        a.loadState(1, vfOffset(reg));
        if (dest != 0xFu)
        {
            a.loadData(2);
            a.blendps(2, 1, blendMask(dest));
            a.storeData(2);
            return;
        }
        a.storeData(1);
    }

    void emitLower(Assembler &a, uint32_t instr, uint32_t dataMask, uint8_t suppressedReg)
    {
        if (instr == 0u || instr == 0x8000033Cu)
            return;
        const uint8_t opHi = (instr >> 25) & 0x7Fu;
        const uint8_t dest = (instr >> 21) & 0xFu;
        const uint8_t vit = VIT(instr), vis = VIS(instr), vid = VID(instr);
        const uint8_t vfT = FT(instr), vfS = FS(instr);
        switch (opHi)
        {
        case 0x00: // LQ
            a.loadViEax(viOffset(vis));
            a.addEaxImm(static_cast<uint32_t>(static_cast<int32_t>(IMM11(instr))));
            a.shlEax4();
            a.andEaxImm(dataMask);
            emitLoadVf(a, vfT, dest, suppressedReg);
            return;
        case 0x01: // SQ
            a.loadViEax(viOffset(vit));
            a.addEaxImm(static_cast<uint32_t>(static_cast<int32_t>(IMM11(instr))));
            a.shlEax4();
            a.andEaxImm(dataMask);
            emitStoreData(a, vfS, dest);
            return;
        case 0x04: // ILW: the first lane of dest, sign-extended
        case 0x05: // ISW: stores at once, like SQ
        {
            if (opHi == 0x04u && vit == 0u)
                return;
            a.loadViEax(viOffset(vis));
            a.addEaxImm(static_cast<uint32_t>(static_cast<int32_t>(IMM11(instr))));
            a.shlEax4();
            a.andEaxImm(dataMask);
            if (opHi == 0x04u)
            {
                const uint8_t lane = (dest & 8u) ? 0u : (dest & 4u) ? 1u : (dest & 2u) ? 2u : 3u;
                a.loadDataEax(static_cast<uint8_t>(lane * 4u));
                a.movsxEaxAx();
                a.storeViEax(viOffset(vit));
                return;
            }
            a.loadViEcx(viOffset(vit));
            a.movzxEcxCx();
            for (uint8_t lane = 0u; lane < 4u; ++lane)
                if ((dest & (8u >> lane)) != 0u)
                    a.storeDataEcx(static_cast<uint8_t>(lane * 4u));
            return;
        }
        case 0x08: // IADDIU
        case 0x09: // ISUBIU
        {
            if (vit == 0u)
                return;
            const int32_t imm = static_cast<int16_t>((instr & 0x7FFu) | ((instr >> 10) & 0x7800u));
            a.loadViEax(viOffset(vis));
            a.addEaxImm(static_cast<uint32_t>(opHi == 0x08u ? imm : -imm));
            a.movsxEaxAx();
            a.storeViEax(viOffset(vit));
            return;
        }
        default:
            break;
        }

        const uint8_t funct = instr & 0x3Fu;
        if (funct < 0x3Cu)
        {
            if (funct == 0x32u) // IADDI
            {
                if (vit == 0u)
                    return;
                const int32_t imm5 = static_cast<int32_t>(((instr >> 6) & 0x1Fu) << 27) >> 27;
                a.loadViEax(viOffset(vis));
                a.addEaxImm(static_cast<uint32_t>(imm5));
                a.movsxEaxAx();
                a.storeViEax(viOffset(vit));
                return;
            }
            if (vid == 0u)
                return;
            a.loadViEax(viOffset(vis));
            a.loadViEcx(viOffset(vit));
            switch (funct)
            {
            case 0x30: a.addEaxEcx(); a.movsxEaxAx(); break;
            case 0x31: a.subEaxEcx(); a.movsxEaxAx(); break;
            case 0x34: a.andEaxEcx(); break;
            default: a.orEaxEcx(); break;
            }
            a.storeViEax(viOffset(vid));
            return;
        }

        const uint8_t special = static_cast<uint8_t>((instr & 3u) | ((instr >> 4) & 0x7Cu));
        switch (special)
        {
        case 0x30: // MOVE
            if (vfT != 0u && vfT != suppressedReg)
            {
                a.loadState(1, vfOffset(vfS));
                emitStoreVf(a, vfT, dest, 1);
            }
            return;
        case 0x31: // MR32
            if (vfT != 0u && vfT != suppressedReg)
            {
                a.loadState(1, vfOffset(vfS));
                a.shufps(1, 1, 0x39);
                emitStoreVf(a, vfT, dest, 1);
            }
            return;
        case 0x34: // LQI
            emitAddressFromVi(a, vis, dataMask);
            emitLoadVf(a, vfT, dest, suppressedReg);
            emitPostIncrement(a, vis, 1);
            return;
        case 0x35: // SQI
            emitAddressFromVi(a, vit, dataMask);
            emitStoreData(a, vfS, dest);
            emitPostIncrement(a, vit, 1);
            return;
        case 0x36: // LQD
            emitPostIncrement(a, vis, -1);
            emitAddressFromVi(a, vis, dataMask);
            emitLoadVf(a, vfT, dest, suppressedReg);
            return;
        case 0x37: // SQD
            emitPostIncrement(a, vit, -1);
            emitAddressFromVi(a, vit, dataMask);
            emitStoreData(a, vfS, dest);
            return;
        case 0x3C: // MTIR
            if (vit != 0u)
            {
                a.loadViEax(vfOffset(vfS) + ((instr >> 21) & 3u) * 4u);
                a.movsxEaxAx();
                a.storeViEax(viOffset(vit));
            }
            return;
        default: // MFIR
            if (vfT != 0u && vfT != suppressedReg)
            {
                a.loadViEax(viOffset(vis));
                a.movsxEaxAx();
                a.movdXmmEax(1);
                a.shufps(1, 1, 0x00);
                emitStoreVf(a, vfT, dest, 1);
            }
            return;
        }
    }

    struct CodeArena
    {
        uint8_t *base = nullptr;
        uint32_t used = 0;

        uint8_t *place(const std::vector<uint8_t> &code)
        {
#if PS2_VU_JIT_SUPPORTED
            if (!base)
            {
                void *memory = mmap(nullptr, kCodeArenaSize, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE | PROT_EXEC,
                                    MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0);
                if (memory == MAP_FAILED)
                    return nullptr;
                base = static_cast<uint8_t *>(memory);
            }
            if (used + code.size() > kCodeArenaSize)
                return nullptr;
            uint8_t *destination = base + used;
            std::memcpy(destination, code.data(), code.size());
            used += static_cast<uint32_t>(code.size());
            return destination;
#else
            (void)code;
            return nullptr;
#endif
        }
    };
    CodeArena g_codeArena;
}

struct VU1Interpreter::JitBlock
{
    using Function = void (*)(VU1State *, uint8_t *, VU1Interpreter *);
    struct Timing
    {
        uint8_t kind; // 0 VF lane, 1 VI, 2 ACC lane
        uint8_t reg;
        uint8_t lane;
        uint16_t offset;
    };

    static constexpr uint16_t kNone = 0xFFFFu;
    Function function = nullptr;
    uint32_t pairs = 0;
    uint32_t cycles = 0;
    uint16_t fdivOffset = kNone, efuOffset = kNone; // issue cycle of the block's DIV-class / EFU op
    uint16_t xgkickOffset = kNone;                   // an XGKICK, always the block's last pair
    bool xgkickPairReadsQ = false;                   // its upper op reads Q, which may land while it waits
    VfAccess xgkickVfWrite{};                        // what its upper op writes: a stall delays these
    uint8_t xgkickAccWrite = 0;
    bool endsWithBranch = false;                     // last two pairs: a branch and its delay slot
    uint16_t qFirstOffset = kNone, qLastOffset = kNone; // issue cycles of the first and last Q readers
    JitBlock *qSyncVariant = nullptr; // same pairs, Q brought up to date before each later reader
    bool startsWithBranch = false;
    std::vector<Timing> reads;  // earliest offset first
    std::vector<Timing> writes; // latest offset first
};

struct VU1Interpreter::JitState
{
    struct Tables
    {
        std::array<JitBlock *, kMaxDecodedPairs> blocks{};
        std::array<bool, kMaxDecodedPairs> nearFlagReader{};
    };
    // MKSM re-uploads the same few programs several times a frame: tables are kept per
    // code image (keyed by a hash of the whole code memory).
    std::unordered_map<uint64_t, std::unique_ptr<Tables>> tablesByCode;
    Tables *tables = nullptr;
    std::unordered_map<uint64_t, JitBlock *> known;
    JitBlock noBlock;
    uint64_t generation = UINT64_MAX;
    uint32_t checkInterval = 0; // Check one block in this many; 0 disables.
    uint64_t seenBlocks = 0;
    uint64_t checkedBlocks = 0;
    uint64_t mismatches = 0;
    uint64_t cycleMismatches = 0;
    uint32_t pairsLeft = 0;
    // No VF/VI/ACC ready cycle is above readyMax. Valid while m_cycle == exitCycle, i.e.
    // nothing ran since the last block; the interpreter's writes need a rescan.
    uint64_t readyMax = 0;
    uint64_t exitCycle = UINT64_MAX;
    bool compileQSync = false; // compileJitBlock builds the qSyncVariant form (keeps the header unchanged)
    uint64_t xgkickStall = 0;  // cycles the last block's XGKICK waited for the previous transfer
};

void VU1Interpreter::setJitEnabled(bool enabled)
{
#if PS2_VU_JIT_SUPPORTED
    const char *setting = std::getenv("PS2X_VU_JIT");
    if (setting != nullptr && setting[0] == '0')
        enabled = false;
    if (enabled && m_jit == nullptr)
    {
        m_jit = new JitState();
        const char *check = std::getenv("PS2X_VU_JIT_CHECK");
        m_jit->checkInterval = check != nullptr ? static_cast<uint32_t>(std::strtoul(check, nullptr, 10)) : 0u;
    }
    m_jitEnabled = enabled;
#else
    (void)enabled;
#endif
}

VU1Interpreter::JitBlock *VU1Interpreter::compileJitBlock(const uint8_t *vuCode, uint32_t codeSize,
                                                          PS2Memory *memory, uint32_t startPc, uint32_t dataSize)
{
    JitState &jit = *m_jit;
    const uint32_t dataMask = dataSize - 1u;

    bool hasFdiv = false, hasEfu = false; // one of each per block: run() checks the unit is free
    const auto pairIsCompilable = [&](uint32_t pc, bool isFirst, const DecodedInstructionPair &pair)
    {
        if (jit.tables->nearFlagReader[pc / 8u])
            return false;
        if (pair.eBit || pair.dBit || pair.tBit || pair.mBit ||
            pair.upperUsage.reserved || pair.lowerUsage.reserved)
            return false;
        const bool clipUpper = upperIsClip(pair.upper);
        const bool calloutLower = !pair.iBit && (lowerIsCallout(pair.lower) || lowerIsXgkick(pair.lower));
        if ((!clipUpper && (pair.upperUsage.readsClip || pair.upperUsage.writesClip)) ||
            (!calloutLower && (pair.lowerUsage.readsClip || pair.lowerUsage.writesClip)))
            return false;
        const UpperOp upper = decodeUpper(pair.upper);
        if (upper.kind == UpperKind::Unsupported && !clipUpper)
            return false;
        // Q changes when the FDIV unit commits: run() checks an FDIV in flight lands before
        // or after all of the block's Q readers. One issued inside the block would land
        // between them.
        if (!isFirst && upperReadsQ(upper) && hasFdiv)
            return false;
        if (pair.iBit)
            return true;
        if (pair.lowerUsage.pipeline == PipelineBranch)
            return true; // a callout, followed by its delay slot (see the pair loop)
        if ((!lowerIsSupported(pair.lower) && !calloutLower) || pair.lowerUsage.waitQ || pair.lowerUsage.waitP)
            return false;
        if (calloutLower && pair.lowerUsage.vfWrite.reg != 0u && pair.suppressedLowerVf == pair.lowerUsage.vfWrite.reg)
            return false;
        return true;
    };
    const auto isBranch = [](const DecodedInstructionPair &pair)
    { return !pair.iBit && pair.lowerUsage.pipeline == PipelineBranch; };
    // A VI write right before a branch: the branch reads the old value (the interpreter's
    // VI backup), so such a pair runs as a recording callout and needs the branch in the block.
    const auto recordsForBranch = [](const DecodedInstructionPair &pair, const DecodedInstructionPair &next)
    { return !pair.iBit && pair.lowerUsage.delaysNextBranchRead && (pair.lowerUsage.viWrite & 0xFFFEu) != 0u &&
             !next.iBit && next.lowerUsage.pipeline == PipelineBranch; };

    // Pair lookups below can reuse the shared uncached slot: copy what must survive.
    std::vector<DecodedInstructionPair> pairs;
    bool endsWithBranch = false;
    const auto unitBusy = [&](const DecodedInstructionPair &pair)
    {
        const uint8_t pipeline = pair.iBit ? static_cast<uint8_t>(PipelineNone) : pair.lowerUsage.pipeline;
        return (pipeline == PipelineFdiv && hasFdiv) || (pipeline == PipelineEfu && hasEfu);
    };
    const auto noteUnit = [&](const DecodedInstructionPair &pair)
    {
        const uint8_t pipeline = pair.iBit ? static_cast<uint8_t>(PipelineNone) : pair.lowerUsage.pipeline;
        hasFdiv = hasFdiv || pipeline == PipelineFdiv;
        hasEfu = hasEfu || pipeline == PipelineEfu;
    };
    for (uint32_t pc = startPc; pc + 8u <= codeSize && pairs.size() < kMaxBlockPairs; pc += 8u)
    {
        const DecodedInstructionPair pair = getDecodedInstructionPairForPc(vuCode, codeSize, memory, pc);
        if (!pairIsCompilable(pc, pairs.empty(), pair) || unitBusy(pair))
            break;
        if (isBranch(pair))
        {
            // The delay slot ends the block; run() sends pc to the target after it.
            if (pc + 16u > codeSize || pairs.size() + 2u > kMaxBlockPairs)
                break;
            const DecodedInstructionPair delay = getDecodedInstructionPairForPc(vuCode, codeSize, memory, pc + 8u);
            if (!pairIsCompilable(pc + 8u, false, delay) || isBranch(delay) || unitBusy(delay))
                break;
            noteUnit(pair);
            pairs.push_back(pair);
            noteUnit(delay);
            pairs.push_back(delay);
            endsWithBranch = true;
            break;
        }
        noteUnit(pair);
        pairs.push_back(pair);
        // PATH1 reads VU memory over the cycles after an XGKICK: nothing of the block may follow.
        if (!pair.iBit && lowerIsXgkick(pair.lower))
            break;
    }
    // A recording pair whose branch didn't make it into the block stays with the interpreter.
    if (!endsWithBranch && !pairs.empty())
    {
        const uint32_t nextPc = startPc + static_cast<uint32_t>(pairs.size()) * 8u;
        if (nextPc + 8u <= codeSize && recordsForBranch(pairs.back(), getDecodedInstructionPairForPc(vuCode, codeSize, memory, nextPc)))
            pairs.pop_back();
    }

    // Callouts run with m_cycle at the block entry; the interpreter sees its own cycle.
    const auto upperCall = +[](VU1Interpreter *self, uint32_t instr, uint32_t offset)
    {
        const uint64_t entry = self->m_cycle;
        self->m_cycle = entry + offset;
        self->commitReadyPipelines();
        self->execUpper(instr);
        self->m_cycle = entry;
    };
    const auto lowerCall = +[](VU1Interpreter *self, uint32_t instr, uint32_t offset)
    {
        const uint64_t entry = self->m_cycle;
        self->m_cycle = entry + offset;
        self->commitReadyPipelines();
        self->execLower(instr, self->m_activeVuData, self->m_activeVuDataSize, *self->m_activeGs, self->m_activeMemory, 0u);
        // Stores land at the next cycle boundary; later pairs of the block read memory directly.
        self->m_cycle = entry + offset + 1u;
        self->commitReadyPipelines();
        self->m_cycle = entry;
    };
    // Branch callouts: the interpreter computes the target from m_state.pc, so it gets the
    // pair's pc (packed above the cycle offset). It reads the VI backup only when the pair
    // before it recorded one; "clear" drops a backup left from outside the block.
    const auto branchCall = +[](VU1Interpreter *self, uint32_t instr, uint32_t packed)
    {
        const uint64_t entry = self->m_cycle;
        const uint32_t savedPc = self->m_state.pc;
        self->m_cycle = entry + (packed & 0xFFFFu);
        self->commitReadyPipelines();
        self->m_state.pc = packed >> 16;
        self->execLower(instr, self->m_activeVuData, self->m_activeVuDataSize, *self->m_activeGs, self->m_activeMemory, 0u);
        self->m_viBranchBackupValid = false;
        self->m_state.pc = savedPc;
        self->m_cycle = entry;
    };
    const auto branchCallClear = +[](VU1Interpreter *self, uint32_t instr, uint32_t packed)
    {
        self->m_viBranchBackupValid = false;
        const uint64_t entry = self->m_cycle;
        const uint32_t savedPc = self->m_state.pc;
        self->m_cycle = entry + (packed & 0xFFFFu);
        self->commitReadyPipelines();
        self->m_state.pc = packed >> 16;
        self->execLower(instr, self->m_activeVuData, self->m_activeVuDataSize, *self->m_activeGs, self->m_activeMemory, 0u);
        self->m_viBranchBackupValid = false;
        self->m_state.pc = savedPc;
        self->m_cycle = entry;
    };
    const auto recordCall = +[](VU1Interpreter *self, uint32_t instr, uint32_t offset)
    {
        const uint64_t entry = self->m_cycle;
        self->m_cycle = entry + offset;
        self->commitReadyPipelines();
        const uint16_t viWrite = self->decodeLowerUsage(instr).viWrite & 0xFFFEu;
        const uint8_t written = viWrite != 0u ? static_cast<uint8_t>(__builtin_ctz(viWrite)) : 0u;
        const int32_t oldVi = self->m_state.vi[written];
        self->execLower(instr, self->m_activeVuData, self->m_activeVuDataSize, *self->m_activeGs, self->m_activeMemory, 0u);
        self->m_viBranchBackupValid = false;
        self->recordViWriteForBranch(written, oldVi);
        self->m_cycle = entry + offset + 1u;
        self->commitReadyPipelines();
        self->m_cycle = entry;
    };
    // An FDIV result landing inside the block: readers from its ready cycle on see it.
    // The real commit (status flags too) still happens on the interpreter's schedule.
    // XGKICK ends its block: the cycles before it pass for real, it waits for the previous
    // PATH1 transfer like the interpreter's stall, and its issue cycle ends the block.
    const auto xgkickCall = +[](VU1Interpreter *self, uint32_t instr, uint32_t offset)
    {
        self->advanceTo(self->m_cycle + offset);
        const uint64_t issue = self->m_cycle;
        while (self->m_xgkick.active)
            self->advanceOneCycle();
        self->m_jit->xgkickStall = self->m_cycle - issue;
        self->execLower(instr, self->m_activeVuData, self->m_activeVuDataSize, *self->m_activeGs, self->m_activeMemory, 0u);
        self->advanceOneCycle();
    };
    const auto qSyncCall = +[](VU1Interpreter *self, uint32_t, uint32_t offset)
    {
        if (self->m_fdiv.valid && self->m_fdiv.readyCycle <= self->m_cycle + offset)
            self->m_state.q = self->m_fdiv.value;
    };
    if (pairs.size() < kMinBlockPairs)
        return &jit.noBlock;

    uint64_t hash = 0xCBF29CE484222325ull ^ (static_cast<uint64_t>(startPc) << 32) ^ dataSize ^ (jit.compileQSync ? 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull : 0u);
    for (const DecodedInstructionPair &pair : pairs)
    {
        hash = (hash ^ pair.lower) * 0x100000001B3ull;
        hash = (hash ^ pair.upper) * 0x100000001B3ull;
    }
    hash ^= static_cast<uint64_t>(pairs.size()) << 48;
    if (const auto found = jit.known.find(hash); found != jit.known.end())
        return found->second;

    auto block = std::make_unique<JitBlock>();
    uint32_t vfReady[32][4]{};
    bool vfWritten[32][4]{};
    uint32_t viReady[16]{};
    bool viWritten[16]{};
    uint32_t accReady[4]{};
    bool accWritten[4]{};
    uint32_t cycle = 0u;

    // Stall from writes inside the block, as calculatePairReadyCycle would see them.
    const auto innerReady = [&](const InstructionUsage &usage, uint32_t ready)
    {
        for (uint32_t index = 0u; index < usage.vfReadCount; ++index)
        {
            const VfAccess &access = usage.vfRead[index];
            for (uint32_t lane = 0u; lane < 4u; ++lane)
                if ((access.lanes & laneForComponent(lane)) != 0u && vfWritten[access.reg][lane])
                    ready = std::max(ready, vfReady[access.reg][lane]);
        }
        for (uint32_t reg = 1u; reg < 16u; ++reg)
            if ((usage.viRead & (1u << reg)) != 0u && viWritten[reg])
                ready = std::max(ready, viReady[reg]);
        for (uint32_t lane = 0u; lane < 4u; ++lane)
            if ((usage.accRead & laneForComponent(lane)) != 0u && accWritten[lane])
                ready = std::max(ready, accReady[lane]);
        return ready;
    };
    // Values from outside the block are checked at entry, at this pair's final offset.
    const auto recordOuterReads = [&](const InstructionUsage &usage)
    {
        const uint16_t offset = static_cast<uint16_t>(cycle);
        for (uint32_t index = 0u; index < usage.vfReadCount; ++index)
        {
            const VfAccess &access = usage.vfRead[index];
            for (uint32_t lane = 0u; lane < 4u; ++lane)
                if ((access.lanes & laneForComponent(lane)) != 0u && !vfWritten[access.reg][lane])
                    block->reads.push_back({0u, access.reg, static_cast<uint8_t>(lane), offset});
        }
        for (uint32_t reg = 1u; reg < 16u; ++reg)
            if ((usage.viRead & (1u << reg)) != 0u && !viWritten[reg])
                block->reads.push_back({1u, static_cast<uint8_t>(reg), 0u, offset});
        for (uint32_t lane = 0u; lane < 4u; ++lane)
            if ((usage.accRead & laneForComponent(lane)) != 0u && !accWritten[lane])
                block->reads.push_back({2u, 0u, static_cast<uint8_t>(lane), offset});
    };
    const auto markVf = [&](const VfAccess &access, uint32_t latency)
    {
        for (uint32_t lane = 0u; lane < 4u; ++lane)
        {
            if ((access.lanes & laneForComponent(lane)) != 0u)
            {
                vfWritten[access.reg][lane] = true;
                vfReady[access.reg][lane] = cycle + latency;
            }
        }
    };

    const auto selfOffset = [this](const void *member)
    { return static_cast<uint32_t>(static_cast<const uint8_t *>(member) - reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(this)); };
    const uint32_t backupValueOffset = selfOffset(&m_viBranchBackupValue);
    const uint32_t backupRegOffset = selfOffset(&m_viBranchBackupReg);
    const uint32_t backupValidOffset = selfOffset(&m_viBranchBackupValid);
    Assembler a;
    loadJitConstants(a);
    bool finiteVf[32]{};
    finiteVf[0] = true; // (0, 0, 0, 1), writes are dropped
    for (size_t index = 0; index < pairs.size(); ++index)
    {
        const DecodedInstructionPair &pair = pairs[index];
        const uint32_t pairPc = startPc + static_cast<uint32_t>(index) * 8u;
        const bool branchPair = isBranch(pair);
        // A delay slot that writes VI records too: the pair at the branch target may be a branch.
        const bool delaySlotRecords = endsWithBranch && index + 1u == pairs.size() && !pair.iBit &&
                                      pair.lowerUsage.delaysNextBranchRead && (pair.lowerUsage.viWrite & 0xFFFEu) != 0u;
        const bool recordPair = delaySlotRecords || (index + 1u < pairs.size() && recordsForBranch(pair, pairs[index + 1u]));
        const bool backupFromPrevious = index == 0u || recordsForBranch(pairs[index - 1u], pair);
        // Inline forms. A branch at the block's start may read a backup from outside: callout.
        const bool nativeBranch = branchPair && index != 0u && branchIsNative(pair.lower);
        const bool nativeRecord = recordPair && lowerIsSupported(pair.lower) &&
                                  (delaySlotRecords || branchIsNative(pairs[index + 1u].lower));
        cycle = innerReady(pair.lowerUsage, innerReady(pair.upperUsage, cycle));
        recordOuterReads(pair.upperUsage);
        recordOuterReads(pair.lowerUsage);

        const UpperOp upper = decodeUpper(pair.upper);
        const bool clipUpper = upperIsClip(pair.upper);
        if (upperReadsQ(upper))
        {
            if (block->qFirstOffset == JitBlock::kNone)
                block->qFirstOffset = static_cast<uint16_t>(cycle);
            block->qLastOffset = static_cast<uint16_t>(cycle);
            if (jit.compileQSync && cycle != 0u)
                emitCallout(a, reinterpret_cast<const void *>(qSyncCall), 0u, cycle);
        }
        if (clipUpper)
            emitCallout(a, reinterpret_cast<const void *>(upperCall), pair.upper, cycle);
        else
            emitUpper(a, pair.upper, upper, reinterpret_cast<const void *>(&VU1Interpreter::jitFmacFixup), finiteVf);
        if (pair.iBit)
        {
            uint32_t immediate = pair.lower;
            float value = 0.0f;
            std::memcpy(&value, &immediate, sizeof(value));
            value = normalizeOperand(value);
            std::memcpy(&immediate, &value, sizeof(immediate));
            a.storeImm32(iOffset(), immediate);
        }
        else if (nativeBranch)
        {
            // The pair before it left the old value of the VI it wrote in the backup slot.
            const uint32_t backupReg = backupFromPrevious ? static_cast<uint32_t>(__builtin_ctz(pairs[index - 1u].lowerUsage.viWrite & 0xFFFEu)) : 0u;
            const uint8_t opHi = (pair.lower >> 25) & 0x7Fu;
            size_t skip = 0u;
            if (backupFromPrevious) // a record callout leaves it set
                a.storeSelfImm8(backupValidOffset, 0u);
            if (opHi != 0x20u)
            {
                const uint32_t is = VIS(pair.lower), it = VIT(pair.lower);
                if (is == backupReg && is != 0u) a.loadSelfEax(backupValueOffset); else a.loadViEax(viOffset(is));
                if (it == backupReg && it != 0u) a.loadSelfEcx(backupValueOffset); else a.loadViEcx(viOffset(it));
                a.cmpAxCx();
                skip = opHi == 0x28u ? a.jnzFar() : a.jzFar();
            }
            a.storeImm8(static_cast<uint32_t>(offsetof(VU1State, branchPending)), 1u);
            a.storeImm32(static_cast<uint32_t>(offsetof(VU1State, branchTarget)),
                         (pairPc + 8u + static_cast<uint32_t>(static_cast<int32_t>(IMM11(pair.lower)) * 8)) & microAddressMask());
            a.storeImm32(static_cast<uint32_t>(offsetof(VU1State, branchDelay)), 1u);
            if (opHi != 0x20u)
                a.patchJump(skip);
        }
        else if (nativeRecord)
        {
            const uint32_t written = static_cast<uint32_t>(__builtin_ctz(pair.lowerUsage.viWrite & 0xFFFEu));
            a.loadViEax(viOffset(written));
            a.storeSelfEax(backupValueOffset);
            if (delaySlotRecords) // the branch that may read it is outside the block
            {
                a.storeSelfImm8(backupRegOffset, static_cast<uint8_t>(written));
                a.storeSelfImm8(backupValidOffset, 1u);
            }
            emitLower(a, pair.lower, dataMask, pair.suppressedLowerVf);
        }
        else if (branchPair)
        {
            emitCallout(a, reinterpret_cast<const void *>(backupFromPrevious ? branchCall : branchCallClear), pair.lower,
                        (pairPc << 16) | static_cast<uint32_t>(cycle));
        }
        else if (recordPair)
        {
            emitCallout(a, reinterpret_cast<const void *>(recordCall), pair.lower, cycle);
        }
        else if (lowerIsXgkick(pair.lower))
        {
            emitCallout(a, reinterpret_cast<const void *>(xgkickCall), pair.lower, cycle);
            block->xgkickOffset = static_cast<uint16_t>(cycle);
            block->xgkickPairReadsQ = upperReadsQ(upper);
            block->xgkickVfWrite = pair.upperUsage.vfWrite;
            block->xgkickAccWrite = pair.upperUsage.accWrite;
        }
        else if (lowerIsCallout(pair.lower))
        {
            emitCallout(a, reinterpret_cast<const void *>(lowerCall), pair.lower, cycle);
            if (pair.lowerUsage.pipeline == PipelineFdiv)
                block->fdivOffset = static_cast<uint16_t>(cycle);
            else if (pair.lowerUsage.pipeline == PipelineEfu)
                block->efuOffset = static_cast<uint16_t>(cycle);
        }
        else
        {
            emitLower(a, pair.lower, dataMask, pair.suppressedLowerVf);
        }
        if (!clipUpper && upper.kind != UpperKind::Nop)
        {
            if (upper.toAcc)
                emitStoreAcc(a, DEST(pair.upper), 0);
            else if (upper.kind == UpperKind::Itof || upper.kind == UpperKind::Ftoi || upper.kind == UpperKind::Abs)
                emitStoreVf(a, FT(pair.upper), DEST(pair.upper), 0);
            else
                emitStoreVf(a, FD(pair.upper), DEST(pair.upper), 0);
            if (!upper.toAcc && upper.kind != UpperKind::Unsupported)
            {
                const bool targetsFt = upper.kind == UpperKind::Itof || upper.kind == UpperKind::Ftoi || upper.kind == UpperKind::Abs;
                const uint32_t target = targetsFt ? FT(pair.upper) : FD(pair.upper);
                if (target != 0u && DEST(pair.upper) != 0u)
                {
                    if (upper.kind == UpperKind::Ftoi) // integer bit patterns
                        finiteVf[target] = false;
                    else if (DEST(pair.upper) == 0xFu)
                        finiteVf[target] = true; // lanes not written keep their old state otherwise
                }
            }
        }
        if (pair.lowerUsage.vfWrite.reg != 0u)
            finiteVf[pair.lowerUsage.vfWrite.reg] = false;

        const VfAccess lowerWrite = pair.lowerUsage.vfWrite;
        if (!pair.iBit && lowerWrite.reg != 0u && pair.suppressedLowerVf != lowerWrite.reg)
            markVf(lowerWrite, pair.lowerUsage.vfLatency != 0u ? pair.lowerUsage.vfLatency : pair.lowerUsage.latency);
        if (pair.upperUsage.vfWrite.reg != 0u)
            markVf(pair.upperUsage.vfWrite, pair.upperUsage.vfLatency != 0u ? pair.upperUsage.vfLatency : pair.upperUsage.latency);
        if (!pair.iBit)
        {
            for (uint32_t reg = 1u; reg < 16u; ++reg)
            {
                if ((pair.lowerUsage.viWrite & (1u << reg)) != 0u)
                {
                    viWritten[reg] = true;
                    viReady[reg] = cycle + (pair.lowerUsage.viLatency != 0u ? pair.lowerUsage.viLatency : pair.lowerUsage.latency);
                }
            }
        }
        for (uint32_t lane = 0u; lane < 4u; ++lane)
        {
            if ((pair.upperUsage.accWrite & laneForComponent(lane)) != 0u)
            {
                accWritten[lane] = true;
                accReady[lane] = cycle + kAccForwardLatency;
            }
        }
        ++cycle;
    }
    a.ret();

    for (uint32_t reg = 1u; reg < 32u; ++reg)
        for (uint32_t lane = 0u; lane < 4u; ++lane)
            if (vfWritten[reg][lane])
                block->writes.push_back({0u, static_cast<uint8_t>(reg), static_cast<uint8_t>(lane), static_cast<uint16_t>(vfReady[reg][lane])});
    for (uint32_t reg = 1u; reg < 16u; ++reg)
        if (viWritten[reg])
            block->writes.push_back({1u, static_cast<uint8_t>(reg), 0u, static_cast<uint16_t>(viReady[reg])});
    for (uint32_t lane = 0u; lane < 4u; ++lane)
        if (accWritten[lane])
            block->writes.push_back({2u, 0u, static_cast<uint8_t>(lane), static_cast<uint16_t>(accReady[lane])});

    std::stable_sort(block->reads.begin(), block->reads.end(), [](const auto &x, const auto &y)
                     { return x.offset < y.offset; });
    std::stable_sort(block->writes.begin(), block->writes.end(), [](const auto &x, const auto &y)
                     { return x.offset > y.offset; });

    uint8_t *code = g_codeArena.place(a.bytes);
    if (code == nullptr)
        return &jit.noBlock;
    block->function = reinterpret_cast<JitBlock::Function>(code);
    block->pairs = static_cast<uint32_t>(pairs.size());
    block->cycles = cycle;
    block->endsWithBranch = endsWithBranch;
    block->startsWithBranch = isBranch(pairs.front());
    JitBlock *result = block.release();
    jit.known.emplace(hash, result);
    return result;
}

void VU1Interpreter::prepareJitTable(const uint8_t *vuCode, uint32_t codeSize, PS2Memory *memory)
{
    JitState &jit = *m_jit;
    const uint64_t generation = memory == nullptr ? 0u : m_unit == Unit::VU1 ? memory->getVU1CodeGeneration() : memory->getVU0CodeGeneration();
    if (jit.generation == generation)
        return;
    jit.generation = generation;
    // Four independent FNV lanes: a single chain waits on one multiply per 8 bytes (~320 swaps/s of 16 KB).
    uint64_t lanes[4] = {0xCBF29CE484222325ull, 0x84222325CBF29CE4ull, 0x100000001B3ull, 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull};
    uint32_t offset = 0u;
    for (; offset + 32u <= codeSize; offset += 32u)
        for (uint32_t lane = 0u; lane < 4u; ++lane)
        {
            uint64_t word = 0u;
            std::memcpy(&word, vuCode + offset + lane * 8u, 8u);
            lanes[lane] = (lanes[lane] ^ word) * 0x100000001B3ull;
        }
    for (; offset + 8u <= codeSize; offset += 8u)
    {
        uint64_t word = 0u;
        std::memcpy(&word, vuCode + offset, 8u);
        lanes[0] = (lanes[0] ^ word) * 0x100000001B3ull;
    }
    uint64_t codeHash = 0xCBF29CE484222325ull;
    for (const uint64_t lane : lanes)
        codeHash = (codeHash ^ lane) * 0x100000001B3ull;
    if (jit.tablesByCode.size() >= 256u) // a game that streams code: start over (blocks stay in known)
        jit.tablesByCode.clear();
    std::unique_ptr<JitState::Tables> &cached = jit.tablesByCode[codeHash];
    const bool known = cached != nullptr;
    if (!known)
        cached = std::make_unique<JitState::Tables>();
    jit.tables = cached.get();
    if (known)
        return;
    const uint32_t count = std::min(codeSize / 8u, kMaxDecodedPairs);
    for (uint32_t index = 0u; index < count; ++index)
    {
        uint32_t lower = 0u, upper = 0u;
        std::memcpy(&lower, vuCode + index * 8u, 4u);
        std::memcpy(&upper, vuCode + index * 8u + 4u, 4u);
        // VU0: the EE reads MAC/STATUS (CFC2) once the program stops, so its end counts
        // as a flag reader. A VU1 program's end is observed by no one.
        if (m_unit == Unit::VU0 && (upper & 0x40000000u) != 0u)
        {
            const uint32_t first = index > kFlagReaderWindow ? index - kFlagReaderWindow : 0u;
            for (uint32_t covered = first; covered <= index + 1u && covered < count; ++covered) // + delay slot
                jit.tables->nearFlagReader[covered] = true;
            continue;
        }
        const uint8_t opHi = (lower >> 25) & 0x7Fu;
        const bool readsArithmeticFlags = opHi == 0x14u || opHi == 0x16u || opHi == 0x17u ||
                                          opHi == 0x18u || opHi == 0x1Au || opHi == 0x1Bu;
        if (!readsArithmeticFlags || (upper & 0x80000000u) != 0u)
            continue;
        const uint32_t first = index > kFlagReaderWindow ? index - kFlagReaderWindow : 0u;
        for (uint32_t covered = first; covered <= index; ++covered)
            jit.tables->nearFlagReader[covered] = true;
    }
}

bool VU1Interpreter::jitActiveFor(uint8_t *vuCode, PS2Memory *memory) const
{
    return m_jitEnabled && m_jit != nullptr && m_jit->pairsLeft == 0u && memory != nullptr &&
           vuCode == (m_unit == Unit::VU1 ? memory->getVU1Code() : memory->getVU0Code());
}

bool VU1Interpreter::runJitBlock(uint8_t *vuCode, uint32_t codeSize, uint8_t *vuData, uint32_t dataSize,
                                 GS &gs, PS2Memory *memory, uint64_t budgetEnd)
{
    JitState &jit = *m_jit;
    const uint32_t pairIndex = m_state.pc / 8u;
    if ((m_state.pc & 7u) != 0u || pairIndex >= kMaxDecodedPairs)
        return false;
    prepareJitTable(vuCode, codeSize, memory);

    JitBlock *block = jit.tables->blocks[pairIndex];
    if (block == nullptr)
    {
        block = compileJitBlock(vuCode, codeSize, memory, m_state.pc, dataSize);
        jit.tables->blocks[pairIndex] = block;
    }
    if (block->function == nullptr)
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (m_cycle != jit.exitCycle)
    {
        uint64_t most = 0u;
        for (const auto &lanes : m_vfReady)
            for (const uint64_t ready : lanes)
                most = std::max(most, ready);
        for (const uint64_t ready : m_viReady)
            most = std::max(most, ready);
        for (const uint64_t ready : m_accReady)
            most = std::max(most, ready);
        jit.readyMax = most;
    }
    uint64_t entry = m_cycle;
    // A read at offset o stalls only if its value is ready after m_cycle + o.
    const uint64_t horizon = jit.readyMax > m_cycle ? jit.readyMax - m_cycle : 0u;
    for (const JitBlock::Timing &read : block->reads)
    {
        if (read.offset >= horizon)
            break;
        const uint64_t ready = read.kind == 0u   ? m_vfReady[read.reg][read.lane]
                               : read.kind == 1u ? m_viReady[read.reg]
                                                 : m_accReady[read.lane];
        if (ready > entry + read.offset)
            entry = ready - read.offset;
    }
    if (entry + block->cycles >= budgetEnd)
        return false;
    // A busy FDIV or EFU would stall the pair: leave that to the interpreter.
    if (block->fdivOffset != JitBlock::kNone && m_fdiv.valid && m_fdiv.readyCycle > entry + block->fdivOffset)
        return false;
    // A reader at offset o sees the FDIV result when it lands by entry + o.
    const bool qLandsFirst = block->qFirstOffset != JitBlock::kNone && m_fdiv.valid && m_fdiv.readyCycle > entry &&
                             m_fdiv.readyCycle <= entry + block->qFirstOffset;
    if (block->qFirstOffset != JitBlock::kNone && m_fdiv.valid && m_fdiv.readyCycle > entry + block->qFirstOffset &&
        m_fdiv.readyCycle <= entry + block->qLastOffset)
    {
        if (block->qSyncVariant == nullptr)
        {
            jit.compileQSync = true;
            block->qSyncVariant = compileJitBlock(vuCode, codeSize, memory, m_state.pc, dataSize);
            jit.compileQSync = false;
        }
        block = block->qSyncVariant;
        if (block->function == nullptr)
            return false;
    }
    if (block->efuOffset != JitBlock::kNone && m_efuResourceReady > entry + block->efuOffset)
        return false;
    // The checker can't replay a stall that already finished the previous transfer.
    if (block->xgkickOffset != JitBlock::kNone && m_xgkick.active && (block->xgkickPairReadsQ || jit.checkInterval != 0u))
        return false;
    jit.xgkickStall = 0u;
    if (entry != m_cycle)
        advanceTo(entry);
    // The interpreter drops the VI backup after the pair that follows the write; only a
    // branch at the block's start still reads it (see branchCall).
    if (!block->startsWithBranch)
        m_viBranchBackupValid = false;
    if (qLandsFirst)
        m_state.q = m_fdiv.value; // what every reader would see; the commit writes it again

    const auto applyBlockTiming = [&]
    {
        // A write ready by the block's end can be skipped when the value it replaces is
        // too: past ready cycles never stall anything.
        const bool oldMayBeLate = jit.readyMax > entry + block->cycles;
        for (const JitBlock::Timing &write : block->writes)
        {
            if (write.offset <= block->cycles && !oldMayBeLate)
                break;
            const uint64_t ready = entry + write.offset;
            if (write.kind == 0u)
                m_vfReady[write.reg][write.lane] = ready;
            else if (write.kind == 1u)
                m_viReady[write.reg] = ready;
            else
                m_accReady[write.lane] = ready;
        }
    };
    const auto finishCycles = [&]
    {
        advanceTo(entry + block->cycles);
    };

    if (jit.checkInterval != 0u && jit.seenBlocks++ % jit.checkInterval == 0u)
    {
        const VU1State before = m_state;
        const uint64_t cycleBefore = m_cycle;
        const auto vfReadyBefore = m_vfReady;
        const auto viReadyBefore = m_viReady;
        const auto accReadyBefore = m_accReady;
        const auto flagsBefore = m_flagPipeline;
        const auto fdivBefore = m_fdiv;
        const auto efuBefore = m_efu;
        const auto storesBefore = m_storePipeline;
        const auto xgkickBefore = m_xgkick;
        const uint64_t efuReadyBefore = m_efuResourceReady;
        const uint64_t nextPipelineBefore = m_nextPipelineCycle;
        const uint32_t workingClipBefore = m_workingClip;
        const bool backupValidBefore = m_viBranchBackupValid;
        const int32_t backupValueBefore = m_viBranchBackupValue;
        const uint8_t backupRegBefore = m_viBranchBackupReg;
        std::vector<uint8_t> dataBefore(vuData, vuData + dataSize);

        block->function(&m_state, vuData, this);
        m_state.pc = before.pc + block->pairs * 8u;
        if (block->endsWithBranch && m_state.branchPending)
        {
            m_state.pc = m_state.branchTarget & microAddressMask();
            m_state.branchPending = false;
            m_state.branchDelay = 0u;
        }
        m_cycle = entry + block->cycles; // Q, P and CLIP as the interpreter will have them
        commitReadyPipelines();
        const VU1State jitState = m_state;
        std::vector<uint8_t> dataJit(vuData, vuData + dataSize);

        m_state = before;
        m_cycle = cycleBefore;
        m_vfReady = vfReadyBefore;
        m_viReady = viReadyBefore;
        m_accReady = accReadyBefore;
        m_flagPipeline = flagsBefore;
        m_fdiv = fdivBefore;
        m_efu = efuBefore;
        m_storePipeline = storesBefore;
        m_xgkick = xgkickBefore;
        m_efuResourceReady = efuReadyBefore;
        m_nextPipelineCycle = nextPipelineBefore;
        m_workingClip = workingClipBefore;
        m_viBranchBackupValid = backupValidBefore;
        m_viBranchBackupValue = backupValueBefore;
        m_viBranchBackupReg = backupRegBefore;
        std::memcpy(vuData, dataBefore.data(), dataSize);

        jit.pairsLeft = block->pairs;
        run(vuCode, codeSize, vuData, dataSize, gs, memory, static_cast<uint32_t>(budgetEnd - m_cycle));
        jit.pairsLeft = 0u;

        ++jit.checkedBlocks;
        const bool sameVf = std::memcmp(jitState.vf, m_state.vf, sizeof(m_state.vf)) == 0;
        const bool sameVi = std::memcmp(jitState.vi, m_state.vi, sizeof(m_state.vi)) == 0;
        const bool sameAcc = std::memcmp(jitState.acc, m_state.acc, sizeof(m_state.acc)) == 0;
        const bool sameData = std::memcmp(dataJit.data(), vuData, dataSize) == 0;
        const bool sameQpc = std::memcmp(&jitState.q, &m_state.q, sizeof(float)) == 0 &&
                             std::memcmp(&jitState.p, &m_state.p, sizeof(float)) == 0 && jitState.clip == m_state.clip;
        const bool sameCycles = entry + block->cycles == m_cycle && jitState.pc == m_state.pc;
        jit.cycleMismatches += sameCycles ? 0u : 1u;
        if (!sameVf || !sameVi || !sameAcc || !sameQpc || !sameData || !sameCycles)
        {
            static std::vector<uint32_t> reportedPcs;
            ++jit.mismatches;
            if (reportedPcs.size() < 8u && std::find(reportedPcs.begin(), reportedPcs.end(), before.pc) == reportedPcs.end() &&
                (reportedPcs.push_back(before.pc), true))
            {
                std::fprintf(stderr, "[vu-jit] mismatch pc=0x%x pairs=%u vf=%d vi=%d acc=%d qpclip=%d data=%d cycles jit=%llu int=%llu\n",
                             before.pc, block->pairs, sameVf, sameVi, sameAcc, sameQpc, sameData,
                             static_cast<unsigned long long>(entry + block->cycles),
                             static_cast<unsigned long long>(m_cycle));
                for (uint32_t reg = 0u; reg < 32u; ++reg)
                {
                    if (std::memcmp(jitState.vf[reg], m_state.vf[reg], 16u) != 0)
                    {
                        uint32_t j[4], i[4];
                        std::memcpy(j, jitState.vf[reg], 16u);
                        std::memcpy(i, m_state.vf[reg], 16u);
                        std::fprintf(stderr, "[vu-jit]   vf%u jit=%08x,%08x,%08x,%08x int=%08x,%08x,%08x,%08x\n", reg,
                                     j[0], j[1], j[2], j[3], i[0], i[1], i[2], i[3]);
                    }
                }
                for (uint32_t pair = 0u; pair < block->pairs; ++pair)
                {
                    uint32_t lower = 0u, upper = 0u;
                    std::memcpy(&lower, vuCode + before.pc + pair * 8u, 4u);
                    std::memcpy(&upper, vuCode + before.pc + pair * 8u + 4u, 4u);
                    std::fprintf(stderr, "[vu-jit]   pair %u: upper=%08x lower=%08x\n", pair, upper, lower);
                }
                uint32_t accBits[4], qBits = 0u, iBits = 0u;
                std::memcpy(accBits, before.acc, 16u);
                std::memcpy(&qBits, &before.q, 4u);
                std::memcpy(&iBits, &before.i, 4u);
                std::fprintf(stderr, "[vu-jit]   in acc=%08x,%08x,%08x,%08x q=%08x i=%08x\n",
                             accBits[0], accBits[1], accBits[2], accBits[3], qBits, iBits);
                uint32_t beforeBits[32][4];
                std::memcpy(beforeBits, before.vf, sizeof(beforeBits));
                for (uint32_t reg = 1u; reg < 32u; ++reg)
                    std::fprintf(stderr, "[vu-jit]   in vf%u=%08x,%08x,%08x,%08x\n", reg,
                                 beforeBits[reg][0], beforeBits[reg][1], beforeBits[reg][2], beforeBits[reg][3]);
            }
        }
        if ((jit.checkedBlocks & 0xFFFFFu) == 0u)
            std::fprintf(stderr, "[vu-jit] checked=%llu mismatches=%llu cycle-only-or-more=%llu\n",
                         static_cast<unsigned long long>(jit.checkedBlocks),
                         static_cast<unsigned long long>(jit.mismatches),
                         static_cast<unsigned long long>(jit.cycleMismatches));
        return true;
    }

    block->function(&m_state, vuData, this);
    m_state.pc += block->pairs * 8u;
    if (block->endsWithBranch && m_state.branchPending)
    {
        m_state.pc = m_state.branchTarget & microAddressMask();
        m_state.branchPending = false;
        m_state.branchDelay = 0u;
    }
    applyBlockTiming();
    if (jit.xgkickStall != 0u) // the XGKICK pair issued that much later
    {
        for (uint32_t lane = 0u; lane < 4u; ++lane)
        {
            if (block->xgkickVfWrite.reg != 0u && (block->xgkickVfWrite.lanes & laneForComponent(lane)) != 0u)
                m_vfReady[block->xgkickVfWrite.reg][lane] += jit.xgkickStall;
            if ((block->xgkickAccWrite & laneForComponent(lane)) != 0u)
                m_accReady[lane] += jit.xgkickStall;
        }
    }
    if (!block->writes.empty())
        jit.readyMax = std::max(jit.readyMax, entry + block->writes.front().offset + jit.xgkickStall);
    finishCycles();
    jit.exitCycle = m_cycle;
    return true;
}

bool VU1Interpreter::jitCheckPairDone()
{
    return m_jit != nullptr && m_jit->pairsLeft != 0u && --m_jit->pairsLeft == 0u;
}

void VU1Interpreter::jitFmacFixup(VU1Interpreter *self, uint32_t instr, float *result)
{
    self->m_currentUpperInstruction = instr;
    uint8_t laneFlags[4]{};
    self->normalizeFmacResult(result, DEST(instr), laneFlags);
}
```

`patches/ps2_vu1_thread.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "ps2_vu1_thread.h"
#include "runtime/ps2_perf.h"

#include <atomic>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <deque>
#include <mutex>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

namespace ps2_vu1_thread
{
    namespace
    {
        struct Job
        {
            std::vector<uint8_t> data;
            uint32_t fbrst = 0u;
        };

        Hooks g_hooks;
        std::thread g_thread;
        std::mutex g_mutex;
        std::condition_variable g_work, g_idle;
        std::deque<Job> g_jobs;
        std::vector<std::vector<uint8_t>> g_spare; // reused job buffers
        bool g_busy = false, g_stop = false, g_running = false;
        std::atomic<bool> g_pending{false}; // queue not empty or a job running: sync's fast path
        std::atomic<uint32_t> g_stopBits{0u};
        std::atomic<bool> g_stopBitsNew{false};
        thread_local bool t_worker = false;
        uint32_t g_jobFbrst = 0u; // VU1 thread only

        void loop()
        {
            pthread_setname_np(pthread_self(), "VU1Thread"); // PS2X_PROFILE_THREAD picks threads by name
            ps2_perf::pinHeavyThread(ps2_perf::HeavyThread::Vu1);
            t_worker = true;
            std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(g_mutex);
            while (true)
            {
                g_work.wait(lock, [] { return g_stop || !g_jobs.empty(); });
                if (g_jobs.empty())
                    break;
                Job job = std::move(g_jobs.front());
                g_jobs.pop_front();
                g_busy = true;
                lock.unlock();
                g_jobFbrst = job.fbrst;
                g_hooks.processVif1(job.data.data(), static_cast<uint32_t>(job.data.size()));
                lock.lock();
                g_busy = false;
                job.data.clear();
                if (g_spare.size() < 8u)
                    g_spare.push_back(std::move(job.data));
                if (g_jobs.empty())
                {
                    g_pending.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
                    g_idle.notify_all();
                }
            }
        }
    }

    bool enabled()
    {
        static const bool on = []
        {
            const char *setting = std::getenv("PS2X_VU1_THREAD");
            return !(setting && setting[0] == '0');
        }();
        return on && g_running;
    }

    void start(Hooks hooks)
    {
        if (g_running)
            return;
        const char *setting = std::getenv("PS2X_VU1_THREAD");
        if (setting && setting[0] == '0')
            return;
        g_hooks = std::move(hooks);
        g_stop = false;
        g_running = true;
        g_thread = std::thread(loop);
    }

    void stop()
    {
        if (!g_running)
            return;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_mutex);
            g_stop = true;
        }
        g_work.notify_all();
        g_thread.join();
        g_running = false;
    }

    bool onWorker()
    {
        return t_worker;
    }

    void submit(const uint8_t *data, uint32_t size)
    {
        if (size == 0u)
            return;
        Job job;
        job.fbrst = g_hooks.readFbrst ? g_hooks.readFbrst() : 0u;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_mutex);
            if (!g_spare.empty())
            {
                job.data = std::move(g_spare.back());
                g_spare.pop_back();
            }
        }
        job.data.assign(data, data + size);
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_mutex);
            g_jobs.push_back(std::move(job));
            g_pending.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        }
        g_work.notify_one();
    }

    void sync()
    {
        if (!g_running || t_worker)
            return;
        if (g_pending.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        {
            std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(g_mutex);
            g_idle.wait(lock, [] { return g_jobs.empty() && !g_busy; });
        }
        if (g_stopBitsNew.exchange(false, std::memory_order_acq_rel) && g_hooks.applyStopBits)
            g_hooks.applyStopBits(g_stopBits.load(std::memory_order_relaxed));
    }

    uint32_t jobFbrst()
    {
        return g_jobFbrst;
    }

    void noteStopBits(uint32_t bits)
    {
        g_stopBits.store(bits, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        g_stopBitsNew.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    }
}
```

`patches/ps2_vu1_thread.h`:

```h
#pragma once
// VU1 on its own thread (like PCSX2's MTVU). The EE thread hands each VIF1 DMA transfer
// (copied, since the game may reuse the buffer once the channel reports done) to the VU1
// thread, which runs the whole VIF1 stream there: unpacks into VU1 memory, MPG, MSCAL
// (the VU1 program to its end) and DIRECT. GIF packets of PATH1 and PATH2 therefore leave
// in VIF1 stream order. The EE thread waits for the queue to drain (sync) before it looks
// at anything that thread owns: VU1 memory, VIF1 registers and FIFO, GS state, its own GIF
// submissions. It always waits for everything, so the game always sees the work done, as
// when VU1 ran inline: the result does not depend on host timing (online lockstep).
// PS2X_VU1_THREAD=0 runs VU1 inline as before.
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>

namespace ps2_vu1_thread
{
    struct Hooks
    {
        std::function<void(const uint8_t *data, uint32_t size)> processVif1; // runs on the VU1 thread
        std::function<uint32_t()> readFbrst;                                 // EE thread: VU0 FBRST now
        std::function<void(uint32_t stopBits)> applyStopBits;                // EE thread: VPU_STAT D/T bits
    };

    bool enabled();
    void start(Hooks hooks);
    void stop();
    bool onWorker();
    // EE thread: queue one VIF1 transfer (copied).
    void submit(const uint8_t *data, uint32_t size);
    // EE thread: wait until every queued transfer ran. No-op on the VU1 thread or when off.
    void sync();
    // VU1 thread: FBRST as the EE had it when the running transfer was queued.
    uint32_t jobFbrst();
    // VU1 thread: D/T stop bits of the last program; the EE gets them at its next sync.
    void noteStopBits(uint32_t bits);
}
```

`patches/ps2_vu_clip.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include "ps2_runtime.h"
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>

// Macro CLIP: six ordered plane bits, then four results of history in 24 bits.
// Compare raw magnitudes so signed W and denormal operands follow VU semantics.
// Micro-mode latency remains managed by VU1Interpreter.
inline void ps2VuClip(R5900Context* ctx, uint32_t instruction) {
    uint32_t source[4], threshold[4];
    std::memcpy(source, &ctx->vu0_vf[(instruction >> 11) & 31u], 16);
    std::memcpy(threshold, &ctx->vu0_vf[(instruction >> 16) & 31u], 16);
    const uint32_t w = threshold[3];
    const uint32_t limit = (w & 0x7f800000u) ? w & 0x7fffffffu : 0x007fffffu;
    uint32_t flags = 0;
    for (unsigned axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis) {
        if ((source[axis] & 0x7fffffffu) > limit)
            flags |= 1u << (axis * 2u + (source[axis] >> 31));
    }
    ctx->vu0_clip_flags = ((ctx->vu0_clip_flags << 6) | flags) & 0x00ffffffu;
}
```

`patches/ps2_vu_sub.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include "ps2_runtime.h"
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <limits>

// Synchronous macro-mode VSUB. Micro-mode scheduling remains in VU1Interpreter.
// Keep VF0 immutable even when the instruction is used only for MAC flags.
inline void ps2VuSub(R5900Context* ctx, uint32_t instruction) {
    const unsigned mask=(instruction>>21)&15u,fd=(instruction>>6)&31u;
    const unsigned fs=(instruction>>11)&31u,ft=(instruction>>16)&31u,op=instruction&63u;
    std::array<float,4> left,right,result;
    std::memcpy(left.data(),&ctx->vu0_vf[fs],16);
    std::memcpy(right.data(),&ctx->vu0_vf[ft],16);
    std::memcpy(result.data(),&ctx->vu0_vf[fd],16);
    const auto normalized=[](float value) {
        uint32_t bits;std::memcpy(&bits,&value,4);
        const unsigned exponent=(bits>>23)&255u;
        if (!exponent) bits&=0x80000000u;
        else if (exponent==255u) bits=(bits&0x80000000u)|0x7f7fffffu;
        std::memcpy(&value,&bits,4);return double(value);
    };
    uint32_t mac=0,status=0;
    for (unsigned component=0;component<4;++component) {
        const unsigned lane=8u>>component;
        if (!(mask&lane)) continue;
        const float rhs=op==0x24u?ctx->vu0_q:op==0x26u?ctx->vu0_i:
                        (op>=4u&&op<=7u)?right[op&3u]:right[component];
        const double exact=normalized(left[component])-normalized(rhs);
        const bool negative=std::signbit(exact);
        const double magnitude=std::fabs(exact);
        uint32_t flags=negative?2u:0u,bits=negative?0x80000000u:0u;
        if (magnitude==0.0) flags|=1u;
        else if (magnitude>std::numeric_limits<float>::max()) {flags|=8u;bits|=0x7f7fffffu;}
        else if (magnitude<std::numeric_limits<float>::min()) flags|=5u;
        else {const float value=static_cast<float>(exact);std::memcpy(&bits,&value,4);}
        std::memcpy(&result[component],&bits,4);
        for (unsigned bit=0;bit<4;++bit) if (flags&(1u<<bit)) mac|=lane<<(bit*4u);
        status|=flags;
    }
    if (fd) std::memcpy(&ctx->vu0_vf[fd],result.data(),16);
    ctx->vu0_mac_flags=mac;
    ctx->vu0_status=static_cast<uint16_t>((ctx->vu0_status&0xff0u)|status|(status<<6u));
}
```
