+// VU MAX/MINI (COP2 macro): denormals count as signed zero, order by sign and magnitude (+0 > -0),
+// like the VU1 interpreter's vuMax/vuMin. _mm_max_ps alone gets -0/+0 and denormals wrong.
+inline __m128i ps2_vu_order_key(__m128i &x)
+{
+    const __m128i den = _mm_cmpeq_epi32(_mm_and_si128(x, _mm_set1_epi32(0x7F800000)), _mm_setzero_si128());
+    x = _mm_blendv_epi8(x, _mm_and_si128(x, _mm_set1_epi32(static_cast<int>(0x80000000u))), den);
+    return _mm_xor_si128(x, _mm_srli_epi32(_mm_srai_epi32(x, 31), 1));
+}
+inline __m128 ps2_vu_max_ps(__m128 a, __m128 b)
+{
+    __m128i ia = _mm_castps_si128(a), ib = _mm_castps_si128(b);
+    const __m128i gt = _mm_cmpgt_epi32(ps2_vu_order_key(ia), ps2_vu_order_key(ib));
+    return _mm_castsi128_ps(_mm_blendv_epi8(ib, ia, gt));
+}
+inline __m128 ps2_vu_min_ps(__m128 a, __m128 b)
+{
+    __m128i ia = _mm_castps_si128(a), ib = _mm_castps_si128(b);
+    const __m128i gt = _mm_cmpgt_epi32(ps2_vu_order_key(ia), ps2_vu_order_key(ib));
+    return _mm_castsi128_ps(_mm_blendv_epi8(ia, ib, gt));
+}
+
+// EE FPU compares: no NaN/Inf (exponent 255 is just a large number) and denormals count as zero.
+// Compare sign-magnitude keys so +0, -0 and denormals are all equal.
+inline int32_t ps2_fcmp_key(float x)
+{
+    uint32_t bits;
+    std::memcpy(&bits, &x, sizeof(bits));
+    if ((bits & 0x7F800000u) == 0u)
+        return 0;
+    const int32_t mag = static_cast<int32_t>(bits & 0x7FFFFFFFu);
+    return (bits >> 31) ? -mag : mag;
+}

+bool EeScheduler::idleCheckpoint() noexcept
+{
+    // The loop only waits for an interrupt to change memory, so jump the clock to the
+    // next event instead of spinning 32 cycles per lap (PCSX2's idle loop skip).
+    // MKSM_NO_IDLE_SKIP=1 restores the plain checkpoint.
+    static const bool disabled = std::getenv("MKSM_NO_IDLE_SKIP") != nullptr;
+    uint64_t cycles = kGeneratedCheckpointCycles;
+    const uint64_t nextEventCycle = m_nextDeadlineCycle.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
+    if (!disabled && nextEventCycle > m_eeCycle)
+        cycles = std::clamp<uint64_t>(nextEventCycle - m_eeCycle, kGeneratedCheckpointCycles, kVBlankPeriodCycles);
+    // Stop at the next EE timer event: a jump past it delivers the interrupt late (game hung at load).
+    if (m_eeTimerBatchLimit > m_eeTimerPendingCycles)
+        cycles = std::max<uint64_t>(kGeneratedCheckpointCycles, std::min<uint64_t>(cycles, m_eeTimerBatchLimit - m_eeTimerPendingCycles));
+    return checkpointDue(static_cast<uint32_t>(cycles));
+}
+
 void EeScheduler::accountCycles(uint32_t cycles) noexcept
 {
     const uint64_t elapsed = std::max<uint64_t>(1u, cycles);
     m_eeCycle += elapsed;
-    m_pendingEeTimerInterrupts |= m_runtime.memory().advanceEeTimers(elapsed);
-    m_runtime.advanceIopEeCycles(elapsed);
+    // Runs after every guest block; the timer update cost 16% of the game thread.
+    // shortcut: timer counts and the GIF FQC clear lag by up to kEeTimerBatchCycles,
+    // so flush on timer register access instead if a game times itself that finely.
+    m_eeTimerPendingCycles += elapsed;
+    if (m_eeTimerPendingCycles >= m_eeTimerBatchLimit)
+        flushEeTimers();
+    m_iopPendingCycles += elapsed;
+    if (m_iopPendingCycles >= 16384u)
+    {
+        m_runtime.advanceIopEeCycles(m_iopPendingCycles);
+        m_iopPendingCycles = 0u;
+    }
     if (m_pendingEeTimerInterrupts != 0u)
     {
         m_checkpointPending.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
     }
 }
 
+void EeScheduler::flushEeTimers() noexcept
+{
+    PS2Memory &memory = m_runtime.memory();
+    m_pendingEeTimerInterrupts |= memory.advanceEeTimers(m_eeTimerPendingCycles);
+    m_eeTimerPendingCycles = 0u;
+    m_eeTimerBatchLimit = std::min<uint64_t>(kEeTimerBatchCycles, memory.cyclesUntilNextEeTimerInterrupt());
+}

+#if PS2X_HAS_FFMPEG

+        // Decodes a movie file (Sofdec .SFD = MPEG program stream) straight from the disc image.
+        class MovieFileSource
+        {
+        public:
+            ~MovieFileSource() { close(); }
+            bool open(const std::string &path)
+            {
+                close();
+                if (avformat_open_input(&m_fmt, path.c_str(), nullptr, nullptr) < 0)
+                    return false;
+                if (avformat_find_stream_info(m_fmt, nullptr) < 0)
+                    return close(), false;
+                m_stream = av_find_best_stream(m_fmt, AVMEDIA_TYPE_VIDEO, -1, -1, nullptr, 0);
+                if (m_stream < 0)
+                    return close(), false;
+                const AVCodecParameters *par = m_fmt->streams[m_stream]->codecpar;
+                const AVCodec *codec = avcodec_find_decoder(par->codec_id);
+                m_codec = codec ? avcodec_alloc_context3(codec) : nullptr;
+                if (!m_codec || avcodec_parameters_to_context(m_codec, par) < 0 || avcodec_open2(m_codec, codec, nullptr) < 0)
+                    return close(), false;
+                m_packet = av_packet_alloc();
+                m_frame = av_frame_alloc();
+                m_path = path;
+                return m_packet && m_frame;
+            }
+            const std::string &path() const { return m_path; }
+            // Compressed video bytes fed to the decoder since the previous picture.
+            uint32_t takeBytes() { const uint32_t b = m_bytes; m_bytes = 0; return b; }
+            // The demuxer has read the whole file (the decoder may still hold pictures).
+            bool inputEnded() const { return m_inputEnded; }
+            // Appends the next decoded picture; false at the end of the file.
+            bool next(std::deque<MpegDecodedFrame> &out)
+            {
+                if (!m_fmt)
+                    return false;
+                for (;;)
+                {
+                    const int got = avcodec_receive_frame(m_codec, m_frame);
+                    if (got == 0)
+                    {
+                        MpegDecodedFrame decoded;
+                        decoded.width = m_frame->width;
+                        decoded.height = m_frame->height;
+                        decoded.repeatPict = m_frame->repeat_pict;
+                        const AVRational tb = m_fmt->streams[m_stream]->time_base;
+                        decoded.pts90k = m_frame->best_effort_timestamp == AV_NOPTS_VALUE ? -1
+                                         : av_rescale_q(m_frame->best_effort_timestamp, tb, AVRational{1, 90000});
+                        m_sws = sws_getCachedContext(m_sws, m_frame->width, m_frame->height, static_cast<AVPixelFormat>(m_frame->format),
+                                                     m_frame->width, m_frame->height, AV_PIX_FMT_RGBA, SWS_BILINEAR, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr);
+                        if (!m_sws)
+                            return false;
+                        decoded.rgba.resize(static_cast<size_t>(m_frame->width) * m_frame->height * 4u);
+                        uint8_t *dst[4] = {decoded.rgba.data(), nullptr, nullptr, nullptr};
+                        const int dstStride[4] = {m_frame->width * 4, 0, 0, 0};
+                        sws_scale(m_sws, m_frame->data, m_frame->linesize, 0, m_frame->height, dst, dstStride);
+                        out.push_back(std::move(decoded));
+                        return true;
+                    }
+                    if (got == AVERROR_EOF)
+                        return false;
+                    // EAGAIN: feed the next video packet (or flush at the end of the file).
+                    int read;
+                    while ((read = av_read_frame(m_fmt, m_packet)) >= 0 && m_packet->stream_index != m_stream)
+                        av_packet_unref(m_packet);
+                    if (read >= 0)
+                        m_bytes += static_cast<uint32_t>(m_packet->size);
+                    else
+                        m_inputEnded = true;
+                    avcodec_send_packet(m_codec, read >= 0 ? m_packet : nullptr);
+                    if (read >= 0)
+                        av_packet_unref(m_packet);
+                }
+            }
+            void close()
+            {
+                sws_freeContext(m_sws);
+                m_sws = nullptr;
+                av_frame_free(&m_frame);
+                av_packet_free(&m_packet);
+                avcodec_free_context(&m_codec);
+                avformat_close_input(&m_fmt);
+                m_path.clear();
+                m_bytes = 0;
+                m_inputEnded = false;
+            }
+
+        private:
+            AVFormatContext *m_fmt = nullptr;
+            AVCodecContext *m_codec = nullptr;
+            AVPacket *m_packet = nullptr;
+            AVFrame *m_frame = nullptr;
+            SwsContext *m_sws = nullptr;
+            int m_stream = -1;
+            uint32_t m_bytes = 0;
+            bool m_inputEnded = false;
+            std::string m_path;
+        };
+
+        // Moves the toIPU DMA (channel 4) forward by `bytes`, walking its tag chain the way the
+        // IPU reads it; at the end of the chain the transfer stops (STR cleared). The player
+        // stops the channel itself to read how far it got (TADR/MADR) before refilling, so the
+        // registers move even while STR is clear.
+        void advanceIpuInDma(uint8_t *rdram, PS2Runtime *runtime, uint32_t bytes)
+        {
+            constexpr uint32_t kChcr = 0x1000B400u, kMadr = 0x1000B410u, kQwc = 0x1000B420u, kTadr = 0x1000B430u;
+            PS2Memory &mem = runtime->memory();
+            uint32_t chcr = mem.readIORegister(kChcr);
+            uint32_t madr = mem.readIORegister(kMadr), qwc = mem.readIORegister(kQwc), tadr = mem.readIORegister(kTadr);
+            uint32_t left = (bytes + 15u) / 16u;
+            const bool chain = ((chcr >> 2) & 0x3u) == 1u;
+            bool last = !chain;
+            for (int guard = 0; guard < 4096; ++guard)
+            {
+                const uint32_t take = std::min(left, qwc);
+                madr += take * 16u, qwc -= take, left -= take;
+                if (qwc != 0u || left == 0u)
+                    break;
+                if (last) // the final tag's data is gone: the transfer is over
+                {
+                    chcr &= ~0x100u;
+                    break;
+                }
+                uint64_t tag = 0;
+                if (const uint8_t *p = getMemPtr(rdram, tadr & 0x01FFFFF0u))
+                    std::memcpy(&tag, p, sizeof(tag));
+                const uint32_t id = static_cast<uint32_t>((tag >> 28) & 0x7u);
+                const uint32_t addr = static_cast<uint32_t>(tag >> 32) & ~0xFu;
+                qwc = static_cast<uint32_t>(tag & 0xFFFFu);
+                chcr = (chcr & 0x0000FFFFu) | (static_cast<uint32_t>(tag >> 16) & 0xFFFF0000u);
+                switch (id)
+                {
+                case 0: madr = addr, tadr += 16u, last = true; break;          // refe
+                case 1: madr = tadr + 16u, tadr = madr + qwc * 16u; break;     // cnt
+                case 2: madr = tadr + 16u, tadr = addr; break;                 // next
+                case 3: case 4: madr = addr, tadr += 16u; break;               // ref, refs
+                default: madr = tadr + 16u, tadr += 16u, last = true; break;   // end (call/ret unused)
+                }
+                if (((tag >> 31) & 1u) != 0u && (chcr & 0x80u) != 0u) // IRQ + TIE ends after this tag
+                    last = true;
+            }
+            mem.writeIORegister(kMadr, madr);
+            mem.writeIORegister(kQwc, qwc);
+            mem.writeIORegister(kTadr, tadr);
+            mem.writeIORegister(kChcr, chcr);
+        }
+
+        std::string g_movieFilePath; // guarded by g_mpeg_stub_mutex
+        MovieFileSource g_movieFile;
+    }
+#endif

+#ifdef __linux__

+        // DualShock motors through the kernel's force feedback (raylib's GLFW backend has no
+        // vibration). The first event device with FF_RUMBLE is used; it is looked up again a few
+        // seconds after a failure, so a controller plugged in later still rumbles.
+        struct Rumble
+        {
+            int fd = -1;
+            int16_t effect = -1;
+            uint16_t strong = 0, weak = 0;
+            std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point nextScan{};
+
+            bool open()
+            {
+                if (fd >= 0)
+                    return true;
+                const auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
+                if (now < nextScan)
+                    return false;
+                nextScan = now + std::chrono::seconds(3);
+                DIR *dir = opendir("/dev/input");
+                if (!dir)
+                    return false;
+                while (dirent *entry = readdir(dir))
+                {
+                    if (std::strncmp(entry->d_name, "event", 5) != 0)
+                        continue;
+                    const std::string path = std::string("/dev/input/") + entry->d_name;
+                    const int candidate = ::open(path.c_str(), O_RDWR | O_CLOEXEC);
+                    if (candidate < 0)
+                        continue;
+                    unsigned long ff[(FF_CNT + 8 * sizeof(long) - 1) / (8 * sizeof(long))]{};
+                    const bool rumble = ioctl(candidate, EVIOCGBIT(EV_FF, sizeof(ff)), ff) >= 0 &&
+                                        (ff[FF_RUMBLE / (8 * sizeof(long))] >> (FF_RUMBLE % (8 * sizeof(long)))) & 1ul;
+                    if (rumble)
+                    {
+                        fd = candidate;
+                        break;
+                    }
+                    ::close(candidate);
+                }
+                closedir(dir);
+                return fd >= 0;
+            }
+
+            void set(uint16_t newStrong, uint16_t newWeak)
+            {
+                if ((newStrong == strong && newWeak == weak) || !open())
+                    return;
+                strong = newStrong, weak = newWeak;
+                ff_effect fx{};
+                fx.type = FF_RUMBLE;
+                fx.id = effect;
+                fx.u.rumble.strong_magnitude = strong;
+                fx.u.rumble.weak_magnitude = weak;
+                fx.replay.length = 0xFFFF; // until the game changes or stops it
+                if (ioctl(fd, EVIOCSFF, &fx) < 0)
+                {
+                    ::close(fd), fd = -1, effect = -1; // unplugged: look again later
+                    return;
+                }
+                effect = fx.id;
+                input_event play{};
+                play.type = EV_FF;
+                play.code = static_cast<uint16_t>(effect);
+                play.value = (strong || weak) ? 1 : 0;
+                if (::write(fd, &play, sizeof(play)) < 0)
+                    ::close(fd), fd = -1, effect = -1;
+            }
+        };
+        Rumble g_rumble;
+    }

 namespace

+    // Superset of the 64-word blocks a transfer touches in a buffer: pages are at least 64
+    // pixels wide and 32 rows tall, so rows [0, lastRow) span at most width pages per 32 rows
+    // from base, even when base is not page aligned. (A margin of two more page rows made
+    // CLUTs stored after a texture look written and cost 339 GPU waits in fase2.gsr.)
+    std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t> transferBlocks(uint32_t base, uint32_t width, uint32_t lastRow)
+    {
+        return {base, base + std::max<uint32_t>(width, 1u) * std::max<uint32_t>((lastRow + 31u) / 32u, 1u) * 32u};
+    }
+
+    // The same for a rectangle in a known format: the span of the blocks its cells map to
+    // (a small texture no longer reaches the CLUT stored later in the same page).
+    std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t> transferBlocks(uint32_t base, uint32_t width, uint32_t psm,
+                                                 uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t w, uint32_t h)
+    {
+        const auto whole = transferBlocks(base, width, y + h);
+        uint32_t cellW = 8u, cellH = 8u, perBlock = 64u; // pixels per block cell, address units per block
+        switch (psm)
+        {
+        case GS_PSM_CT32: case GS_PSM_CT24: case GS_PSM_Z32: case GS_PSM_Z24:
+        case GS_PSM_T8H: case GS_PSM_T4HL: case GS_PSM_T4HH: break;
+        case GS_PSM_CT16: case GS_PSM_CT16S: case GS_PSM_Z16: case GS_PSM_Z16S: cellW = 16u; perBlock = 128u; break;
+        case GS_PSM_T8: cellW = 16u; cellH = 16u; perBlock = 256u; break;
+        case GS_PSM_T4: cellW = 32u; cellH = 16u; perBlock = 512u; break;
+        default: return whole;
+        }
+        width = std::max<uint32_t>(width, 1u);
+        if (w == 0u || h == 0u || x + w > width * 64u || y + h > 2048u)
+            return whole;
+        uint32_t first = UINT32_MAX, last = 0u;
+        for (uint32_t cy = y / cellH * cellH; cy < y + h; cy += cellH)
+            for (uint32_t cx = x / cellW * cellW; cx < x + w; cx += cellW)
+            {
+                const uint32_t block = GSMem::PixelAddress(psm, base, width, cx, cy) / perBlock;
+                first = std::min(first, block);
+                last = std::max(last, block);
+            }
+        if (first < base || last >= whole.second) // wrapped around the memory
+            return whole;
+        return {first, last + 1u};
+    }

+GSCpuBackend::~GSCpuBackend()
+{
+    {
+        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(m_queueMutex);
+        m_stopWorker = true;
+    }
+    m_queueCv.notify_all();
+    m_worker.join();
+}
+
+void GSCpuBackend::Enqueue(QueuedCommand &&command)
+{
+    constexpr size_t kMaxQueuedCommands = 32768u;
+    std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(m_queueMutex);
+    if (m_queue.size() >= kMaxQueuedCommands)
+    {
+        const uint64_t waitStart = ps2_perf::enabled() ? ps2_perf::nowNs() : 0u;
+        m_queueCv.wait(lock, [this]
+                       { return m_queue.size() < kMaxQueuedCommands; });
+        if (ps2_perf::enabled())
+            ps2_perf::counters().eeWaitingGsNs.fetch_add(ps2_perf::nowNs() - waitStart, std::memory_order_relaxed);
+    }
+    m_queue.push_back(std::move(command));
+    if (m_queue.size() == 1u)
+        m_queueCv.notify_all();
+}
+
+void GSCpuBackend::WaitForQueue() const
+{
+    {
+        std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(m_queueMutex);
+        m_queueCv.wait(lock, [this]
+                       { return m_queue.empty() && !m_workerBusy; });
+    }
+    // The worker leaves its last GPU batch running; readers need it finished.
+    if (m_gpu)
+    {
+        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(m_mutex);
+        m_gpu->Flush();
+    }
+}
+
+void GSCpuBackend::WorkerLoop()
+{
+    pthread_setname_np(pthread_self(), "GSWorker"); // PS2X_PROFILE_THREAD picks threads by name
+    ps2_perf::pinHeavyThread(ps2_perf::HeavyThread::GsWorker);
+    // One band per physical core: 8 bands on a 4C/8T CPU measured slightly slower.
+    const uint32_t physicalCores = std::thread::hardware_concurrency() / 2u;
+    const uint32_t bandCount = physicalCores >= 4u ? 4u : physicalCores >= 2u ? 2u : 1u; // Power of two: see rowInBand.
+    m_bandTotal = bandCount;
+    for (uint32_t band = 1u; band < bandCount; ++band)
+        m_bandThreads.emplace_back(&GSCpuBackend::BandLoop, this, band);
+
+    std::vector<QueuedCommand> commands;
+    std::vector<const GSPrimitiveBatch *> segment;
+    std::vector<std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t>> segmentTargets;
+    std::unique_lock<std::mutex> queueLock(m_queueMutex);
+    while (true)
+    {
+        m_queueCv.wait(queueLock, [this]
+                       { return m_stopWorker || !m_queue.empty(); });
+        if (m_queue.empty())
+            break;
+
+        commands.swap(m_queue);
+        const uint64_t busyStart = ps2_perf::enabled() ? ps2_perf::nowNs() : 0u;
+        m_workerBusy = true;
+        queueLock.unlock();
+        m_queueCv.notify_all();
+        {
+            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(m_mutex);
+            uint64_t pixelEstimate = 0u;
+            // GPU draws queued before CPU work must land first, and the other way round.
+            auto flushSegment = [&]
+            {
+                if (m_gpu && !segment.empty())
+                    m_gpu->Flush();
+                RunDrawSegment(segment, pixelEstimate);
+                if (m_gpu)
+                    for (const auto &[start, end] : segmentTargets)
+                        m_gpu->HostWrote(start, end);
+                segmentTargets.clear();
+            };
+            // Hands a finished GPU capture to the presenter (swap, so the lock is short).
+            auto publishCapture = [&]
+            {
+                if (!m_gpu)
+                    return;
+                m_captureScratch.resize(m_vramSize);
+                if (!m_gpu->TakeCapture(m_captureScratch.data()))
+                    return;
+                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> frameLock(m_frameMutex);
+                m_completedFrameVram.swap(m_captureScratch);
+                // shortcut: page formats as of the newest queued capture, not the one taken;
+                // they only differ if the game changes a frame page's PSM between two fields.
+                m_completedPagePsm = m_capturePagePsm;
+                ++m_completedFrameSerial;
+                m_presentsSinceCapture = 0u;
+            };
+            auto flushAll = [&]
+            {
+                flushSegment();
+                if (m_gpu)
+                    m_gpu->Flush();
+            };
+            GSGpuSpriteJob gpuJob;
+            GSGpuPrimitive gpuPrimitive;
+            // Local-to-local copies run on the GPU in queue order when source and destination
+            // don't overlap (pixel order would matter then) and the destination doesn't wrap.
+            auto copyOnGpu = [&](const GSTransferCommand &transfer)
+            {
+                auto supported = [](uint32_t psm)
+                {
+                    switch (psm)
+                    {
+                    case GS_PSM_CT32: case GS_PSM_CT24: case GS_PSM_CT16: case GS_PSM_CT16S:
+                    case GS_PSM_Z32: case GS_PSM_Z24: case GS_PSM_Z16: case GS_PSM_Z16S:
+                    case GS_PSM_T8: case GS_PSM_T8H: case GS_PSM_T4: case GS_PSM_T4HL: case GS_PSM_T4HH:
+                        return true;
+                    default:
+                        return false;
+                    }
+                };
+                const auto &buffers = transfer.bitbltbuf;
+                const auto &position = transfer.trxpos;
+                const uint32_t rrw = transfer.trxreg.rrw, rrh = transfer.trxreg.rrh;
+                const uint32_t dbw = std::max<uint32_t>(buffers.dbw, 1u), sbw = std::max<uint32_t>(buffers.sbw, 1u);
+                if (transfer.direction != 2u || rrw == 0u || rrh == 0u || !supported(buffers.spsm) || !supported(buffers.dpsm) ||
+                    position.dsax + rrw > dbw * 64u || position.dsay + rrh > 2048u)
+                    return false;
+                const auto dest = transferBlocks(buffers.dbp, dbw, buffers.dpsm, position.dsax, position.dsay, rrw, rrh);
+                const auto source = transferBlocks(buffers.sbp, sbw, buffers.spsm, position.ssax, position.ssay, rrw, rrh);
+                if (dest.first < source.second && source.first < dest.second)
+                    return false;
+                const GSGpuCopy copy{{buffers.dbp, dbw, buffers.dpsm, position.dsax, position.dsay, rrw, 0u, rrw * rrh, dest.first, dest.second},
+                                     buffers.sbp, sbw, buffers.spsm, position.ssax, position.ssay, position.dir, source.first, source.second};
+                m_gpu->QueueLocalCopy(copy);
+                // The state BeginTransferLocked leaves after PerformLocalToLocalTransfer.
+                m_transfer = transfer;
+                m_transferState = {};
+                m_transferState.x = position.dsax;
+                m_transferState.y = position.dsay;
+                m_transferState.totalPixels = rrw * rrh;
+                m_transferState.copiedPixels = rrw * rrh;
+                m_transferState.direction = 3u;
+                if (buffers.dbp % 32u == 0u)
+                    NotePagePsm(buffers.dbp / 32u, buffers.dpsm);
+                return true;
+            };
+            // Big uploads (textures) run on the GPU in queue order, so they never wait for it.
+            // Small ones (CLUTs) stay on the CPU, since a CLUT load reads them from host
+            // memory, unless queued GPU work uses that memory: then the GPU beats a wait.
+            auto uploadOnGpu = [&](const std::vector<uint8_t> &image, bool clash, bool mirrored = false)
+            {
+                static const bool enabled = []
+                {
+                    const char *setting = std::getenv("PS2X_GS_GPU_UPLOAD");
+                    return setting == nullptr || setting[0] != '0';
+                }();
+                if (!enabled || (image.size() < 4096u && !clash) || m_transferState.direction != 0u || m_transferState.totalPixels == 0u)
+                    return false;
+                const uint8_t psm = m_transfer.bitbltbuf.dpsm;
+                uint32_t bytesPerPixel = 0u; // 0: two pixels per byte
+                switch (psm)
+                {
+                case GS_PSM_CT32: case GS_PSM_Z32: bytesPerPixel = 4u; break;
+                case GS_PSM_CT24: case GS_PSM_Z24: bytesPerPixel = 3u; break;
+                case GS_PSM_CT16: case GS_PSM_CT16S: case GS_PSM_Z16: case GS_PSM_Z16S: bytesPerPixel = 2u; break;
+                case GS_PSM_T8: case GS_PSM_T8H: bytesPerPixel = 1u; break;
+                case GS_PSM_T4: case GS_PSM_T4HL: case GS_PSM_T4HH: break;
+                default: return false;
+                }
+                // Pixels must not wrap onto each other: GPU invocations write them in any order.
+                const uint32_t dbw = std::max<uint32_t>(m_transfer.bitbltbuf.dbw, 1u), rrw = m_transfer.trxreg.rrw;
+                if (rrw == 0u || m_transfer.trxpos.dsax + rrw > dbw * 64u || m_transfer.trxpos.dsay + m_transfer.trxreg.rrh > 2048u)
+                    return false;
+                const uint32_t size = static_cast<uint32_t>(image.size());
+                const uint32_t remaining = m_transferState.totalPixels - m_transferState.copiedPixels;
+                const uint32_t count = std::min(remaining, bytesPerPixel == 0u ? size * 2u : size / bytesPerPixel);
+                const uint32_t bytes = bytesPerPixel == 0u ? (count + 1u) / 2u : count * bytesPerPixel;
+                const auto dest = transferBlocks(m_transfer.bitbltbuf.dbp, dbw, psm, m_transfer.trxpos.dsax, m_transfer.trxpos.dsay, rrw, m_transfer.trxreg.rrh);
+                const GSGpuUpload upload{m_transfer.bitbltbuf.dbp, dbw, psm, m_transfer.trxpos.dsax, m_transfer.trxpos.dsay, rrw,
+                                         m_transferState.copiedPixels, count, dest.first, dest.second};
+                if (!m_gpu->QueueUpload(upload, image.data(), bytes, mirrored))
+                    return false;
+                // The same transfer state UploadImageLocked leaves.
+                m_transferState.copiedPixels += count;
+                if (m_transferState.copiedPixels >= m_transferState.totalPixels)
+                {
+                    m_transferState.direction = 3u;
+                    m_transferState.totalPixels = 0u;
+                }
+                else
+                {
+                    m_transferState.x = m_transfer.trxpos.dsax + m_transferState.copiedPixels % rrw;
+                    m_transferState.y = m_transfer.trxpos.dsay + m_transferState.copiedPixels / rrw;
+                }
+                return true;
+            };
+            for (const QueuedCommand &command : commands)
+            {
+                switch (command.kind)
+                {
+                case QueuedKind::Draw:
+                {
+                    const auto &ctx = command.batch.state.context;
+                    // MKSM draws one field per vsync, alternating frame pages 0x00 and 0x46,
+                    // with bloom, depth copies and HUD in between. Switching to the other page
+                    // means the previous field is complete: that is the copy the window shows.
+                    const uint32_t fbp = ctx.frame.fbp;
+                    const bool mainTarget = fbp == 0x00u || fbp == 0x46u;
+                    if (mainTarget && fbp != m_lastMainFbp)
+                    {
+                        if (m_lastMainFbp != ~0u && m_vram && m_gpu)
+                        {
+                            // The GPU copies the field when it gets there; waiting here cost
+                            // ~6 ms per field (65 s of 290 s live). Published by publishCapture.
+                            flushSegment();
+                            m_gpu->QueueCapture();
+                            m_capturePagePsm = m_pagePsm;
+                            publishCapture();
+                        }
+                        else if (m_lastMainFbp != ~0u && m_vram)
+                        {
+                            flushAll();
+                            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> frameLock(m_frameMutex);
+                            m_completedFrameVram.assign(m_vram, m_vram + m_vramSize);
+                            m_completedPagePsm = m_pagePsm;
+                            ++m_completedFrameSerial;
+                            m_presentsSinceCapture = 0u;
+                        }
+                        m_lastMainFbp = fbp;
+                        ps2_perf::counters().gameFrames.fetch_add(1u, std::memory_order_relaxed);
+                    }
+                    m_lastDrawFbp = fbp;
+                    NotePagePsm(fbp, ctx.frame.psm);
+
+                    constexpr uint32_t kBlocksPerPage = 32u;
+                    const uint32_t targetStart = fbp * kBlocksPerPage;
+                    const uint32_t targetRows = static_cast<uint32_t>(ctx.scissor.y1) / 32u + 1u;
+                    const uint32_t targetEnd = targetStart + std::max<uint32_t>(ctx.frame.fbw, 1u) * targetRows * kBlocksPerPage;
+                    const uint32_t depthStart = ctx.zbuf.zmask ? 0u : GSInternal::framePageBaseToBlock(ctx.zbuf.zbp);
+                    const uint32_t depthEnd = ctx.zbuf.zmask ? 0u : depthStart + (targetEnd - targetStart);
+
+                    // A draw that samples pixels written earlier needs those draws finished.
+                    bool readsOwnTarget = false;
+                    uint32_t textureStart = 0u, textureEnd = 0u;
+                    if (command.batch.state.prim.tme)
+                    {
+                        textureStart = ctx.tex0.tbp0;
+                        uint32_t textureHeight = 1u << std::min<uint32_t>(ctx.tex0.th, 10u);
+                        // A sprite with texel coordinates reads no row past its last V: the stage
+                        // shrinks the Z buffer into a target that only the full height would reach.
+                        if (command.batch.state.prim.fst && command.batch.state.prim.type == GS_PRIM_SPRITE)
+                            textureHeight = std::min<uint32_t>(textureHeight, (std::max(command.batch.vertices[0].v, command.batch.vertices[1].v) >> 4) + 1u);
+                        const uint32_t textureRows = textureHeight / 32u + 1u;
+                        textureEnd = textureStart + std::max<uint32_t>(ctx.tex0.tbw, 1u) * textureRows * kBlocksPerPage;
+                        auto overlaps = [&](uint32_t start, uint32_t end)
+                        {
+                            return textureStart < end && textureEnd > start;
+                        };
+                        readsOwnTarget = overlaps(targetStart, targetEnd);
+                        bool readsPendingTarget = false;
+                        for (const auto &[start, end] : segmentTargets)
+                            readsPendingTarget = readsPendingTarget || overlaps(start, end);
+                        if (readsOwnTarget || readsPendingTarget)
+                            flushSegment();
+                    }
+
+                    if (m_gpu && PrepareGpuSprite(command.batch, readsOwnTarget, gpuJob))
+                    {
+                        flushSegment();
+                        m_gpu->QueueSprite(gpuJob);
+                        break;
+                    }
+                    if (m_gpu && !readsOwnTarget)
+                    {
+                        const int prepared = PrepareGpuPrimitive(command.batch, gpuPrimitive);
+                        if (prepared != 0)
+                        {
+                            flushSegment();
+                            if (prepared == 1)
+                            {
+                                GSGpuAccess access;
+                                access.frameStart = targetStart;
+                                access.frameEnd = targetEnd;
+                                access.frameWidth = std::max<uint32_t>(ctx.frame.fbw, 1u);
+                                access.framePsm = ctx.frame.psm;
+                                access.depthStart = depthStart;
+                                access.depthEnd = depthEnd;
+                                access.depthPsm = ctx.zbuf.psm;
+                                if (ctx.zbuf.zmask && ((ctx.test >> 17) & 3u) >= 2u)
+                                {
+                                    access.depthReadStart = GSInternal::framePageBaseToBlock(ctx.zbuf.zbp);
+                                    access.depthReadEnd = access.depthReadStart + (targetEnd - targetStart);
+                                }
+                                access.textureStart = textureStart;
+                                access.textureEnd = textureEnd;
+                                m_gpu->QueuePrimitive(gpuPrimitive, access);
+                            }
+                            break;
+                        }
+                    }
+
+                    if (readsOwnTarget)
+                    {
+                        if (m_gpu)
+                            m_gpu->Flush();
+                        DrawFeedbackPrimitive(command.batch);
+                        if (m_gpu)
+                        {
+                            m_gpu->HostWrote(targetStart, targetEnd);
+                            m_gpu->HostWrote(depthStart, depthEnd);
+                        }
+                        break;
+                    }
+
+                    for (const std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t> target : {std::pair{targetStart, targetEnd}, std::pair{depthStart, depthEnd}})
+                        if (target.second > target.first &&
+                            std::find(segmentTargets.begin(), segmentTargets.end(), target) == segmentTargets.end())
+                            segmentTargets.push_back(target);
+                    segment.push_back(&command.batch);
+
+                    float minX = command.batch.vertices[0].x, maxX = minX;
+                    float minY = command.batch.vertices[0].y, maxY = minY;
+                    for (uint32_t i = 1u; i < command.batch.vertexCount; ++i)
+                    {
+                        minX = std::min(minX, command.batch.vertices[i].x);
+                        maxX = std::max(maxX, command.batch.vertices[i].x);
+                        minY = std::min(minY, command.batch.vertices[i].y);
+                        maxY = std::max(maxY, command.batch.vertices[i].y);
+                    }
+                    pixelEstimate += static_cast<uint64_t>(maxX - minX + 1.0f) * static_cast<uint64_t>(maxY - minY + 1.0f);
+                    break;
+                }
+                case QueuedKind::LoadClut:
+                {
+                    // The CLUT is read from local memory: wait only if queued GPU work writes there.
+                    // CSM1 reads a 16x16 block at CBP; CSM2 a line at (COU*16, COV) of a CBW-wide buffer.
+                    flushSegment();
+                    const auto source = command.tex0.csm == 0u
+                                            ? transferBlocks(command.tex0.cbp, 1u, command.tex0.cpsm, 0u, 0u, 16u, 16u)
+                                            : transferBlocks(command.tex0.cbp,
+                                                             std::max<uint32_t>(command.texclut.cbw, (command.texclut.cou * 16u + 256u) / 64u + 1u),
+                                                             command.texclut.cov);
+                    // Then the GPU loads it in queue order instead (fase3.gsr: the bloom blur at
+                    // 0x14C covers the CLUT at 0x2B10 the game loads next, ~0.8 waits per field).
+                    const bool clash = m_gpu && m_gpu->Touches(source.first, source.second, false);
+                    const bool gpuFormat = command.tex0.cpsm == GS_PSM_CT32 || command.tex0.cpsm == GS_PSM_CT16 || command.tex0.cpsm == GS_PSM_CT16S;
+                    m_clutViaGpu = clash && gpuFormat;
+                    m_clutSource = source;
+                    if (clash && !m_clutViaGpu)
+                    {
+                        SyncClutFromGpu();
+                        m_gpu->Flush();
+                    }
+                    LoadClutLocked(command.tex0, command.texclut);
+                    m_clutViaGpu = false;
+                    break;
+                }
+                case QueuedKind::BeginTransfer:
+                    flushSegment();
+                    if (m_gpu && copyOnGpu(command.transfer))
+                        break;
+                    // An upload (direction 0) touches nothing yet: UploadImage checks its writes.
+                    if (m_gpu && (command.transfer.direction == 1u ||
+                                  (command.transfer.direction == 2u && TransferTouchesGpu(command.transfer))))
+                        m_gpu->Flush();
+                    BeginTransferLocked(command.transfer);
+                    if (m_gpu && command.transfer.direction == 2u)
+                    {
+                        const auto dest = transferBlocks(command.transfer.bitbltbuf.dbp, command.transfer.bitbltbuf.dbw, command.transfer.bitbltbuf.dpsm,
+                                                         command.transfer.trxpos.dsax, command.transfer.trxpos.dsay,
+                                                         command.transfer.trxreg.rrw, command.transfer.trxreg.rrh);
+                        m_gpu->HostWrote(dest.first, dest.second);
+                    }
+                    break;
+                case QueuedKind::UploadImage:
+                    // Host uploads write local memory under queued GPU work: only a clash waits.
+                    flushSegment();
+                    // A small upload (CLUT) that only clashes with queued GPU reads goes to the
+                    // GPU in order and is also written to host memory: the CLUT load that
+                    // follows reads it there without waiting (339 waits in fase2.gsr).
+                    if (m_gpu && command.image.size() < 4096u && TransferTouchesGpu(m_transfer))
+                    {
+                        const auto dest = transferBlocks(m_transfer.bitbltbuf.dbp, m_transfer.bitbltbuf.dbw, m_transfer.bitbltbuf.dpsm,
+                                                         m_transfer.trxpos.dsax, m_transfer.trxpos.dsay,
+                                                         m_transfer.trxreg.rrw, m_transfer.trxreg.rrh);
+                        const auto before = m_transferState;
+                        if (!m_gpu->Touches(dest.first, dest.second, false) && uploadOnGpu(command.image, true, true))
+                        {
+                            m_transferState = before;
+                            UploadImageLocked(command.image.data(), static_cast<uint32_t>(command.image.size()));
+                            break;
+                        }
+                    }
+                    if (m_gpu && uploadOnGpu(command.image, TransferTouchesGpu(m_transfer)))
+                        break;
+                    if (m_gpu && TransferTouchesGpu(m_transfer))
+                        m_gpu->Flush();
+                    UploadImageLocked(command.image.data(), static_cast<uint32_t>(command.image.size()));
+                    if (m_gpu)
+                    {
+                        const auto dest = transferBlocks(m_transfer.bitbltbuf.dbp, m_transfer.bitbltbuf.dbw, m_transfer.bitbltbuf.dpsm,
+                                                         m_transfer.trxpos.dsax, m_transfer.trxpos.dsay,
+                                                         m_transfer.trxreg.rrw, m_transfer.trxreg.rrh);
+                        m_gpu->HostWrote(dest.first, dest.second);
+                    }
+                    break;
+                }
+            }
+            // Don't wait for the GPU here: the next chunk (or WaitForQueue) does if it must.
+            flushSegment();
+            if (m_gpu)
+                m_gpu->Submit();
+            publishCapture();
+        }
+        commands.clear();
+        if (ps2_perf::enabled())
+            ps2_perf::counters().gsBusyNs.fetch_add(ps2_perf::nowNs() - busyStart, std::memory_order_relaxed);
+        queueLock.lock();
+        m_workerBusy = false;
+        m_queueCv.notify_all();
+    }
+
+    {
+        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(m_bandMutex);
+        m_stopBands = true;
+    }
+    m_bandCv.notify_all();
+    for (std::thread &thread : m_bandThreads)
+        thread.join();
+}
+
+void GSCpuBackend::BandLoop(uint32_t bandIndex)
+{
+    pthread_setname_np(pthread_self(), "GSBand");
+    t_bandIndex = bandIndex;
+    t_bandCount = m_bandTotal;
+    uint64_t seenGeneration = 0u;
+    while (true)
+    {
+        // A frame has around 100 segments: spin through the gaps instead of paying
+        // a futex wake for each one, and sleep only when the GS really goes idle.
+        for (uint32_t spin = 0u; spin < kBandSpinCount && m_bandGeneration.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == seenGeneration; ++spin)
+            _mm_pause();
+        if (m_bandGeneration.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == seenGeneration)
+        {
+            std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(m_bandMutex);
+            m_bandCv.wait(lock, [&]
+                          { return m_stopBands || m_bandGeneration.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != seenGeneration; });
+            if (m_stopBands)
+                return;
+        }
+        seenGeneration = m_bandGeneration.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
+        for (const GSPrimitiveBatch *batch : *m_bandSegment)
+            DrawPrimitive(*batch);
+        m_bandPending.fetch_sub(1u, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
+    }
+}
+
+void GSCpuBackend::RunDrawSegment(std::vector<const GSPrimitiveBatch *> &segment, uint64_t &pixelEstimate)
+{
+    if (ClutHasUnknown())
+        for (const GSPrimitiveBatch *batch : segment)
+            if (batch->state.prim.tme && (isFourBitIndexedPsm(batch->state.context.tex0.psm) || isEightBitIndexedPsm(batch->state.context.tex0.psm)))
+            {
+                SyncClutFromGpu(); // CPU texels read m_clut
+                break;
+            }
+    if (!m_bandThreads.empty() && pixelEstimate >= kParallelMinPixels)
+    {
+        const uint32_t helpers = static_cast<uint32_t>(m_bandThreads.size());
+        m_bandSegment = &segment;
+        m_bandPending.store(helpers, std::memory_order_release);
+        {
+            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(m_bandMutex);
+            m_bandGeneration.fetch_add(1u, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
+        }
+        m_bandCv.notify_all();
+        t_bandIndex = 0u;
+        t_bandCount = helpers + 1u;
+        for (const GSPrimitiveBatch *batch : segment)
+            DrawPrimitive(*batch);
+        t_bandCount = 1u;
+        while (m_bandPending.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != 0u)
+            _mm_pause();
+    }
+    else
+    {
+        for (const GSPrimitiveBatch *batch : segment)
+            DrawPrimitive(*batch);
+    }
+    segment.clear();
+    pixelEstimate = 0u;
+}

 }

+bool GSCpuBackend::ClutHasUnknown() const
+{
+    for (const uint64_t word : m_clutUnknown)
+        if (word != 0u)
+            return true;
+    return false;
+}
+
+void GSCpuBackend::SyncClutFromGpu()
+{
+    if (!ClutHasUnknown())
+        return;
+    m_gpu->Flush();
+    m_gpu->ReadClut(m_clut.data());
+    m_clutUnknown.fill(0u);
+}
+
+void GSCpuBackend::PublishClut()
+{
+    if (m_gpu)
+        m_gpu->SetClut(m_clut.data(), ClutHasUnknown() ? m_clutUnknown.data() : nullptr);
+}
+
 void GSCpuBackend::LoadClutUnlocked(const GSTex0Reg &tex0, const GSTexClutReg &texclut)
 {
+    // A reload that leaves the palette as it was needs no new GPU version (SetClut, CLUT hash,
+    // texture cache key): MKSM reloads the same CLUT for most textured draws.
+    const std::array<uint16_t, 512> clutBefore = m_clut;

+    struct CpuBackendState
+    {

+void GSCpuBackend::SaveState(std::vector<uint8_t> &out) const
+{
+    WaitForQueue();
+    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(m_mutex);
+    const_cast<GSCpuBackend *>(this)->SyncClutFromGpu();
+    const CpuBackendState state{m_clut, m_clutCbp, m_transfer, m_transferState, m_lastDrawFbp};
+    out.resize(sizeof(state));
+    std::memcpy(out.data(), &state, sizeof(state));
+}
+
+void GSCpuBackend::LoadState(const std::vector<uint8_t> &vram, const std::vector<uint8_t> &state)
+{
+    WaitForQueue();
+    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(m_mutex);
+    if (m_vram && vram.size() == m_vramSize)
+        std::memcpy(m_vram, vram.data(), m_vramSize);
+    if (m_gpu)
+        m_gpu->HostWrote(0u, m_vramSize / 256u);
+    if (state.size() == sizeof(CpuBackendState))
+    {
+        CpuBackendState loaded;
+        std::memcpy(&loaded, state.data(), sizeof(loaded));
+        m_clut = loaded.clut;
+        m_clutUnknown.fill(0u);
+        m_clutCbp = loaded.clutCbp;
+        m_transfer = loaded.transfer;
+        m_transferState = loaded.transferState;
+        m_lastDrawFbp = loaded.lastDrawFbp;
+        if (m_gpu)
+            m_gpu->SetClut(m_clut.data());
+    }
+}

+// The GS texture cache hands a primitive its source as it was before that primitive
+// drew. MKSM's bloom blurs a buffer into itself with 3-5 pixel offsets; reading live
+// VRAM lets each pixel see the taps written a moment earlier in the same row, which
+// smears rows sideways and multiplies the brightness until it saturates to white.
+void GSCpuBackend::FeedbackPages(const GSPrimitiveBatch &batch, std::vector<uint32_t> &pages) const
+{
+    const GSDrawState &state = batch.state;
+    const GSTex0Reg &tex = state.context.tex0;
+    const int texW = state.textureWidth, texH = state.textureHeight;
+
+    float minU = 1e30f, maxU = -1e30f, minV = 1e30f, maxV = -1e30f;
+    for (uint32_t i = 0u; i < batch.vertexCount; ++i)
+    {
+        const GSVertex &v = batch.vertices[i];
+        const float invQ = state.prim.fst ? 1.0f : 1.0f / fabsQ(v.q);
+        const float u = state.prim.fst ? v.u / 16.0f : v.s * invQ * texW;
+        const float t = state.prim.fst ? v.v / 16.0f : v.t * invQ * texH;
+        minU = std::min(minU, u), maxU = std::max(maxU, u);
+        minV = std::min(minV, t), maxV = std::max(maxV, t);
+    }
+    // One texel of margin for bilinear; anything that may wrap takes the whole texture.
+    int u0 = static_cast<int>(std::floor(minU)) - 1, u1 = static_cast<int>(std::ceil(maxU)) + 1;
+    int v0 = static_cast<int>(std::floor(minV)) - 1, v1 = static_cast<int>(std::ceil(maxV)) + 1;
+    if (!(u0 >= -1 && v0 >= -1 && u1 <= texW && v1 <= texH))
+        u0 = 0, v0 = 0, u1 = texW - 1, v1 = texH - 1;
+    u0 = std::max(u0, 0), v0 = std::max(v0, 0);
+    u1 = std::min(u1, texW - 1), v1 = std::min(v1, texH - 1);
+
+    uint32_t pageW = 64u, pageH = 32u;
+    switch (tex.psm)
+    {
+    case GS_PSM_CT16: case GS_PSM_CT16S: case GS_PSM_Z16: case GS_PSM_Z16S: pageH = 64u; break;
+    case GS_PSM_T8: pageW = 128u, pageH = 64u; break;
+    case GS_PSM_T4: pageW = 128u, pageH = 128u; break;
+    default: break;
+    }
+    const uint32_t pagesPerRow = std::max<uint32_t>(tex.tbw * 64u / pageW, 1u);
+    const uint32_t pageCount = m_vramSize / 8192u;
+    // A base that is not page aligned spills each page into the next one.
+    const uint32_t spill = (tex.tbp0 % 32u) != 0u ? 1u : 0u;
+    pages.clear();
+    for (uint32_t py = static_cast<uint32_t>(v0) / pageH; py <= static_cast<uint32_t>(v1) / pageH; ++py)
+        for (uint32_t px = static_cast<uint32_t>(u0) / pageW; px <= static_cast<uint32_t>(u1) / pageW + spill; ++px)
+            pages.push_back((tex.tbp0 / 32u + py * pagesPerRow + px) % pageCount);
+}
+
+void GSCpuBackend::DrawFeedbackPrimitive(const GSPrimitiveBatch &batch)
+{
+    constexpr uint32_t kPageBytes = 8192u;
+    thread_local std::vector<uint32_t> pages;
+    FeedbackPages(batch, pages);
+    if (m_feedbackVram.size() != m_vramSize)
+        m_feedbackVram.resize(m_vramSize);
+    for (const uint32_t page : pages)
+        std::memcpy(m_feedbackVram.data() + page * kPageBytes, m_vram + page * kPageBytes, kPageBytes);
+
+    // Every pixel reads the snapshot, never this primitive's own writes, so the
+    // bands can share its rows (the bloom sends ~700 of these a frame).
+    m_textureVram = m_feedbackVram.data();
+    std::vector<const GSPrimitiveBatch *> single{&batch};
+    uint64_t forceParallel = kParallelMinPixels;
+    RunDrawSegment(single, forceParallel);
+    m_textureVram = m_vram;
+}

+// Mirrors the fast path at the top of DrawSprite: same eligibility, geometry and texel
+// coordinates (computed here on the CPU so the GPU never redoes the float division).
+bool GSCpuBackend::PrepareGpuSprite(const GSPrimitiveBatch &batch, bool feedback, GSGpuSpriteJob &job) const
+{
+    const GSDrawState &state = batch.state;

+        return false;

+                              (testReg & 1u) == 0u && ((testReg >> 14) & 1u) == 0u && ((testReg >> 17) & 3u) == 1u &&
+                              ctx.zbuf.zmask && (ctx.fba & 1ull) == 0ull && !state.pabe;
+    const bool simpleTexture = !state.prim.tme ||
+                               (state.prim.fst && !state.linearFilter && ctx.tex0.psm == GS_PSM_CT32 && ctx.tex0.tfx == 1u);
+    if (!simplePixels || !simpleTexture)
+        return false;
+
+    const GSVertex &v0 = batch.vertices[0];
+    const GSVertex &v1 = batch.vertices[1];
+    const int ofx = ctx.xyoffset.ofx >> 4;
+    const int ofy = ctx.xyoffset.ofy >> 4;
+    int x0 = static_cast<int>(v0.x) - ofx;
+    int y0 = static_cast<int>(v0.y) - ofy;
+    int x1 = static_cast<int>(v1.x) - ofx;
+    int y1 = static_cast<int>(v1.y) - ofy;
+    if (x0 > x1)
+        std::swap(x0, x1);
+    if (y0 > y1)
+        std::swap(y0, y1);
+    const int unclippedX0 = x0, unclippedY0 = y0;
+    const int spanX = std::max(1, x1 - x0), spanY = std::max(1, y1 - y0);
+    const int unclippedX1 = unclippedX0 + spanX - 1, unclippedY1 = unclippedY0 + spanY - 1;
+    if (unclippedX1 < ctx.scissor.x0 || unclippedX0 > ctx.scissor.x1 ||
+        unclippedY1 < ctx.scissor.y0 || unclippedY0 > ctx.scissor.y1)
+    {
+        job.x0 = 1, job.x1 = 0; // nothing to draw, but it stays on the GPU path
+    }
+    else
+    {
+        job.x0 = clampInt(unclippedX0, ctx.scissor.x0, ctx.scissor.x1);
+        job.y0 = clampInt(unclippedY0, ctx.scissor.y0, ctx.scissor.y1);
+        job.x1 = clampInt(unclippedX1, ctx.scissor.x0, ctx.scissor.x1);
+        job.y1 = clampInt(unclippedY1, ctx.scissor.y0, ctx.scissor.y1);
+    }
+
+    job.fbBlock = GSInternal::framePageBaseToBlock(ctx.frame.fbp);
+    job.fbWidth = std::max<uint32_t>(ctx.frame.fbw, 1u);
+    job.source = pack32(v1.r, v1.g, v1.b, v1.a);
+    job.alphaMode = static_cast<uint32_t>(ctx.alpha & 0xFFu);
+    job.alphaFix = static_cast<uint32_t>((ctx.alpha >> 32) & 0xFFu);
+    job.flags = (state.prim.abe ? 1u : 0u) | (state.prim.tme ? 2u : 0u) | (ctx.tex0.tcc ? 4u : 0u);
+    job.texBlock = ctx.tex0.tbp0;
+    job.texWidth = ctx.tex0.tbw;
+    job.columnU.clear();
+    job.rowV.clear();
+    job.snapshotPages.clear();
+    if (job.x0 > job.x1)
+        return true;
+
+    if (state.prim.tme)
+    {
+        const uint64_t clamp = ctx.clamp;
+        const uint8_t wrapU = static_cast<uint8_t>(clamp & 0x3u), wrapV = static_cast<uint8_t>((clamp >> 2) & 0x3u);
+        const uint16_t minU = (clamp >> 4) & 0x3FFu, maxU = (clamp >> 14) & 0x3FFu;
+        const uint16_t minV = (clamp >> 24) & 0x3FFu, maxV = (clamp >> 34) & 0x3FFu;
+        const float u0f = static_cast<float>(v0.u >> 4), v0f = static_cast<float>(v0.v >> 4);
+        const float u1f = static_cast<float>(v1.u >> 4), v1f = static_cast<float>(v1.v >> 4);
+        const float spriteW = static_cast<float>(spanX), spriteH = static_cast<float>(spanY);
+        for (int x = job.x0; x <= job.x1; ++x)
+        {
+            const float texUf = u0f + (u1f - u0f) * ((static_cast<float>(x - unclippedX0) + 0.5f) / spriteW);
+            job.columnU.push_back(wrapTextureCoordinate(clampInt(static_cast<int>((texUf * 16.0f) + 0.5f), 0, 0xFFFF) >> 4,
+                                                        state.textureWidth, wrapU, minU, maxU));
+        }
+        for (int y = job.y0; y <= job.y1; ++y)
+        {
+            const float texVf = v0f + (v1f - v0f) * ((static_cast<float>(y - unclippedY0) + 0.5f) / spriteH);
+            job.rowV.push_back(wrapTextureCoordinate(clampInt(static_cast<int>((texVf * 16.0f) + 0.5f), 0, 0xFFFF) >> 4,
+                                                     state.textureHeight, wrapV, minV, maxV));
+        }
+        if (feedback)
+        {
+            FeedbackPages(batch, job.snapshotPages);
+            std::sort(job.snapshotPages.begin(), job.snapshotPages.end());
+            job.snapshotPages.erase(std::unique(job.snapshotPages.begin(), job.snapshotPages.end()), job.snapshotPages.end());
+            job.flags |= 8u;
+        }
+    }
+    return true;
+}

+namespace
+{
+    bool gpuFramePsm(uint32_t psm) { return psm == GS_PSM_CT32 || psm == GS_PSM_CT24 || psm == GS_PSM_CT16 || psm == GS_PSM_CT16S; }
+    bool gpuDepthPsm(uint32_t psm) { return psm == GS_PSM_Z32 || psm == GS_PSM_Z24 || psm == GS_PSM_Z16 || psm == GS_PSM_Z16S; }
+    bool gpuTexturePsm(uint32_t psm)
+    {
+        switch (psm)
+        {
+        case GS_PSM_CT32: case GS_PSM_CT24: case GS_PSM_CT16: case GS_PSM_CT16S:
+        case GS_PSM_T8: case GS_PSM_T4: case GS_PSM_T8H: case GS_PSM_T4HL: case GS_PSM_T4HH:
+        case GS_PSM_Z32: case GS_PSM_Z24: case GS_PSM_Z16: case GS_PSM_Z16S:
+            return true;
+        default:
+            return false;
+        }
+    }
+    uint32_t floatBits(float value)
+    {
+        uint32_t bits;
+        std::memcpy(&bits, &value, sizeof(bits));
+        return bits;
+    }
+    void putDouble(uint32_t *words, double value)
+    {
+        std::memcpy(words, &value, sizeof(value));
+    }
+}

+// Same setup as DrawTriangle and the general path of DrawSprite, written into the
+// record gs_tiles.comp reads (word layout documented there and in GSGpuPrimitive).
+int GSCpuBackend::PrepareGpuPrimitive(const GSPrimitiveBatch &batch, GSGpuPrimitive &primitive) const
+{
+    const GSDrawState &state = batch.state;
+    const auto &ctx = state.context;
+    const bool triangle = batch.vertexCount == 3u &&
+                          (state.prim.type == GS_PRIM_TRIANGLE || state.prim.type == GS_PRIM_TRISTRIP || state.prim.type == GS_PRIM_TRIFAN);
+    const bool sprite = batch.vertexCount == 2u && state.prim.type == GS_PRIM_SPRITE;
+    if ((!triangle && !sprite) || !(gpuFramePsm(ctx.frame.psm) || gpuDepthPsm(ctx.frame.psm)) || !gpuDepthPsm(ctx.zbuf.psm))
+        return 0;
+    const auto &tex = ctx.tex0;
+    if (state.prim.tme && (!gpuTexturePsm(tex.psm) ||
+                           ((isFourBitIndexedPsm(tex.psm) || isEightBitIndexedPsm(tex.psm)) && !gpuFramePsm(tex.cpsm))))
+        return 0;
+
+    uint32_t *w = primitive.words;
+    // Words 0-29 are always written below; each path clears the rest it leaves unset.
+    primitive.columns.clear();
+    primitive.rows.clear();
+    w[5] = (state.prim.iip ? 1u : 0u) | (state.prim.tme ? 2u : 0u) | (state.prim.fst ? 4u : 0u) | (state.prim.fge ? 8u : 0u) |
+           (state.prim.abe ? 16u : 0u) | (state.pabe ? 32u : 0u) | (state.linearFilter ? 64u : 0u) |
+           (ctx.zbuf.zmask ? 128u : 0u) | ((ctx.fba & 1ull) ? 256u : 0u);
+    w[6] = GSInternal::framePageBaseToBlock(ctx.frame.fbp);
+    w[7] = std::max<uint32_t>(ctx.frame.fbw, 1u);
+    w[8] = ctx.frame.psm;
+    w[9] = ctx.frame.fbmsk;
+    w[10] = GSInternal::framePageBaseToBlock(ctx.zbuf.zbp);
+    w[11] = ctx.zbuf.psm;
+    w[12] = static_cast<uint32_t>(ctx.test);
+    w[13] = static_cast<uint32_t>(ctx.alpha & 0xFFu);
+    w[14] = static_cast<uint32_t>((ctx.alpha >> 32) & 0xFFu);
+    w[15] = tex.tbp0;
+    w[16] = tex.tbw;
+    w[17] = tex.psm;
+    w[18] = tex.tcc;
+    w[19] = tex.tfx;
+    w[20] = tex.cpsm;
+    w[21] = tex.csm;
+    w[22] = tex.csa;
+    w[23] = state.textureWidth;
+    w[24] = state.textureHeight;
+    const uint64_t clamp = ctx.clamp;
+    w[25] = static_cast<uint32_t>(clamp & 0xFu);
+    w[26] = static_cast<uint32_t>((clamp >> 4) & 0x3FFu) | (static_cast<uint32_t>((clamp >> 14) & 0x3FFu) << 16);
+    w[27] = static_cast<uint32_t>((clamp >> 24) & 0x3FFu) | (static_cast<uint32_t>((clamp >> 34) & 0x3FFu) << 16);
+    w[28] = state.texa.ta0 | (state.texa.aem ? 0x100u : 0u) | (static_cast<uint32_t>(state.texa.ta1) << 16);
+    w[29] = state.fogR | (static_cast<uint32_t>(state.fogG) << 8) | (static_cast<uint32_t>(state.fogB) << 16);
+
+    const int ofx = ctx.xyoffset.ofx >> 4;
+    const int ofy = ctx.xyoffset.ofy >> 4;
+    if (triangle)
+    {
+        const GSVertex &v0 = batch.vertices[0], &v1 = batch.vertices[1], &v2 = batch.vertices[2];
+        const float fx0 = v0.x - static_cast<float>(ofx), fy0 = v0.y - static_cast<float>(ofy);
+        const float fx1 = v1.x - static_cast<float>(ofx), fy1 = v1.y - static_cast<float>(ofy);
+        const float fx2 = v2.x - static_cast<float>(ofx), fy2 = v2.y - static_cast<float>(ofy);
+        w[0] = 0u;
+        w[1] = static_cast<uint32_t>(clampInt(static_cast<int>(std::floor(std::min({fx0, fx1, fx2}))), ctx.scissor.x0, ctx.scissor.x1));
+        w[2] = static_cast<uint32_t>(clampInt(static_cast<int>(std::ceil(std::max({fx0, fx1, fx2}))), ctx.scissor.x0, ctx.scissor.x1));
+        w[3] = static_cast<uint32_t>(clampInt(static_cast<int>(std::floor(std::min({fy0, fy1, fy2}))), ctx.scissor.y0, ctx.scissor.y1));
+        w[4] = static_cast<uint32_t>(clampInt(static_cast<int>(std::ceil(std::max({fy0, fy1, fy2}))), ctx.scissor.y0, ctx.scissor.y1));
+        const float denom = (fy1 - fy2) * (fx0 - fx2) + (fx2 - fx1) * (fy0 - fy2);
+        if (std::fabs(denom) < 0.001f)
+            return 2;
+        if (!state.prim.tme && !state.prim.iip &&
+            !classifyAlphaTest(ctx.test, v2.a, static_cast<uint8_t>(ctx.frame.psm)).writesAnything())
+            return 2;
+        const float invDenom = 1.0f / denom;
+        w[51] = 0u;
+        w[60] = floatBits(fx0); // vertex positions for the rasterizer path (gs_raster.vert)
+        w[61] = floatBits(fy0);
+        w[62] = floatBits(fx1);
+        w[63] = floatBits(fy1);
+        w[30] = floatBits(fx2);
+        w[31] = floatBits(fy2);
+        w[32] = floatBits((fy1 - fy2) * invDenom);
+        w[33] = floatBits((fx2 - fx1) * invDenom);
+        w[34] = floatBits((fy2 - fy0) * invDenom);
+        w[35] = floatBits((fx0 - fx2) * invDenom);
+        const GSVertex *v[3] = {&v0, &v1, &v2};
+        for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
+        {
+            w[36 + i] = pack32(v[i]->r, v[i]->g, v[i]->b, v[i]->a);
+            w[39 + i] = static_cast<uint32_t>(v[i]->u) | (static_cast<uint32_t>(v[i]->v) << 16);
+            w[42 + i * 3] = floatBits(v[i]->s);
+            w[43 + i * 3] = floatBits(v[i]->t);
+            w[44 + i * 3] = floatBits(v[i]->q);
+            w[51] |= static_cast<uint32_t>(v[i]->fog) << (8 * i);
+            putDouble(w + 52 + i * 2, v[i]->z);
+        }
+        return 1;
+    }
+
+    // General sprite path (the CPU fast path goes through PrepareGpuSprite instead).
+    const GSVertex &v0 = batch.vertices[0], &v1 = batch.vertices[1];
+    int x0 = static_cast<int>(v0.x) - ofx, y0 = static_cast<int>(v0.y) - ofy;
+    int x1 = static_cast<int>(v1.x) - ofx, y1 = static_cast<int>(v1.y) - ofy;
+    if (x0 > x1)
+        std::swap(x0, x1);
+    if (y0 > y1)
+        std::swap(y0, y1);
+    const int unclippedX0 = x0, unclippedY0 = y0;
+    const int spanX = std::max(1, x1 - x0), spanY = std::max(1, y1 - y0);
+    const int unclippedX1 = unclippedX0 + spanX - 1, unclippedY1 = unclippedY0 + spanY - 1;
+    if (unclippedX1 < ctx.scissor.x0 || unclippedX0 > ctx.scissor.x1 || unclippedY1 < ctx.scissor.y0 || unclippedY0 > ctx.scissor.y1)
+        return 2;
+    std::memset(w + 35, 0, sizeof(primitive.words) - 35u * sizeof(uint32_t));
+    w[0] = 1u;
+    w[1] = static_cast<uint32_t>(clampInt(unclippedX0, ctx.scissor.x0, ctx.scissor.x1));
+    w[2] = static_cast<uint32_t>(clampInt(unclippedX1, ctx.scissor.x0, ctx.scissor.x1));
+    w[3] = static_cast<uint32_t>(clampInt(unclippedY0, ctx.scissor.y0, ctx.scissor.y1));
+    w[4] = static_cast<uint32_t>(clampInt(unclippedY1, ctx.scissor.y0, ctx.scissor.y1));
+    w[30] = pack32(v1.r, v1.g, v1.b, v1.a);
+    w[31] = static_cast<u32>(v1.z);
+    w[32] = v1.fog;
+    w[33] = static_cast<uint32_t>(unclippedX0);
+    w[34] = static_cast<uint32_t>(unclippedY0);
+    if (state.prim.tme)
+    {
+        const int texW = state.textureWidth, texH = state.textureHeight;
+        float u0f, v0f, u1f, v1f;
+        if (state.prim.fst)
+        {
+            u0f = static_cast<float>(v0.u >> 4);
+            v0f = static_cast<float>(v0.v >> 4);
+            u1f = static_cast<float>(v1.u >> 4);
+            v1f = static_cast<float>(v1.v >> 4);
+        }
+        else
+        {
+            const float q0 = fabsQ(v0.q), q1 = fabsQ(v1.q);
+            u0f = (v0.s / q0) * static_cast<float>(texW);
+            v0f = (v0.t / q0) * static_cast<float>(texH);
+            u1f = (v1.s / q1) * static_cast<float>(texW);
+            v1f = (v1.t / q1) * static_cast<float>(texH);
+        }
+        const float spriteW = std::max(static_cast<float>(spanX), 1.0f), spriteH = std::max(static_cast<float>(spanY), 1.0f);
+        for (int x = static_cast<int>(w[1]); x <= static_cast<int>(w[2]); ++x)
+        {
+            const float tx = (static_cast<float>(x - unclippedX0) + 0.5f) / spriteW;
+            const float texUf = u0f + (u1f - u0f) * tx;
+            primitive.columns.push_back(state.prim.fst ? static_cast<uint32_t>(static_cast<uint16_t>(clampInt(static_cast<int>((texUf * 16.0f) + 0.5f), 0, 0xFFFF)))
+                                                       : floatBits(texUf / static_cast<float>(texW)));
+        }
+        for (int y = static_cast<int>(w[3]); y <= static_cast<int>(w[4]); ++y)
+        {
+            const float ty = (static_cast<float>(y - unclippedY0) + 0.5f) / spriteH;
+            const float texVf = v0f + (v1f - v0f) * ty;
+            primitive.rows.push_back(state.prim.fst ? static_cast<uint32_t>(static_cast<uint16_t>(clampInt(static_cast<int>((texVf * 16.0f) + 0.5f), 0, 0xFFFF)))
+                                                    : floatBits(texVf / static_cast<float>(texH)));
+        }
+    }
+    return 1;
+}

+void GSCpuBackend::NotePagePsm(uint32_t page, uint8_t psm)
+{
+    // Only the worker writes: compare without the lock, take it only on a change.
+    if (page < m_pagePsm.size() && m_pagePsm[page] != psm)
+    {
+        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> frameLock(m_frameMutex);
+        m_pagePsm[page] = psm;
+    }
+}

+// MKSM's light rays (Goro's Lair ceiling beams, pillar column) arrive as T4 strips with full
+// vertex alpha (0x80) and the normal blend 0x44, so they draw as solid grey bars;
+// the console shows faint soft beams there (PLANO 5A.24: the data itself says opaque). An
+// improvement over fidelity: draw them additive with low alpha. PS2X_RAYS=0 keeps the original.
+static void softenLightRay(GSPrimitiveBatch &batch)
+{
+    static const bool enabled = [] { const char *v = std::getenv("PS2X_RAYS"); return !(v && *v == '0'); }();
+    GSDrawState &state = batch.state;
+    GSContext &ctx = state.context;
+    if (!enabled || !state.prim.tme || !state.prim.abe || batch.vertexCount != 3u ||
+        (ctx.test & 0x7FFFFull) != 0x7380Bull || (ctx.alpha & 0xFFull) != 0x44ull || ctx.tex0.psm != GS_PSM_T4)
+        return;
+    // shortcut: matched by VRAM address in Goro's Lair: the beam palette 0x2F8B (beam textures
+    // 0x2F5F and 0x2F7F) and the pillar column texture 0x2728. Other stages may place theirs
+    // elsewhere: add them when seen.
+    if (ctx.tex0.cbp != 0x2F8Bu && ctx.tex0.tbp0 != 0x2728u)
+        return;
+    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < batch.vertexCount; ++i)
+    {
+        const GSVertex &v = batch.vertices[i];
+        if (v.a < 0x80u) // the translucent passes of the same beam already look right
+            return;
+    }
+    ctx.alpha = (ctx.alpha & ~0xFFull) | 0x48ull; // Cs * As + Cd
+    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < batch.vertexCount; ++i)
+        batch.vertices[i].a = 0x18u;
+}

+    // (LCM=1: LOD = K), then TEX0 points at that level from MIPTBP1/2. Without it only level 0

+    // shortcut: the GS picks the level per pixel; a big triangle spanning levels uses one. Pass
+    // the LOD per pixel to the shaders if seams show. FST (UV) primitives keep level 0.

+    {

+        float lod = k;
+        if ((tex1Mip & 1u) == 0u)
+        {
+            float q = 0.0f;
+            for (int i = 0; i < batch.vertexCount; ++i)

+            lod = (q > 0.0f ? std::log2(1.0f / q) : 0.0f) * static_cast<float>(1u << l) + k;

+        mipLevel = std::clamp(static_cast<int>(lod + 0.5f), 0, static_cast<int>(std::min(mxl, 6u)));

 void VU1Interpreter::advanceTo(uint64_t targetCycle)
 {
     while (m_cycle < targetCycle)
+    {
+        // Nothing commits before the next ready cycle: jump to it, giving PATH1 the
+        // cycles in between at once (it only reads VU memory, which they leave alone).
+        const uint64_t next = std::min(targetCycle, m_nextPipelineCycle);
+        if (next > m_cycle + 1u)
+        {
+            const uint64_t skipped = next - 1u - m_cycle;
+            m_cycle = next - 1u;
+            m_state.cycles = m_cycle;
+            if (m_xgkick.active)
+            {
+                m_xgkick.cycleCredit += static_cast<decltype(m_xgkick.cycleCredit)>(skipped - 1u);

+    // The VU orders MAX/MINI operands as sign-magnitude integers: +0 > -0, and denormals
+    // compare by their bits instead of as zero. The result is one operand's bits, unchanged.
+    int32_t vuOrderKey(float value)
+    {
+        int32_t bits;
+        std::memcpy(&bits, &value, sizeof(bits));
+        return bits ^ ((bits >> 31) & 0x7FFFFFFF);
+    }

+                const std::string saved = previous ? previous : "";

+                else

+                uint32_t seed = 12345u;
+                auto next = [&] { seed = seed * 1664525u + 1013904223u; return seed; };
+                auto upload = [&](uint32_t dbp, uint32_t dbw, uint32_t psm, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t bytesPerPixel)
+                {
+                    gs.writeRegister(GS_REG_BITBLTBUF, (static_cast<uint64_t>(dbp) << 32) | (static_cast<uint64_t>(dbw) << 48) |
+                                                           (static_cast<uint64_t>(psm) << 56));
+                    gs.writeRegister(GS_REG_TRXPOS, 0ull);
+                    gs.writeRegister(GS_REG_TRXREG, w | (static_cast<uint64_t>(h) << 32));
+                    gs.writeRegister(GS_REG_TRXDIR, 0ull);
+                    const uint32_t bytes = w * h * bytesPerPixel;
+                    std::vector<uint8_t> packet;
+                    appendU64(packet, makeGifTag(static_cast<uint16_t>(bytes / 16u), GIF_FMT_IMAGE, 0u, true));
+                    appendU64(packet, 0ull);
+                    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < bytes; ++i)
+                        packet.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(next() >> 24));
+                    gs.processGIFPacket(packet.data(), static_cast<uint32_t>(packet.size()));
+                    gs.writeRegister(GS_REG_TEXFLUSH, 0ull);
+                };
+                auto xyz = [](uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t z)
+                { return (static_cast<uint64_t>(x) << 4) | (static_cast<uint64_t>(y) << 20) | (static_cast<uint64_t>(z) << 32); };
+                auto st = [](float s, float tt)
+                {
+                    uint32_t a = 0u, b = 0u;
+                    std::memcpy(&a, &s, 4u);

+                    return static_cast<uint64_t>(a) | (static_cast<uint64_t>(b) << 32);
+                };
+                auto frame = [&](uint32_t fbp, uint32_t psm)
+                { gs.writeRegister(GS_REG_FRAME_1, fbp | (10ull << 16) | (static_cast<uint64_t>(psm) << 24)); };
+                auto texture = [&](uint32_t tbp, uint32_t tbw, uint32_t psm, uint32_t cbp, uint32_t cpsm, uint32_t csm, uint32_t cld)
+                {

+                                                        (static_cast<uint64_t>(cpsm) << 51) | (static_cast<uint64_t>(csm) << 55) |
+                                                        (static_cast<uint64_t>(cld) << 61));

+                auto triangle = [&](bool textured, uint32_t ox, uint32_t oy, uint32_t size)
+                {

+                        gs.writeRegister(GS_REG_XYZ2, xyz(ox + next() % size, oy + next() % size, next() & 0xFFFFFFu));
+                    }

+                {

+                    gs.writeRegister(GS_REG_RGBAQ, (next() & 0x7FFFFFFFu) | (0x3F800000ull << 32));

+                frame(0u, GS_PSM_CT32);

+                gs.writeRegister(GS_REG_TEST_1, (1ull << 16) | (1ull << 17)); // ZTST ALWAYS

+                upload(kTex, 1u, GS_PSM_CT32, 64u, 64u, 4u);

+                    triangle(true, 0u, 0u, 250u);

+            // Two blocks at word 0x5000 through the STD port: every nibble 7, shift 0, filter 0
+            // (each sample 0x7000); the second block ends the loop without repeat.
+            spu2Write16(reg(0x1A8), 0u);
+            spu2Write16(reg(0x1AA), 0x5000u);

+            {
+                spu2Write16(reg(0x1AC), block == 0u ? 0x0400u : 0x0100u);
+                for (uint32_t word = 0u; word < 7u; ++word)
+                    spu2Write16(reg(0x1AC), 0x7777u);
+            }
+            spu2Write16(reg(0x000), 0x3FFFu); // voice 0 volume
+            spu2Write16(reg(0x002), 0x3FFFu);
+            spu2Write16(reg(0x004), 0x1000u); // one sample per output frame
+            spu2Write16(reg(0x006), 0x000Fu); // fastest linear attack
+            spu2Write16(reg(0x1C0), 0u);      // SSA
+            spu2Write16(reg(0x1C2), 0x5000u);
+            spu2Write16(reg(0x188), 1u); // dry mix, left and right
+            spu2Write16(reg(0x190), 1u);
+            spu2Write16(reg(0x760), 0x3FFFu);
+            spu2Write16(reg(0x762), 0x3FFFu);
+            spu2Write16(reg(0x1A0), 1u); // KON voice 0

+        // The recompiler (ps2_vu1_jit.cpp) must leave registers, memory and the cycle count
+        // exactly as the interpreter does. Program A is a real MKSM block whose NaN inputs
+        // drive MADDA to the exponent limit; program B covers every supported operation.
+        tc.Run("VU1 recompiler matches the interpreter bit for bit", [](TestCase &t)
+        {
+            struct Program
+            {
+                std::vector<std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t>> pairs; // lower, upper
+                std::vector<std::pair<uint32_t, std::array<uint32_t, 4>>> vf;
+                std::array<uint32_t, 4> acc{};
+                float q = 0.0f;
+                float i = 0.0f;
+            };
+            struct Outcome
+            {
+                VU1State state{};
+                std::vector<uint8_t> data;
+            };
+            const auto run = [&t](const Program &program, bool jit)
+            {
+                Vu1Fixture fx;
+                t.IsTrue(fx.initialize(), "VU1 fixture should initialize");
+                uint32_t pc = 0u;
+                for (const auto &[lower, upper] : program.pairs)
+                {
+                    writeVuInstructionPair(fx.code, pc, lower, upper);
+                    pc += 8u;
+                }
+                writeVuInstructionPair(fx.code, pc, 0u, kVuUpperNop | 0x40000000u);
+                writeVuInstructionPair(fx.code, pc + 8u, 0u, kVuUpperNop);
+                for (uint32_t qword = 0u; qword < 64u; ++qword)
+                    for (uint32_t lane = 0u; lane < 4u; ++lane)
+                    {
+                        const float value = static_cast<float>(qword * 4u + lane) * 0.75f - 40.0f;
+                        std::memcpy(fx.data + qword * 16u + lane * 4u, &value, 4u);
+                    }
+                VU1Interpreter vu1;
+                vu1.setJitEnabled(jit);
+                for (const auto &[reg, bits] : program.vf)
+                    std::memcpy(vu1.state().vf[reg], bits.data(), 16u);
+                std::memcpy(vu1.state().acc, program.acc.data(), 16u);
+                vu1.state().q = program.q;
+                vu1.state().i = program.i;
+                vu1.execute(fx.code, PS2_VU1_CODE_SIZE, fx.data, PS2_VU1_DATA_SIZE, fx.gs, &fx.mem, 0u, 0u, 0u, 4096u);
+                Outcome outcome;
+                outcome.state = vu1.state();
+                outcome.data.assign(fx.data, fx.data + PS2_VU1_DATA_SIZE);
+                return outcome;
+            };
+            const auto compare = [&t, &run](const Program &program, const char *name)
+            {
+                const Outcome interpreted = run(program, false);
+                const Outcome recompiled = run(program, true);
+                for (uint32_t reg = 0u; reg < 32u; ++reg)
+                    t.IsTrue(std::memcmp(interpreted.state.vf[reg], recompiled.state.vf[reg], 16u) == 0,
+                             std::string(name) + ": vf" + std::to_string(reg) + " should match");
+                t.IsTrue(std::memcmp(interpreted.state.vi, recompiled.state.vi, sizeof(interpreted.state.vi)) == 0,
+                         std::string(name) + ": VI registers should match");
+                t.IsTrue(std::memcmp(interpreted.state.acc, recompiled.state.acc, 16u) == 0,
+                         std::string(name) + ": ACC should match");
+                t.IsTrue(std::memcmp(&interpreted.state.i, &recompiled.state.i, 4u) == 0,
+                         std::string(name) + ": I should match");
+                t.IsTrue(interpreted.data == recompiled.data, std::string(name) + ": VU memory should match");
+                // Recompiled blocks never queue MAC/STATUS (nothing reads them there), so the
+                // final pipeline drain can end up to one FMAC latency sooner.
+                t.IsTrue(recompiled.state.cycles <= interpreted.state.cycles &&
+                             interpreted.state.cycles - recompiled.state.cycles <= 4u,
+                         std::string(name) + ": cycles should match up to the flag drain");
+            };
+
+            Program game;
+            game.pairs = {{0x10052803u, 0x01f061bcu}, {0x03e59ffdu, 0x01e0b4d0u}, {0x03e5affbu, 0x01f068bdu},
+                          {0x03c597f9u, 0x01f070beu}, {0x8000033cu, 0x01e07c8bu}, {0x8000033cu, 0x00330407u},
+                          {0x8000033cu, 0x01d341bcu}, {0x8000033cu, 0x01d348bdu}, {0x8000033cu, 0x01d350beu}};
+            game.vf = {{12u, {0x4e46e169u, 0x4e4613b6u, 0xce97a5d0u, 0x00007fffu}},
+                       {13u, {0xce46e168u, 0xce4613b6u, 0x4e97a5cfu, 0x00000000u}},
+                       {14u, {0xce7eb0dau, 0xce7eb0dau, 0x4e8099d2u, 0x30b73030u}},
+                       {15u, {0xdacc4cb5u, 0xce7eb0dau, 0x4e8099d2u, 0x5e5e69cdu}},
+                       {16u, {0x7fffffffu, 0x7fffffffu, 0x80000000u, 0x00003516u}}};
+            game.acc = {0x4bfdcba6u, 0xc7f022efu, 0xc7f0a6dbu, 0xd2166a27u};
+            compare(game, "MKSM block");
+
+            const auto bits = [](float value)
+            {

+                std::memcpy(&raw, &value, 4u);

+            };
+            Program covered;
+            covered.vf = {{2u, {bits(1.5f), bits(-2.0f), bits(3.25f), bits(4.0f)}},
+                          {3u, {bits(0.5f), bits(2.0f), bits(-1.0f), 0x7F800000u}},
+                          {12u, {16u, static_cast<uint32_t>(-32), 48u, 1000u}},
+                          {22u, {bits(3.0e38f), bits(-3.0e38f), bits(2.0e38f), bits(1.0f)}}};
+            covered.acc = {bits(1.0f), bits(2.0f), bits(3.0f), bits(4.0f)};
+            covered.q = 0.25f;

+            covered.pairs = {
